title: Software Engineer (Java) - Security
description: <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <h2><strong>In a nutshell</strong></h2> <p>At Picnic, we're building the most secure milkman on earth. Our Security team owns the security tooling that protects Picnic, and we're looking for a Java Engineer to make it work everywhere: connecting our systems to those tools, automating checks across the whole company, and strengthening how we manage identity and access.<br>You'll be the engineer in the Security team. Instead of writing policies, you'll write the code that wires our security systems into the rest of Picnic, and you'll help product teams do the right thing by default. </p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Take ownership of projects from concept to delivery, aligning technical solutions with business goals with a product engineering mindset.</li> <li><strong>Platform work:</strong> Own Picnic’s core Security and IAM platform services, and build integrations with internal and external services.</li> <li><strong>Identity & Access:</strong> Help take our IAM initiative from MVP to production. Look at the options, build or integrate the pieces and connect them to the systems Picnic runs on.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration: </strong>Work closely with development teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Security Ambassador: </strong>Conduct application security workshops to raise awareness and promote secure coding practices among developers.<strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Our Tech:</strong> Java 21/25 (Spring 6 with Spring Boot 3.5, Reactor, Immutables, Maven), React, Angular, RabbitMQ, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Git, Docker, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault, Datadog, Python 3.x</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a Master’s Degree (in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related technical field) or equivalent experience.</li> <li>You have at least 3-7 years of professional experience with Java. </li> <li>A genuine curiosity about security: experience isn’t required, but you’re excited to dive into topics like access control and to grow into the domain with us.</li> <li>Your English skills are on point (no Dutch required).</li> <li>You're based in or happy to relocate to the Netherlands*<br><br>For bonus points:</li> <li>Experience with Security frameworks like NIST, CIS Controls</li> <li>Working experience in IAM integrations</li> </ul> <p>We work from our office in Amsterdam. Being present makes a genuine difference to your team and the work. There's flexibility to work from home when needed, but if remote or hybrid-first is what you're after, this probably isn't the right fit.</p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>✍🏼 Every expert was once a beginner! </strong></p> <p>You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training. We also offer free professional weekly language courses.</p> <p><strong>💡 Make a difference</strong></p> <p>You’ll work in an awesome startup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place! </p> <p><strong>🫱🏼‍🫲🏾 Teamwork makes the dream work</strong></p> <p>With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!</p> <p><strong>🍎 You are what you eat</strong></p> <p>You’ll get freshly prepared, healthy lunches and snacks (with plenty of vegetarian, vegan, and halal options). Coffee snob? Don’t worry, our amazing Picnic barista has you covered.</p> <p><strong>🚴🏽 Stay healthy </strong></p> <p>Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials. There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga, to climbing! </p> <p><strong>🔋 Attractive package</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self, as well as 25 vacation days per year, so you can recharge your batteries </p> <p><strong>🌍 Benefits for expats </strong></p> <p>It can be daunting starting a new job AND moving to a new country. That’s why we offer lots of support for our many expat colleagues, if you want to find our relocation benefits, see <a href="https://jobs.picnic.app/en/relocation">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> </section> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Project Manager Microsoft Dynamics 365
description: <p> </p> <p><em><strong>Complexe projecten, volop mogelijkheden om te groeien en werken bij één van de top Microsoft system integrators van Nederland. Als Senior Project manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van Microsoft technologie en geef je leiding aan het projectteam van HSO.  </strong></em></p> <p>We bouwen steeds vaker oplossingen voor klanten die niet alleen ERP willen, maar die bewust kiezen voor het Microsoft Cloud platform. En dus bijvoorbeeld ook kiezen voor Dynamics 365 for CRM, Field Service en Power BI. Omdat HSO één van de weinige Microsoft system integrators is, kunnen we klanten deze totaaloplossing bieden. De complexe en grotere internationale projecten vragen veel expertise en ervaring, Dus we hebben volop werk en uitdaging! </p> <p>Ben jij gewend om grootschalige Microsoft applicatie projecten te leiden? </p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen? </strong></p> <p>Als Senior Project manager schakel je continu tussen de belangen van de klant en HSO. De projecten zijn bovengemiddeld complex van aard en de stakeholders zijn vaak over meerdere bedrijven en de wereld verspreid. Dit is geen uitdaging maar gesneden koek voor jou. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Jij beschikt over: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Ten minste 5 jaar ervaring met ERP-implementaties als Project manager;</li> <li>Je deelt onze mind set: je bent een kritische denker, een ondernemende zelf starter en je verbindt je met het resultaat;</li> <li>Je business English is dik in orde, gezien onze internationale projecten;</li> <li>Je management vaardigheden zijn consulterend, anticiperend en voorstellend van aard en gebruikt deze eigenschappen om mensen met je mee te krijgen en effectief te laten functioneren;</li> <li>Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, Dynamics AX 2012 of Dynamics 365 is een pre;</li> <li>Aantoonbare kennis van methodieken voor project management zowel waterval als Agile, bijvoorbeeld PRINCE II, PMI- of IPMA C/D-certificering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden we jou?  </strong></p> <p>Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  </p> <ul> <li>Een competitief salaris en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties </li> <li>Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daarbovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;</li> <li>25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken; </li> <li>Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation; </li> <li>EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote; </li> <li>Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; </li> <li>En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun </strong> </p> <p>Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. </p> <p><strong>Over HSO  </strong></p> <p>HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  <br>  </p> <p>HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Solliciteren  </strong></p> <p>Enthousiast? title: Senior Solution Architect
description: <div>At Qualtrics, we create software that the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform. We are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18,000 clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and an appreciation for the unconventional—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. <br><br>When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set ambitious goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged, and complex problems are solved by collaborating and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities— they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.</div> <div> </div> <div style="text-align: center;"><strong>Senior Solution Architect</strong></div> <p><strong>Why We Have This Role</strong></p> <div> <div>We need a Senior Solution Architect to help customers plan and deliver enterprise-grade Qualtrics solutions across APAC. You will sit at the intersection of sales, services and engineering: engaging customers early to define vision and feasibility, designing technical architectures and integration approaches (APIs, data flows, CRM integrations), and ensuring solutions are deliverable and aligned to business outcomes. This role’s primary focus is supporting the sales organisation to win and grow software opportunities, with a secondary focus on attaching the right Professional Services to those deals.</div> </div> <p><strong>How You’ll Find Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep SaaS and integration knowledge — understands APIs, cloud architectures and how platforms integrate with enterprise systems.</li> <li>Solution-design fluency — translates business requirements into robust, scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Customer-facing consulting ability — builds credibility with technical and business stakeholders and leads discovery and scoping conversations.</li> <li>Delivery mindset — scopes feasible solutions, anticipates risks, and ensures smooth handovers to delivery teams.</li> <li>Sales enablement orientation — supports sales with clear, commercial technical guidance that de-risks opportunities and helps win business.</li> <li>Strong communicator — explains complex technical concepts in business terms and produces clear documentation and solution artefacts.</li> <li>Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity — manages multiple opportunities independently and adapts to changing priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How You’ll Grow</strong></p> <ul> <li>Broaden technical leadership across the APAC region, influencing how Qualtrics solutions are positioned and implemented.</li> <li>Gain exposure to large, multi-market programs and procurement-driven customers, strengthening enterprise delivery capability.</li> <li>Influence product and services roadmap by surfacing repeatable customer requirements and integrations.</li> <li>Develop a visible pre-sales and go-to-market profile across Sales, Solutions and Engineering stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Things You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Validate feasibility and accelerate deal velocity — lead discovery and project scoping sessions with customers and internal teams to confirm technical requirements, propose architectures, and produce scoped statements of work that support commercial decisions.</li> <li>Design fit-for-purpose solutions that meet business objectives — craft end-to-end technical designs (including integrations, data flows and security considerations) that adapt the Qualtrics platform to enterprise environments.</li> <li>Reduce delivery risk and improve outcomes — identify and mitigate technical and operational risks early, define implementation approaches, and ensure smooth transition to delivery and services teams.</li> <li>Support sales and services revenue — provide technical leadership in later-stage sales conversations, create persuasive technical materials and costed solutions, and help position services that increase license adoption.</li> <li>Influence product and engineering priorities — consolidate repeatable design patterns and customer requirements into recommendations for Product and Engineering to improve platform capabilities.</li> <li>Improve team effectiveness — contribute to process, tooling and knowledge-sharing initiatives that raise the quality and efficiency of solution architecture across the region.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For On Your Resume</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years’ relevant experience in software, pre-sales<strong>,</strong> solution architecture, systems integration or consulting — with demonstrable experience in SaaS environments.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing custom solutions or enterprise integrations for medium-to-large enterprise customers.</li> <li>Strong understanding of APIs, MCP, web services, cloud platforms and common integration patterns (experience integrating with modern cloud data platforms an advantage).</li> <li>Proven track record working in sales-supporting roles or pre-sales teams, including scoping, RFP/tender responses and commercial solutioning.</li> <li>Ability to communicate technical designs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce clear documentation (diagrams, SOWs, proposals).</li> <li>Familiarity with security, performance and data architecture considerations.</li> <li>Degree in computer science, engineering, IT or relevant experience; Qualtrics product experience is a plus but not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Should Know About This Team</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>You’ll join a small but growing APAC Solutions function that supports both pre-sales and Professional Services — this is a high-impact, high-visibility role.</li> <li>The role balances technical architecture with commercial outcomes: you’ll influence customer decisions and internal strategy.</li> <li>We value autonomy, practical problem solving and sharing lessons learned to scale best practices across the region.</li> <li>The team is resource-constrained and moving quickly — there are strong opportunities to shape the function and take on leadership responsibilities.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary plus variable/OTEs and opportunities for Long-Term Incentives.</li> <li>Comprehensive private health coverage and standard employee benefits.</li> <li>Hybrid working model with flexible work practices.</li> <li>Learning & development support and a culture of mentoring and knowledge sharing.</li> <li> <div>Office perks (team events, catered lunches and stocked kitchens at major offices).</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model</strong>: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid</div> <div> </div> <div><em>Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.</em></div> <div> </div> <div><em>​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:<a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/fmla">Family & Medical Leave Act</a>, <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/poster">Equal Opportunity Employment</a>, <a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act">Employee Polygraph Protection Act</a></em></div> <div> </div> <div><em>Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.</em></div> <div> </div> <div><em>Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>This role builds testing into Dive-XL designs and gives Production the test capability to find faults early. The aim is that faults are found at the lowest level of assembly where they can be found, problems reach design teams with the data needed to fix them, and recurring problems are fixed at their source in the design. The role sits within the Platform Engineering organisation and works closely with Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations.<br>The role starts with the Dive-XL vehicle, built in Australia. Once the approach is proven there, it extends in agreed stages to other Maritime Engineering products and our US sites. At each stage, the responsibilities below apply to the products and sites then in scope, and the role hands the capability it builds to the teams that will run it before moving on.<br>This is a senior technical leadership role at Staff level, and its output is engineering: test strategies, test modes and interfaces, test tooling and design changes. It needs deep technical judgement across electronics, firmware and software, and the credibility to influence design engineers and production teams. The role builds software and tooling for test stations and factory acceptance testing (FAT). Running them day to day, station hardware, fixtures and calibration, first-line triage and field support are outside its scope.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br><strong>Test-Ready Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>From the start of each new Dive-XL design, set its test strategy with the design engineers: what is checked at board, subsystem and vehicle level (electrical performance as well as functional behaviour), with what limits, test points and firmware test modes, and how each test is run</li> <li>Own the firmware and software parts of each test strategy, and work with the electrical and mechanical design engineers on their parts. Specify and verify firmware test modes, and provide a reference implementation of each new kind for the owning firmware teams to adopt</li> <li>Within delegated authority, set testability requirements, sign off testability at design reviews, and own the standards that make products testable: the firmware test-mode specification, device interface definitions and the factory record (each unit's identity and as-built configuration). Work with Configuration Management to add a test-impact check to engineering changes</li> <li>Extend testability across existing Dive-XL boards and subsystems, in a priority order agreed with Platform leadership and informed by production data: built-in self-test, test modes, factory records and a defined starting software baseline for newly built boards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Test Platform and Tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build the shared software that engineering test and production test both use to talk to devices: machine-readable device definitions versioned with the firmware, versioned command interfaces, and a client library for hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) rigs and production stations. Keep it open and not tied to any one test framework</li> <li>With the firmware and application software teams, add an automated check to their release process that production test still works with each new firmware and application version</li> <li>With Manufacturing Engineering, deliver automated test for a first Dive-XL subsystem that runs independently of the application software release cycle, and hand it over, with acceptance tests, to Manufacturing Engineering's test engineers</li> <li>Treat production test tooling as a product, with users, requirements, releases, documentation and a roadmap, and hand it over to its long-term owner when it is ready. With Manufacturing Engineering, make the software on test stations repeatable to deploy from a version-pinned release (for example NixOS), so a new station or site is set up from a release, not by hand</li> </ul> <p><strong>Closing the Loop with Production</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take the software and test side of each first-of-type build of a new design through to readiness, so problems are found and fixed before volume production</li> <li>With Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations, build fault-reporting and diagnostic tools so problems arrive with the data needed to solve them, and Production can resolve more problems itself</li> <li>Use escalations from Production to find systemic causes: lead the root-cause analysis of repeat and systemic problems across hardware, firmware, software and test, and drive a lasting fix at the source (the design, the test or the tooling) with the owning teams</li> <li>Build FAT tooling for Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing Operations to adopt: scripted acceptance runs with machine-readable results, automated unit setup and vehicle-level diagnostics. Use FAT data to propose procedure changes, with evidence, for the procedure owner to consider</li> <li>Decide software, configuration and test questions within delegated authority (for example, a firmware version mismatch on a built unit, or whether a failure is a defect or a design limit), and escalate decisions beyond that authority</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Leadership, Collaboration and Metrics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work as one team with Platform's mechanical and electrical engineers on production readiness: shared readiness criteria for first-of-type builds, common quality-ticket categories, one metrics view and a joint review of FAT teardowns, with this role responsible for the software and test parts</li> <li>Provide technical leadership to the engineers and contractors working on test capability, and work with Manufacturing Engineering's test engineers so Production can own and extend it</li> <li>With Platform's mechanical and electrical engineers and Manufacturing Engineering, track and report shared results: how often Production needs to call in design engineers during first-of-type builds, quality tickets on first-of-type builds, faults caught at a lower level of assembly, FAT first-pass yield, time to root cause, teardown events, and escalations from Production per vehicle built</li> <li>Build strong working relationships across Platform's engineering, software and firmware teams, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, New Product Introduction, Quality and Program Management</li> <li>Take part in production readiness reviews, design reviews (DFM/DFA/DFT) and engineering change reviews as the software and test voice</li> <li>As the role extends, write playbooks that take the approach to new product lines and sites</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Competencies & Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering Judgement:</strong> Technical depth across electronics, firmware and software, with production pragmatism; sound decisions under time pressure without over-engineering</li> <li><strong>Systems and Test Thinking:</strong> Sees the product, its tests and the factory as one system; decides what to check at each level of assembly and catches faults as early as possible</li> <li><strong>Design Authority Integrity:</strong> Protects safety and quality under schedule pressure; knows the limits of electronics, including taking products from design into production</li> <li>Experience designing test into embedded products and taking them through production test (test modes, test interfaces, fixtures or automated test stations), hands-on or as technical lead</li> <li>Hands-on experience on or directly supporting a production floor</li> <li>Root cause analysis across hardware, firmware and software, and a strong grasp of firmware loading, configuration management and software baselines</li> <li>Technical leadership of cross-disciplinary engineering work, including directing the work of other engineers</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance</li> <li>Willingness to travel to US sites from time to time</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Design update strategies (full-image, delta/differential, A/B partitioning) that guarantee safe, resumable, and rollback-capable updates across heterogeneous ECUs. Define and evolve the software/hardware compatibility (mismatch) framework, including version dependency graphs, pre-condition checks, and campaign eligibility rules. Drive interface and contract discussions with cloud/backend teams (campaign orchestration, telemetry ingestion, update eligibility services) to keep vehicle-side and cloud-side assumptions in sync. Work with communication protocol stacks used for in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud data exchange (e.g., UDS/ISO 14229, DoIP, SOME/IP, CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, TLS/mTLS, MQTT) to integrate OTA services with ECUs and cloud endpoints. Ensure OTA processes meet automotive security and safety expectations: secure boot, cryptographic signing/verification, key management, and compliance-oriented practices aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R156 (Software Update Management System). Partner with QA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and vehicle integration teams to validate updates through bench, HIL, and vehicle-level testing. Support root-cause analysis and resolution of field issues related to update failures, mismatches, or rollback scenarios. Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence. Drive Germany-site development activities end-to-end: technical planning, design reviews, code quality standards, and delivery execution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior and mid-level engineers on the Germany team; review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability. Identify architectural risks and technical debt early; propose and lead initiatives to address them across the OTA stack. Act as a key escalation point for complex, cross-cutting technical issues spanning firmware, middleware, and cloud interfaces. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in embedded, systems, or automotive software. Demonstrated experience owning system or platform architecture for a production software product, ideally in automotive, IoT, or another safety- or reliability-critical domain. Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, including cross-site or cross-organization collaboration. Experience directly interfacing with a partner engineering team in a different location/time zone to align on architecture and delivery. Strong, hands-on proficiency in C++ and Rust — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement, as the majority of OTA services are implemented in these languages. Solid understanding of embedded Linux / POSIX-compliant operating environments and the constraints of resource-limited automotive compute platforms. Practical experience with in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, UDS/DoIP, TLS, MQTT, gRPC/Protobuf, or comparable). Comfortable driving technical interface discussions directly with cloud/backend engineering teams — defining APIs, data contracts, and failure-handling behavior across the vehicle-cloud boundary. Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software. Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains. Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration with the Palo Alto team; German language skills are a plus for local site interactions. Willingness to travel occasionally to Palo Alto, CA (or host virtual overlap hours) to support cross-site architecture and planning. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience specifically in OTA/software update systems for vehicles or other connected embedded devices. Experience establishing or scaling a new engineering site or team within a larger, distributed organization. Exposure to Machine Learning / AI techniques applied to edge compute — e.g., anomaly detection on update telemetry, predictive mismatch detection, or on-device inference constraints. Automotive middleware development experience on POSIX-based ECUs (e.g., AUTOSAR Adaptive, Linux-based domain/zone controllers, or similar middleware frameworks). Familiarity with Yocto/embedded Linux build systems and board support packages. Experience with functional safety practices (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity standards (ISO/SAE 21434). Knowledge of software bill of materials (SBOM) tooling and dependency/version management at fleet scale. Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test environments and automotive diagnostic tooling. Familiarity with containerization or virtualization on embedded targets (e.g., lightweight containers, hypervisors) for update isolation. Prior experience in a distributed/multi-site engineering organization, including asynchronous collaboration across time zones. title: Senior Territory Account Executive (Based in Sydney)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for amazing people to join our rapidly growing APAC sales team. Based in Sydney, you will drive sales for Cloudflare services into the commercial accounts across New South Wales to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</p> <p>The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p>Reporting to the Sales Manager, you will need to be highly motivated, energetic with a can-do attitude to exceed business targets and execute strategies to grow market share.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required.</li> </ul> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Product Marketing Manager | Kimchi AI Coding Platform| EMEA
description: <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Kimchi is Cast AI’s newest product: an agentic platform for running AI workloads. We are building in a greenfield space where the technology, customer expectations, and the competitive landscape shift constantly. The problem space is broad and ambiguous by design. If you are at your best when the playbook is still being written, you will thrive here.</p> <p>This is not a role for maintaining a mature product line. It’s a hands-on, zero-to-one PMM job inside a startup-like team with the backing of a unicorn. You must be curious. You’ll speak directly with early customers, run messaging and channel experiments, and build Kimchi’s ICP and positioning from the ground up. Then you’ll turn that evidence into the business’s first go-to-market playbook.</p> <p>You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and work alongside Product, Engineering, and company leadership, with support from Content, Growth, Design, and Sales Enablement as the work scales. As a senior hire, you have the autonomy to identify quick wins independently and the judgment to balance short-term results with a longer-term roadmap.</p> <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.</p> <p>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.</p> <p>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.</p> <p><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives<br></strong>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead. </p> <p><strong>Unicorn momentum<br></strong>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>What success looks like in 90 days</h4> <ul> <li>You understand Kimchi’s product, the problems it solves, and its priority audiences.</li> <li>You scope the highest-priority PMM problems instead of trying to solve everything at once.</li> <li>You run small experiments that produce trackable wins, including ICP hypotheses you validate or invalidate.</li> <li>You take senior ownership: you work independently, bring clear recommendations and trade-offs, and balance short-term execution with a longer-term roadmap.</li> </ul> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of product marketing experience with technical audiences, preferably developer tools or AI tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency. You can grasp nuances without an engineer walking you through every detail.</li> <li>Hands-on, sprint-based working style with an experimental mindset.</li> <li>Real experience building an ICP and messaging architecture from scratch for a product whose buying motion was not yet validated.</li> <li>A track record of running customer interviews and extracting patterns that refine positioning.</li> <li>Experience designing GTM experiments and changing direction based on what the data shows.</li> <li>Data literacy: you can define success criteria and read funnel or adoption data.</li> <li>Win/loss research and competitive deal support experience.</li> <li>Sound commercial judgment on pricing, packaging, and willingness to pay, even when Product owns the final call.</li> <li>Fluent English, written and spoken.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What would make you stand out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have thrived in an early-stage or ambiguous product environment.</li> <li>You can point to a PMM outcome that AI meaningfully improved, whether in speed, quality, reuse, or measurement.</li> <li>Excellent writing, backed by work samples such as positioning docs, launch content, and sales narratives.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities<strong>:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run deep, direct customer research to define and validate Kimchi’s ICP.</li> <li>Own positioning and messaging, and keep it consistent as new features ship.</li> <li>Own the commercial hypothesis, audience, message, positioning, and experiment design for GTM tests across trial flow, content, and channels. Growth, Product, and Demand Gen will help execute the experiments and measure results.</li> <li>Translate Kimchi’s technical differentiation into a value story that technical buyers recognize as true.</li> <li>Manage feature launches end to end, from early positioning through GA.</li> <li>Build the first version of sales enablement assets, battlecards, proof points, and demo narrative.</li> <li>Maintain the feedback loop from customer and market signal back into roadmap input.</li> <li>Track the competitive landscape and share what is changing with Product and leadership.</li> <li>Partner directly with Engineering to keep messaging accurate as the product evolves quickly.</li> <li>Build and maintain AI-assisted workflows that make this function faster, more consistent, or easier to measure.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in AI.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="356">Equity options.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="451">Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. title: (Senior) Manager (m/w/d), Commodities & Energy Trading
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities & Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich.</span> </span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.</span></span></p> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.</p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>You will take responsibility for delivering complex client engagements, leading project teams, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Commodity & Energy Trading practice. The breadth of your responsibilities will reflect your experience and the level at which you join. Areas of work include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Client leadership and delivery:</strong> Build trusted relationships with executive and senior client stakeholders, translate strategic priorities into practical programmes whilst owning complex engagements or major programmes from shaping through delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong governance and effective management of scope, risk and commercials.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Business Development</strong><strong>:</strong> Identify and shape opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, develop propositions and account plans, and contribute to business development, revenue growth and capability building. Strengthen our market profile through thought leadership, external networks, sector insight and collaboration across Baringa capabilities and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Depending on your expertise, your client work may include:</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operating model & business transformation: </strong>Leading trading operating model and business transformation engagements, helping clients optimise governance, processes and organisational structures to deliver sustainable operational change.</li> <li><strong>Digital & trading transformation: </strong>Delivering data, analytics and AI-enabled transformation initiatives, helping clients improve trading decision-making, operational efficiency and commercial performance.</li> <li><strong>Trading systems transformation:</strong> Leading ETRM/CTRM transformation engagements, supporting strategy, implementation and optimisation initiatives while aligning business and technology stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility services & integration: </strong>Leading the delivery of flexibility strategy and integration engagements, helping clients unlock value from battery storage, renewable assets and enabling technologies across evolving energy markets.</li> <li><strong>Risk and regulatory advisory: </strong>Advising clients on risk and regulatory challenges, enhancing risk management frameworks, governance and controls while supporting adaptation to evolving market and regulatory requirements.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"> </span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <p>We are looking for experienced professionals who combine management consulting experience with strong knowledge of commodity and energy markets, ideally within energy and commodity trading or trading transformation. You do not need experience across every commodity or capability listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one relevant area, together with the ability to solve complex client challenges:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering or leading complex consulting projects, transformation programmes or strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Deep expertise in at least one of Power, LNG, Gas & Clean Fuels, Metals or Oil, together with a strong understanding of trading organisations, markets and value chains.</li> <li>Relevant expertise in one or more of the following areas: trading operating models, business process improvement, ETRM/CTRM, data, analytics and AI, flexibility and optimisation, trading strategy and portfolio management, or risk and regulation.</li> <li>A track record of building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and influencing complex decisions.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in business development, including shaping opportunities, leading proposals or pitches, and converting client needs into valuable work.</li> <li>Experience leading, coaching and developing project teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in German and English.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":2,"335559738":200,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <p><strong><span style="color: #072b55;">About Boomi and What Makes Us Special</span></strong></p> </div> </div> <div> <div> <p><span style="color: #072b55;">Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out <a href="http://www.boomi.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.boomi.com/&source=gmail&ust=1782843859988000&usg=AOvVaw3Yitd6hYQcya0j0B5k0__J">boomi.com</a>  or visit our <a href="https://boomi.com/company/careers/" target="_blank" more.</span></p> </div> </div></div><h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As the Director, Enterprise Sales, UK & Ireland, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive the next phase of growth. </strong>Formulate and execute a sales strategy for your region that builds on our strong UK presence and ladders up to our overall sales strategy.</li> <li><strong>Win and grow. </strong>Lead, plan and manage sales activity across your territory to acquire new customers, grow existing ones and keep every customer delighted.</li> <li><strong>Lead an established team. </strong>Take the lead of a team of sales professionals selling Boomi products, solutions and services, and drive training and development plans in partnership with product and enablement that help them grow.</li> <li><strong>Be a player-coach. </strong>Stay hands-on with your team: deeply involved in account planning, strategy and sales calls.</li> <li><strong>Create a high-energy culture. </strong>Inspire your team to generate new pipeline and position Boomi’s products and services with confidence for expansion and net new logos. </li> <li><strong>Be a trusted advisor. </strong>Work closely with current and prospective customers to understand their unique challenges and goals, and show them how the Boomi Enterprise Platform, the active data foundation for agentic infrastructure, can help them harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity and blaze new trails within their organisations.</li> <li><strong>Power up with partners. </strong>Work closely with our network of 800+ partners, including GSIs, to open doors and win together.</li> <li><strong>Sell with discipline. </strong>Apply our sales methodology (MEDDPICC) and processes consistently.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across Boomi. </strong>Work with other regional leaders to drive operational cadence, and partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Industry Specialists, Technology and Marketing to build compelling value propositions and business cases.</li> <li><strong>Deliver results. </strong>Consistently achieve revenue targets.</li> <li><strong>Enjoy the ride. </strong>Contribute to our growth in a fast-paced, collaborative and fun atmosphere, as a valued member of our inclusive sales community.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A successful and impressive direct sales career, with a focus on solution selling at C-suite.</li> <li>A strong track record of leading direct sales teams in the UK and Ireland, specifically selling Enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS).</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue goals in the UK and Ireland.</li> <li>MEDDPICC practitioner.</li> <li>Strong forecasting capabilities, with a proven ability to build, drive and manage pipeline and achieve operational excellence.</li> <li>A high level of technical acumen and a good understanding of the customer and industry landscape Boomi operates in, including the shift to AI and agentic transformation. To the era of intelligence. </li> <li>Based remotely in the UK, covering the UK and Ireland territory.</li> <li>Competencies: adaptable, data-driven, inclusive and accountable for results.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.</li> <li>Experience in integration, iPaaS, API management, automation, AI or data management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Boomi?</strong></p> <p><strong>Market Momentum & Growth:</strong> Boomi is in one of its most exciting growth phases in EMEA. With strong investment and an established GTM team on the ground, you’ll have the support and infrastructure to succeed from day one.</p> <p><strong>Enterprise-Grade Technology:</strong> Recognised by Gartner, Forrester, and IDC as a leader, Boomi delivers a market-leading platform for integration, automation, and AI orchestration. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Du hast Spaß daran, selbständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen. Du bist offen, empathisch, klar in der Kommunikation und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit einem starken Team etwas zu bewegen. Du bist mitreißend, charmant und selbstbewusst. title: Director, Corporate Communications
description: <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.</p> <p>With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.</p> <h3>The Opportunity</h3> <p>Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.</p> <h3>Role Overview</h3> <p>As a Director in Teneo Strategy & Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.</p> <p>Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.</p> <p>This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.</p> <h3>Key Responsibilities</h3> <h3>Client Counsel</h3> <h3>o   Act as trusted adviser to clients across a diversity of sectors and industries.</h3> <h3>o   Provide leadership on corporate narrative, reputation, stakeholder engagement, issues management and crisis preparedness.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on how to communicate effectively with employees, media, government, regulators, customers, investors, partners and other key stakeholders.</h3> <h3>o   Bring judgement, discretion and confidence to high-pressure situations involving complex stakeholder dynamics, significant public scrutiny and reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Corporate Communications and Crisis Situations</h3> <h3>o   Develop communications strategies around major corporate events, business transformation, leadership change, restructuring, litigation, regulatory scrutiny, operational incidents, cyber incidents, activism and other significant or sensitive situations.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on crisis preparedness, scenario planning, crisis governance, response strategies, messaging and stakeholder engagement.</h3> <h3>o   Work closely with legal advisers, public affairs teams, risk specialists, management consultants and other advisers to ensure communications strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and stakeholder considerations.</h3> <h3>o   Provide leadership in fast-moving and high-pressure situations involving intense scrutiny, competing stakeholder expectations and significant reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Media, Reputation and Stakeholder Management</h3> <h3>o   Develop and execute media strategies involving German, European and international business, corporate and national media.</h3> <h3>o   Advise clients on reputation management, corporate positioning, proactive storytelling, executive positioning, crisis situations and complex issues.</h3> <h3>o   Help organisations build and protect trust with their most important stakeholders through clear, credible and consistent communications.</h3> <h3>o   Provide senior counsel on emerging reputational risks, stakeholder expectations and issues that may affect corporate licence to operate.</h3> <h3>Leadership</h3> <h3>o   Leading project teams to develop and deliver communications that have real impact for our clients </h3> <h3>o   Providing team direction and management whilst acting as the day to day point of contact for clients</h3> <h3>o   Challenging the status quo with new thinking, new product development, and new ways of working </h3> <p> </p> <h3>o   Responsible for leading client servicing, profitability, forecasting and budgeting </h3> <h3>o   Proactively contributing to and fostering the development of junior team members</h3> <h3> </h3> <p><strong>Skills and Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years’ experience of working in a senior role in corporate communications</li> <li>Prior experience in an advisory firm is a plus</li> <li>Demonstrable experience in managing project teams </li> <li>Excellent understanding of media, social media, and stakeholder environments</li> <li>Excellent ability to shape and deliver strategic advice to senior level clients </li> <li>Able to manage and mentor junior staff </li> <li>An engaging self-starter with high attention to detail </li> <li>Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills </li> <li>A collaborator who is able to foster good working relationships </li> <li>Time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload </li> <li>Comfortable taking the lead on driving performance and revenue </li> <li>Native level German required</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <p><strong>About Teneo</strong></p> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</p> <h3> </h3> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Consultant, Financial Advisory
description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>This is an excellent opportunity to join Teneo’s well established Financial Advisory team in Cardiff. You will work alongside experienced practitioners advising the management teams, lenders and shareholders of businesses that are underperforming and/or facing any financial challenges.</p> <p>The Cardiff team delivers complex, high-profile advisory and formal insolvency appointments, both locally and nationally and across a range of sectors. As a Senior Consultant, you will be exposed to a variety of projects in areas such as debt advisory, accelerated M&A, insolvency, performance improvement and financial forecasting.</p> <p>As a Senior Consultant, you will contribute to a range of projects including restructuring, insolvency, financial forecasting and transaction support. You will take responsibility for delivering key pieces of analysis, while continuing to develop your technical and client-facing skills.</p> <p>The position encourages growth and career development, with a clear path of progression. You will develop a broad skill set across financial modelling, report writing, and stakeholder management, as well as being involved with business development activities that will build your network.</p> <p>You will primarily be based in our Cardiff office, with opportunities to work at client sites and collaborate with colleagues across other locations.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong><em>Client Service</em></strong></p> <p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be a key team member working on financial restructuring and insolvency engagements. Core elements of your role from day one will include:</p> <ul> <li>Support leadership in creating an inclusive environment and proactively support the development of junior colleagues through coaching and feedback</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team culture</li> <li>Share knowledge and help improve ways of working</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Business Development</em></strong></p> <p>Business development is a critical aspect of the team’s day-to-day activities and you will be expected to pro-actively contribute in this area by:</p> <ul> <li>Contribute to proposals, pitches and market research</li> <li>Help identify opportunities to support existing and new clients</li> <li>Build your professional network within the restructuring market</li> <li>Supporting colleagues to run a key account team, including participating in, and organising, client events.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <p>In addition to your ambition to learn, develop and progress, we require an individual with the following core skills:</p> <ul> <li>ACA/ACCA/ICAS or equivalent qualification or experience (fully qualified)</li> <li>Experience in an advisory or auditing environment</li> <li>Client first outlook, with the ability to work quickly and establish effective working relationships with clients and colleagues</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial data</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to take ownership of work and deliver to deadlines</li> <li>Be a self-starter demonstrating initiative, with a strong track record of achievement</li> <li>Experience of writing internal and/or client deliverables.</li> <li>Experience of using standard IT packages such as Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in restructuring, insolvency or transaction-related work</li> <li>Financial modelling or forecasting experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What can we offer you?</strong></h2> <p>New joiners are supported by an induction programme.  As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including;</p> <ul> <li>Market-leading Salary</li> <li>28 days holiday</li> <li>Cash benefits allowance</li> <li>Discretionary Bonus Scheme</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>Extensive investment in personal development & learning</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave</li> <li>Life assurance</li> <li>Cycle to work schemes</li> <li>Regular social, cultural and charitable activities</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Teneo</strong></h2> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 1,600 employees located in 45+ offices around the world.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach. </p> <p>Our concept, “Technology, done differently”, embodies our belief that the way our customers consume and utilize technology should innovate at the same pace as the technology itself.</p> <p>Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.</p> <p>Techary have helped customers scale their operations globally, gain an advantage in financial markets, enabled mission-critical projects and, most importantly, implemented technology that delivers alpha-accelerating business transformation.</p></div><h3> </h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(71, 215, 172);">The Role</span></h3> <p> </p> <p>We are looking for a Talent Acquisition (TA) and People Operations Resourcer to join our fast-growing talent team. Techary has more than doubled in size since 2024, and with 50+ hires to make, you will be at the heart of our next stage of growth. You will be the first voice candidates hear from us, running screening calls, keeping Greenhouse in shape and sourcing for our harder-to-fill roles. You will also support people operations with administration tasks and learn our HR processes as you go.</p> <p>Success in this role comes from a full diary of calls every week, a high share of your shortlists reaching second interview, and close collaboration with hiring managers.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(71, 215, 172);">Key Responsibilities:</span></h3> <p> </p> want to meet, with a high share of shortlists reaching second interview</li> <li>Own the ATS for your roles, keeping Greenhouse accurate, candidates in the right stages and nobody left waiting</li> <li>Source candidates for harder-to-fill roles through LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels</li> <li>Work closely with hiring managers to book interviews and gather feedback quickly</li> <li>Keep candidates warm and informed at every stage of the process</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h4>People ops</h4> <p> </p> <p>Administration tasks, and the chance to learn our HR processes.</p> <ul> <li>Coordinate background checks and right-to-work verification</li> <li>Support onboarding and the employee lifecycle, including starters, leavers and internal changes</li> <li>Maintain employee records and HR documentation</li> <li>Prepare starter paperwork, including contracts and onboarding packs</li> <li>Support the HR team with day-to-day queries and general administration</li> <li>Help with wider people initiatives</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Essential Skills:</span></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>1–3 years’ recruitment experience, in-house or agency, ideally as a resourcer, sourcer or junior recruiter</li> <li>Confident screening candidates by phone and video, with the ability to build rapport and ask the right questions</li> <li>Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter to source and approach candidates</li> <li>Proven ability to manage a high volume of roles and candidates at once</li> <li>Organised and persistent, keeping candidates and roles moving</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Appetite for fast-paced growth</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Desirable Skills:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with an ATS or HRIS, ideally Greenhouse</li> <li>Experience sourcing for harder-to-fill roles</li> <li>Interest in building people operations experience alongside recruitment</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Why Techary</span></h3> <ul> <li><em>Growth that is real. </em>Revenue grew 84.7% in 2025, entirely organically, with no outside investors, and we remain profitable. We have been in The Sunday Times 100 two years running, climbing from 75th to 59th.</li> <li><em>A team that is scaling fast. </em>We have grown from 65 people in January 2024 to 150 today, and AI-powered tools are in use across every team.</li> <li><em>A great place to work. </em>Our engagement score is 8.2 out of 10 against a 6.9 national average, and 8.8 out of 10 would recommend us.</li> <li><em>Room to grow. </em>Monthly 1-2-1s with your manager, paid training and courses, and promotion from within whenever we can.
