title: Founding Product Manager
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The role Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager , you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped. You'll start by owning the brand-facing product , and your scope will grow fast from there. Your mission Shape the vision : bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing. Own the roadmap end to end : turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work. Run discovery : spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build. Ship with the team : work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly. Own launches and outcomes : drive rollout, watch the data, onboard the business teams, and judge your work by what it moved, not by what shipped. Build the product function itself : the rituals, the prioritization, the feedback loop from the field. What we're looking for 3 to 8 years in product , at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results. A generalist comfortable owning the messy middle: discovery one hour, scoping with engineers the next, writing the launch note after that. A bias for action : you make calls with incomplete data, ship, and iterate from what real users do. Customer obsession that shows up in your decisions. AI-native : you already build with tools like Claude, Cursor, v0 or Lovable to prototype, research, synthesize, and move the roadmap faster. Able to learn a lot, fast , in a deep and complex environment. Fluent French and professional English. Based in Paris, with the team at the office (up to 1 day remote per week). Bonus You've built in e-commerce, marketplaces, adtech, or AI/agent products , or you're genuinely fascinated by agentic commerce. A technical background (ex-software engineer or CS), so you can go deep with the team and direct AI tools effectively. Why join us Join a company in early breakout mode , already generating revenue with a clear edge. Be part of the next structural shift of the web : agentic commerce. Work directly with experienced, ambitious founders, and own the product from day one. Shape both the product and how we build it. title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome Nice to have Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes) Our culture and what we offer Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS. Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk. Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken. Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij. Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur. Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling. Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag. Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie. MEER WETEN? Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265. Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative
description: Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder , outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle . Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données. L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants. Les principales missions seront : Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions. Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés. Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates). Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration. Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations. Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation , avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire. Requirements Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou en Master 2 Informatique / Génie logiciel, préparant un diplôme de niveau Bac+5. Compétences techniques requises : Très bonne maîtrise du C++ et de la programmation orientée objet. Bonnes connaissances en conception et architecture logicielle. Maîtrise des algorithmes et des structures de données. Utilisation des outils de gestion de versions (Git/SVN). Connaissances en tests unitaires et qualité logicielle. Compétences appréciées : Framework Qt. QGIS et systèmes d'information géographique (SIG). Formats XML/XSD et bases de données GeoPackage/SQLite. Python. Outils et pratiques CI/CD. Intelligence Artificielle générative, LLM et prompt engineering. Analyse statique de code et conception de systèmes logiciels complexes. Qualités attendues : Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Autonomie, rigueur et curiosité technique. Capacité à proposer des solutions d'architecture et à prendre du recul sur des problématiques complexes. Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation. Information importante : le stage est réservé aux candidats de nationalité française. Une connaissance du domaine ferroviaire constitue un plus, mais n'est pas indispensable. Benefits Ce que nous offrons Un stage où vous verrez la transformation d'une société de l'intérieur, avec les moyens de la faire avancer. Un accès direct à la direction : rattachement au Vice-Président, plusieurs points par semaine, présence aux temps forts du CODIR, accès aux directeurs selon les sujets. De l'impact réel : vos POC seront déployés et utilisés par les équipes, pas rangés dans un rapport. Des moyens : un budget pour les outils et les POC dès le départ, élargi à mesure que les gains sont démontrés. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. title: Engineering Manager, Payments (all genders)
description: About us Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. The opportunity We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Payments engineering team within the E-commerce department. Payments takes, refunds and reconciles customer money across our white-label booking sites, subscriptions and in-person sales points, integrating with providers such as Adyen, PayPal and Checkout.com. Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable. You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it. What you will do: Lead several engineering teams, working through tech leads to set direction, priorities and delivery across them. Hire, coach and grow senior engineers and future leaders. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales. Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response. Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees. Partner with White Label, Orders, Finance and Data teams on checkout, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation and the payment ledger. Stay close to system design and architecture of our event-driven services (Ruby, Kafka), and set the technical bar across your teams. Raise the bar on ownership: documentation, runbooks, observability and on-call. Champion AI-assisted engineering across your teams: coding agents, AI code review, test generation and documentation. Measure which practices improve delivery and quality. Define safe guardrails for AI use where money moves: human review, test coverage and auditability stay non-negotiable. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: An experienced Engineering Manager who has led multiple teams or a team of senior engineers. Required: hands-on background in payments. You've built or run payment systems in production, including PSP integrations, refunds and chargebacks, reconciliation and recurring billing. You understand PCI DSS, SCA/3DS and what it takes to keep money flows auditable. An engineer at heart, with experience in event-driven distributed systems (Kafka or similar) and strong skills in a modern backend language. Ruby is a plus. You're comfortable working across teams and departments, and you communicate clearly in writing in English. You use AI tools in your own day-to-day work, not just in theory. You've helped a team adopt them, and you can tell real productivity gains from hype. Nice to have: card-present/terminal payments, SEPA direct debit, multi-currency, travel or marketplace experience. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.</em></strong></p> <p><strong><em>Role Summary </em></strong></p> <p>As Director, Editorial, you will provide strategic leadership for all editorial functions, setting editorial policies and ensuring the scientific scope, selection criteria, authorship profile, and integrity standards of our journals in support of PLOS's mission and sustainability. editorial workflows to deliver the editorial strategy, setting and delivering against clear targets for quality, cost of service, and contributor experience.</li> <li>Establish the metrics, reporting case handling, and holding day-to-day responsibility for arbitrating case decisions.</li> <li>Hold teams, vendors, and volunteers to clear performance standards, intervening early where quality or policy drift occurs.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Leadership and Culture</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a cohesive editorial leadership team with clear roles, shared goals and real accountability to each other and to peers across PLOS. Develop your leaders into strong people leaders through clear expectations, coaching and mentorship, and set and uphold performance and behavioral standards, addressing gaps promptly.</li> <li>Own hiring, retention and succession planning across editorial, building a bench capable of stepping into senior roles.</li> <li>Lead editorial teams through the change PLOS’s transformation requires, creating trust, clarity and engagement through visible, accessible leadership, and inspiring change rather than working around resistance.</li> <li>Act as a collaborative leader across PLOS. Own outcomes across functional boundaries, anticipate what peers driving shared priorities need from Editorial, surface issues early and directly with the colleagues involved, and escalate to the CSO when they’re unresolved.</li> <li>Leverage the scientific and professional expertise of editorial teams, internally and externally, in service of PLOS’s mission. Support their professional development and their visibility in their communities, so they champion PLOS’s transformative mission with a coherent voice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications & Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced scientific or medical qualifications, typically a PhD degree with  relevant research experience providing strong scientific credibility.</li> <li>Significant, progressively responsible publishing and leadership experience in STM publishing.</li> <li>Proven record of leading through layers of managers: building leadership teams, developing people leaders, and addressing performance issues directly.</li> <li>Demonstrated operational strength, including delivering measurable improvements in workflow performance, quality and cost, and owning budgets and vendor relationships.</li> <li>Experience leading teams through significant organizational change.Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures, disciplines, and organizational functions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of scholarly publishing markets, publishing policies, research integrity, and editorial models.</li> <li>Excellent communication, influencing and leadership skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around shared objectives. .</li> <li>Strong scientific credibility and the ability to build trusted relationships across the research community.</li> <li>Business problem solver – operates with curiosity to get to the root of the business problem to ensure the ultimate solution is grounded in organizational strategy and mission.</li> <li>Dedication to open science and transforming scholarly communication, with a genuine interest in engaging productively with the scientific community.</li> </ul> title: Head of Medical Coding, Germany
description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France. Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. Travel up to 40% (pilot hospitals, DGfM events), plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris. Team: you will recruit and lead our German coders (Kodierfachkräfte) as pilots scale. Your mission for 2027: make our German coding logic accurate and defensible enough that Medizincontrolling teams trust it, and be the person who proves it to them. What you will do Build our German coding logic with our AI engineers Turn the Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien (DKR), ICD-10-GM, OPS and aG-DRG logic into rules and specs our engineers can build on. Write annotation guidelines and build the German test sets our models are measured against. Review model errors every week, explain why they are wrong, and flag the edge cases that hurt accuracy. Settle the hard cases Be our reference on principal diagnosis, PCCL-relevant secondary diagnoses and OPS complex procedure codes (Komplexbehandlungen), using the SEG 4 and FoKA coding recommendations. Make every suggestion defensible in MD audits Pre-bill only (§17c KHG): every suggestion supported by documentation, with an audit trail. Help design our MD audit defense product (justifications for the MD, objections). Make pilots succeed Analyze each hospital's Medizincontrolling workflows before go-live. Run second-level review before our suggestions reach the hospital's coders. Present results to the head of Medizincontrolling and get their sign-off for go-live. Join sales meetings to show what our coding looks like up close. Build the German coding team Recruit and lead Kodierfachkräfte as pilots scale, with our team of 20 coding experts in France. Who you are Experience 5 to 10 years in Medizincontrolling or coding in German acute hospitals, including MD audits and objection procedures. A physician or nursing background, and a qualification as Kodierfachkraft or Medizincontroller:in. Experience at a coding, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor (for example ID Berlin, Tiplu, Damedic, Solventum) is a big plus. You have seen several hospitals: through a hospital group, consulting or a vendor. Mindset Expert and rigorous: you settle hard cases with references, not opinions. Curious about AI: you want to shape how it is used in coding, not just judge it. Clear communicator: you explain complex coding decisions to engineers and to heads of Medizincontrolling alike. Builder: you are comfortable starting from scratch in a startup. Languages Native German, fluent English (our working language with Paris). Hiring process Intro call (30 min). Case (60-90 min): two hard cases and one AI error to fix Working session with one of our AI engineers, including a third case live. Call with Paul (CEO) and Dr. Quentin Jarrion, then references. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. title: Expansion Strategy Lead (f/m/d)

Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. We are scaling fast and investing heavily in expanding our international footprint. Now, we are looking for an Expansion Lead to help us grow our presence across Europe. About the role: As Expansion Lead, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez , to drive Upvest's expansion into new markets and scale our presence in existing ones. You will own the end-to-end process of evaluating, planning and executing market entry - from market sizing and regulatory assessment to go-to-market execution and post-launch optimisation. You will run expansion as a cross-functional programme, working day to day with commercial, product and engineering, legal/compliance and operations, with direct exposure to senior leadership and to clients in each new market. This is a high-impact, highly visible role. What you’ll do: Own the international expansion strategy : Evaluate and prioritise new markets, then own the business case and roadmap for your countries, grounded in market sizing, competitive dynamics and regulatory feasibility Lead expansion programmes end-to-end: Own each market entry as a programme, from the first regulatory application through to launch and beyond. You are accountable for the overarching project and you keep the cross-functional work running smoothly by collaborating closely with legal/compliance, product and engineering, and operations every step of the way. Engage clients and prospects : Work with sales and partnerships to understand B2B client needs in your target market, validate demand, shape the proposition and support the onboarding of launch clients Build external relationships : Engage with regulators, partners and industry bodies to unlock and de-risk expansion opportunities Own cross-functional alignment : Align senior leadership and other departments on expansion priorities, timelines and resourcing Track and report on expansion progress : Develop and own KPIs/OKRs for expansion initiatives and report progress to leadership and the board Support fundraising and investor narrative : Contribute country and market insights to investor updates and board materials What you bring: Experience: 4+ years of experience in top-tier consulting, investment banking/private equity, or a high-growth scale-up, with direct exposure to market entry, GTM strategy or international expansion You have hands-on experience in launching a product or business in a new European market, ideally in fintech, payments or capital markets You have regulatory & financial literacy with a strong understanding of how regulation shapes market entry for a regulated financial business. You are comfortable engaging directly with regulators and compliance teams You have a strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes end-to-end, from scoping and sequencing to delivery across multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable in taking decisions and show true ownership You have demonstrated strong leadership and communication skills, effectively engaging internal and external stakeholders to drive change You are analytical & show commercial acumen: You are structured and numbers-driven, comfortable building business cases, market sizing and competitive analysis, and working with budgets and repeatable launch playbooks You enjoy building relationships with clients/partners and have experience working with them collaboratively to solve problems and achieve shared goals You are AI-native - you use AI tools proactively in your day-to-day work (synthesis, reporting, research) and are always looking for smarter, faster ways of working Location: Berlin-based. German and English are must-have. It’s great if you speak additional European languages relevant to Upvest's target expansion markets How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies. Our Values: Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions. Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection. Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together. Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others. Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot eindproduct. • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de grootste kansen liggen. • Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning. • Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in gebruik. • Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt. • Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe huisstijl. • Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en andere digitale kanalen. Wat willen we bereiken? Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent die: • Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert. • Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden gebruikt. • Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl. • Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet. Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen. Wat bieden wij? • Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief. • De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven. • Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten. • Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving. • Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale kanalen. • Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties en softwaredemo’s. Het eindresultaat Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren. Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar! Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare creatieve opleiding. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: • Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling. • Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of vergelijkbare software. • Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren. • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op. • Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker kan. • Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit te leggen. description: Service Designer Technology Transformation practice Anywhere in Germany, with travel availability Consultant/Senior Consultant About Us You want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? We are growing and are looking for people to join our team. You'll be part of an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment of 300.000 employees. Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready? Our solutions focus on the big-ticket value items on the C-Suite agenda, providing a deep link between business and IT to help you lead with influence beyond the back-office remit. For more information and details on the services we provide and the clients we serve, please visit or careers page. The role As a Service Designer at Infosys Consulting, you help our clients understand what their customers really need and turn those insights into services that work seamlessly across every touchpoint – digital and physical, frontstage and backstage. You make the entire customer journey smooth and enjoyable for users and successful for the business, driving satisfaction, retention and long-term growth. You bring a solid foundation in human-centered design, CX strategy and digital transformation, and you understand how service experiences connect to the client’s marketing, CRM, customer care and operations. title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. $266,000</li> <li>For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Toronto, Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h3>Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026.</h3> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Brand & Content Manager (m/w/d)
description: Overview PR kann heute mehr, als nur Sichtbarkeit verwalten. Bei getpress bauen wir an einer Marke, die zeigt, wie moderne Kommunikation für Europas ambitionierteste Unternehmen aussehen kann: strategisch, messbar, relevant und mit einem klaren Gefühl für Qualität. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere externe Kommunikation ownt und vor allem sichtbar macht. Jemanden, der*die starke Themen erkennt, gute Formate daraus entwickelt und sie auch selbst umsetzt – von LinkedIn und Website über Podcast, Blog und Whitepaper bis zu Speaker- und Event-Content. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content, Thought Leadership und externer Kommunikation. Dabei bist du strategisch genug, um Themen, Kanäle und Formate kritisch zu hinterfragen und hands-on genug, um auch selbst zu schreiben, zu produzieren, zu redigieren und Dinge live zu bringen. Du planst, steuerst und produzierst unseren Content für alle relevanten Kanäle und Formate – darunter LinkedIn, Website, Podcast, Whitepaper sowie Speaker-Auftritte und Events. Du schreibst, redigierst und schärfst Inhalte selbst – von LinkedIn-Posts und Website-Texten über Case Studies bis zu Podcast-Beschreibungen, Speaker-Profilen und Präsentationsinhalten. Visuals, Präsentationen und Social Assets gestaltest du selbst, einfache Foto- und Videoformate setzt du selbst um. Du sparrst mit unseren Corporate Creator*innen und dem C-Level zu Personal Brands, Thought Leadership, Tonalität und Formatideen. Du betreust unseren Podcast redaktionell von Gäste-Recherche und Briefings bis zur Veröffentlichung und begleitenden Kommunikation. Du sorgst dafür, dass getpress über alle Touchpoints hinweg konsistent, hochwertig und markant auftritt, in Sprache, Look, Dramaturgie und Qualität. Du beobachtest, wie unsere Inhalte performen, leitest daraus Learnings ab und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Formate, Kanäle und Botschaften weiterentwickeln. Du repräsentierst getpress auch nach außen – auf Events, in Netzwerken und an den Stellen, an denen Marke durch echten Kontakt entsteht. Wer du bist Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Content, Brand oder Kommunikation und hast in dieser Zeit selbst geschrieben und gestaltet. Gern bei einer Consumer Brand oder einem Magazin, Agenturerfahrung zählt genauso. Erfahrung in PR oder B2B musst du nicht mitbringen, die lernst du bei uns. Neugier auf Wirtschaftsthemen reicht. Außerdem macht dich folgendes aus: Ein feines Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und Qualität. Du erkennst schnell, wann ein Text, Auftritt oder Format wirklich sitzt. Du denkst strategisch mit, verlierst dich aber nicht in Konzepten. Dein Ziel ist Sichtbarkeit schaffen. Du hast LinkedIn, Organic Social und Personal Branding vollständig durchdrungen und weißt, wie man echte Markenwirkung erzeugt. Du arbeitest schnell und selbstorganisiert. Du priorisierst Themen und strukturierst Redaktionspläne eigenständig, ohne dass jemand hinterherlaufen muss. Ein gutes Auge für Design, Ästhetik und Brand Consistency, auch bei Slides, Social Assets, Website-Elementen und Event-Content. Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Canva und hast keine Berührungsängste mit Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Lightroom oder einfachen Editing-Workflows. Du bringst Foto- und Video-Basics mit oder hast Lust, dich in einfache Inhouse-Content-Produktion einzuarbeiten. Du arbeitest souverän mit KI-Tools und nutzt sie für bessere Recherche, Briefings, Struktur, Workflows, Varianten und Qualität, nicht als Abkürzung für generischen Content. Du hast eine eigene Meinung, gibst klares Feedback und bringst dich im Sparring mit Team und C-Level aktiv ein, statt Aufträge nur abzuarbeiten. Was dich erwartet Volle Ownership: Du bist bei uns die einzige Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest Brand und Content ohne Doppelstrukturen, mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Eine Rolle, in der du strategisch gestaltest und selbst umsetzt, und direkt siehst, welche Wirkung deine Arbeit hat. Ein Umfeld, in dem Kommunikation als echter Faktor für Sichtbarkeit, Vertrauen und Relevanz gesehen wird. Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Formate und Arbeitsweisen auszuprobieren – besonders an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content und AI. Ein Team, das ambitioniert, warm und beweglich ist und richtig Bock hat, Dinge voranzubringen. Du wirst regelmäßig vor Ort in Berlin gebraucht – für Abstimmungen, Content-Produktion, Events und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Stakeholdern. Gleichzeitig kannst du auch remote arbeiten. Wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, klarer Kommunikation und Vertrauen. Gehalt: 60.000–70.000 € brutto jährlich Wie gehts weiter? Wenn sich das nach deinem nächsten Schritt anfühlt, dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil, relevante Arbeitsproben oder ein Portfolio . Uns interessiert nicht nur, was du gemacht hast. Sondern vor allem auch, wie du denkst, wie du Qualität einschätzt und welches Gefühl du für starke Kommunikation mitbringst. You’ll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation. interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.</li> <li>Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> Java.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema</li> <li>Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications</li> <li>Experience with Git code management is highly desired.</li> </ul> <p>Other Requirements:</p> <ul> <li>Very strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Proven self-starter.</li> <li>Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.</li> <li>Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></p> That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! </p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. title: Senior SAP / ABAP Engineer

title: Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) Administrator - Infrastructure Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Atlanta, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>Washington DC, US</li> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until November 23, 2026.</strong></p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>We are seeking a DCIM Administrator to build and run our Data Center Infrastructure Management program.  This technical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running one of the world's largest and most important cloud networks. Cloudflare’s global network spans more than 330 cities, and is a key strategic asset that supports all of our customers and products.</p> <p>You are the operational backbone and workflow gatekeeper for all physical changes across our global network. Your meticulous work ensures every Move, Add, and Change (MAC) is executed only through a validated Nlyte work order, driving the highest level of data accuracy essential for supporting our edge and core security and performance services.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-paced environment where you will be expected to drive both project delivery and operational excellence through continuous improvement, standardization, and optimization. This isn't just about day to day operations; it's about building a scalable, performant, secure, and resilient infrastructure that plays a critical role in us building a better Internet.</p> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Assist with the successful deployment of CAPEX investments, ensuring our infrastructure scales ahead of demand.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners including Project Managers, Capacity Planning, Finance, and Security to deliver on ambitious group initiatives.</li> <li>Manage key third-party vendors and contractors, holding them accountable for performance and service level agreements (SLAs).</li> <li>Be a role model and champion for continuous improvement, standardization, optimization, and automation.</li> <li>Workflow Execution: Administer and manage the Nlyte Workflow/Work Order processes, including; issuing, tracking, and closing all physical MAC tickets.</li> <li>Enforce strict adherence to the defined process by global technicians.</li> <li>Data Integrity Champion: Perform daily data entry, manage automated asset discovery tools, and reconcile physical inventory against Nlyte records to guarantee 99.5%+ accuracy.</li> <li>Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM): Own the entire asset data chain from receiving (scanning/logging) through deployment and decommissioning.</li> <li>Model Library Management: Maintain the Nlyte Materials Catalog, ensuring all new hardware models have precise, validated resource profiles (power, cooling, rack elevations) to enable Analyst validation.</li> <li>Field Training & Support: Provide hands-on training and support for global technicians on using the Nlyte mobile app, scanning tools, and required workflow procedures.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <ul> <li>You are a DCIM expert, highly organized and efficient operator.   You have a track record of driving operational excellence through establishing and enforcing standard operating procedures and continuous improvement efforts. You are passionate about asset management and obsessed over data accuracy.  This role is for hands-on asset and infrastructure administrators who can rapidly learn, adapt, and apply learnings to enable fast and sustainable growth. You thrive in a hyper-growth environment and have an outstanding ability to get things done under pressure while maintaining optimism and grit.</li> <li>You are Transparent; you ensure every physical action is accurately logged and instantly visible to stakeholders globally.  You are Principled; you have an uncompromising commitment to data integrity and refuse to bypass established workflows.</li> <li>Education: <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Logistics, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience: <ul> <li>4+ years of hands-on experience in IT Asset Management or DCIM administration (Nlyte experience is a strong advantage).</li> <li>Direct experience administering a workflow or change management system, with a focus on discipline and process enforcement in a multi-site environment.</li> <li>Experience with change management in ERP and asset management transformation efforts.</li> <li>Experience operating in a high-velocity environment involving geographic dispersed Data Centers across various time zones.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Technical Competencies: <ul> <li>High proficiency in physical inventory control, including barcode/RFID systems.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with data center infrastructure, including server hardware, network hardware, rack elevation/density, and power distribution</li> <li>Knowledge of structured cabling, and cabling standards.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) or basic SQL.</li> <li>Expert in workflow Management (MAC Process): Proven experience managing a high-volume Move, Add, Change queue.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Soft Skills: <ul> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.</li> <li>Meticulous Attention to Detail: A "Zero-Defect" mindset regarding data entry.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Documentation & SOP Creation: Experience writing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for remote hands technicians.</li> <li>Remote Training Ability: Experience training or guiding remote teams.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $98,000 - $135,000</li> <li>For Remote - Washington and Washington (Kirkland) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $120,000 - $165,000</li> <li>For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $120,000 - $165,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. title: IT Operations Specialist I
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>As an IT Operations Specialist I, you will provide essential onsite IT support and help maintain daily workplace technology at our corporate office. Working in a heavy macOS and Google Workspace environment with additional support for Windows and Linux endpoints, you will deliver hands-on technical assistance, maintain office AV systems, and manage end-to-end hire-to-retire lifecycle processes. In this role, you will also leverage our internal AI technology tools to optimize support workflows and documentation. You will collaborate closely with broader IT teams, the IT Service Desk, HR, Places & Office, and Security teams to ensure a seamless technical experience for all employees.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary onsite technical support resource, managing employee walk-ups, support tickets, and hardware troubleshooting across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.</li> <li>Work closely with broader IT engineering and operations teams to execute infrastructure updates, enforce system policies, and resolve escalated technical issues.</li> <li>Manage complete hire-to-retire IT operations, including hardware provisioning, account setup, leading IT orientation for new hires, offboarding asset recovery, and access revoking.</li> <li>Administer day-to-day user accounts, permissions, and group access within Google Workspace and connected corporate SaaS tools.</li> <li>Manage physical IT asset lifecycle operations, including inventory tracking, hardware check-in/check-out, stock audits, and secure device disposal.</li> <li>Utilize internal AI technology tools to summarize support incidents, speed up ticket resolution, and draft self-service Knowledge Base (KB) documentation for end users.</li> <li>Support office conference room technology (Google Meet Hardware and Zoom Rooms) and provide live technical setup for corporate town halls and department events.</li> <li>Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation (evenings and weekends) to address critical after-hours P1/P2 incidents, system outages, and urgent executive support needs.</li> </ul> <p>This is an in-office/onsite position. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.</li> <li>Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).</li> <li>Availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.</li> <li>Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.</li> <li>Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with macOS endpoint management using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms like Jamf Pro or Kandji.</li> <li>Experience using corporate ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.</li> <li>Relevant technical certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA A+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United title: Senior GCC Government Relations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid)</strong></p> <p><strong>Public Policy at Cloudflare</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is one of the most dynamic and innovative companies providing services on the Internet. Regulation of the Internet is exploding -- across a number of subject areas and jurisdictions -- at a rate previously unseen in the history of the Internet. We’re looking for a new team member who can help foster and promote our corporate philosophy and approach, in which the security and privacy of our customers are paramount. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do  </strong></p> <ul> <li>We are looking for an exceptionally talented and energetic person to join our Public Policy </li> <li>Team, based in Bengaluru at our Global Capability Centre. With a focus on India we’re looking for someone who can foster our unique corporate philosophy, develop public policy solutions to challenging technology issues and be comfortable giving front line support on issues requiring engagement. </li> <li>You will work on some of the most complicated and rapidly evolving policy issues, such as cybersecurity, privacy, AI , and copyright issues. You will also work with leadership on advancing the reputation and standing of the Global Capability Centre. The perfect candidate is also someone with a strong background in government affairs in India (both State and Central), particularly in the tech space. You’ll help us engage with external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the strategic business objectives of Cloudflare in India. </li> <li>This person has a deep understanding of technology as well as regulatory environments. The ideal candidate can seamlessly go from a technical conversation with engineers to a high-level discussion with policymakers and government officials regarding where Cloudflare fits in the Internet stack. This person should be experienced in engaging and representing the company in key industry forums, engaging with relevant regulatory bodies and industry associations.</li> <li>Because of the scope, complexity, and diversity of the company’s work, our Public Policy team members must be flexible, talented and able to work collaboratively across multi-functional teams to find and present policy solutions, to carry the Cloudflare narrative, and promote the public policy brand externally. </li> <li>This role is ideal for an experienced and energetic team player who is proactive, a strategic thinker, a skilled communicator and above all else, someone who has a thirst for knowledge and continued growth, all while working as part of a great team.    </li> <li>This role has non-standard working hours.</li> <li>This role will report to the APJC Head of Public Policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>This role will lead Cloudflare’s government advocacy for the Global Capability Centre in India and support the public policy team’s India policy goals when needed. Specific areas of responsibility include:</li> <li>Monitor policy conversations, legislative developments and government requests in India, and evaluate how they could impact Cloudflare.</li> <li>Develop and implement the GCC’s government engagement strategy. </li> <li>Represent the company in industry forums, engage with relevant stakeholders including government officials, regulatory bodies and industry associations at the central and the state level.</li> <li>Engage with trade associations, industry partners, non-profit groups and others to educate stakeholders on Cloudflare’s public policy positions.</li> <li>Develop talking points, policy narratives and presentation materials for use at external events and meetings and for other communication purposes (company blog, position papers, etc.).</li> <li>Coordinate with cross-functional teams to provide strategic advice ensuring alignment with business goals and objectives of the GCC.</li> <li>Provide timely updates to colleagues from the Cloudflare Public Policy, Legal, Trust & Safety Teams and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.</li> <li>8+ years of related experience in government affairs, trade associations, government and law enforcement. </li> <li>Expertise with the India and Karnataka policy and legal system, including government and civil society stakeholders, laws and regulations related to technology companies. </li> <li>Fluency in English.</li> <li>Strong communications (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Team player, with a sense of humor.</li> <li>Detail oriented, well organized and a sense of initiative.</li> <li>An ambitious mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate / call out issues when needed.</li> <li>Flexibility and willingness to jump into issues and regions that are not as familiar. </li> <li>Willingness to travel to New Delhi on an occasional basis and occasionally outside the region.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Government Affairs & Public Policy within the Tech sector. </li> <li>Strong knowledge of GCC’s or multinational tech companies in India.</li> <li>Fluency in Hindi and/or Kannada.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

This underscores our commitment to innovation, growth, and fostering a collaborative culture. Since 1994, we've delivered ground-breaking campaigns for the world's most innovative tech companies, and we are always seeking new talent to join our team of Futurists.</p> <p class="x_elementToProof"><span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW259761513 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW259761513 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW259761513 BCX0">WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) </span></span></span><span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW259761513 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW259761513 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW259761513 BCX0">is </span><span class="NormalTextRun ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW259761513 BCX0">the</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW259761513 BCX0"> trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
