Wir vertrauen Dir und unterstützen Dich dabei, Deinen Arbeitstag optimal zu gestalten.</p> <p><strong>Unsere Kultur begeistert.</strong> Wir sind innovativ und streben immer nach mehr – für uns selbst, füreinander und für unsere Kunden. Wir gewinnen gemeinsam und halten uns gegenseitig den Rücken frei.</p> <p><strong>Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Kunden- & Teammanagement: </strong>Du bist das Bindeglied, hältst Projekte am Laufen, managst die täglichen Aktivitäten und baust Beziehungen zu deinen Kunden, den Medien und Kollegen auf.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Medienarbeit: </strong>Du liebst Nachrichten und aktuelle Trends? Perfekt! Du identifizierst Chancen, baust Beziehungen zu Journalist:innen auf und hilfst uns, die besten Stories zu platzieren. Du erstellst überzeugenden Content – von Pressemitteilungen bis Social Media.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Projektmanagement:</strong> Vom Organisieren von Events bis hin zu umfassenden Recherchen – Du bringst Dinge ins Rollen, antizipierst Herausforderungen und findest kreative Lösungen.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>New Business Chancen: </strong>Du hilfst uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkennen, analysierst den Wettbewerb und trägst zu spannenden Pitches bei, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bringst Du mit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Marketing, Kommunikation, Geisteswissenschaften o.ä.) sowie idealerweise erste Praktika in der PR auf Agentur- oder Unternehmensseite.</li> <li>Technologie und digitale Trends begeistern Dich und Du hast ein Gespür für News und Innovationen.</li> <li>Du liebst kreatives Denken und hast ein ausgeprägtes Storytelling-Talent.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf deutscher wie englischer Sprache und hast eine ziel- und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.</li> <li>Als Teamplayer hast Du Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und proaktiv mitzugestalten.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bieten wir:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Eine Agentur, die Tech-Kommunikation neu definiert und den Zeitgeist der Branche prägt</li> <li>Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit branchenführendem Intelligent Working-Ansatz und Vertrauenskultur</li> <li>Ein dynamisches und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Du Dich entwickeln und Dein volles Potenzial ausschöpfen kannst</li> <li>Ein Team, das Unterschiede schätzt, Besonderheiten feiert und gemeinsam Erfolge erreicht</li> <li>Persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch eine Vielzahl an Schulungen, LinkedIn Learning und maßgeschneiderte Fortbildungen</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lust, uns kennenzulernen und Teil unseres Teams zu werden?</strong></p> <p>Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung inklusive Deines möglichen Eintrittsdatums und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung an.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Axicom:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Axicom, a Burson Group company, to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Axicom, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance (Vulnerable Customers)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐<br><br></strong>Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service. We're looking for someone with experience specifically in the Vulnerable Customer domain.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better. Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on. Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production. Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback. Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers. What you bring At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails. Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes. Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS. Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own. Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan. Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you. A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must. You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense. Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus. title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change first, we'd like to hear from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager. In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s. Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers. Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Wat bieden wij? Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering; Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage; Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist; Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen; Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage; Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken; Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage; Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt. Over de organisatie Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)! title: Senior Business Security Consultant
description: About Northwave Defending the digital frontier is our mission. At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium. Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey. By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact. Your Mission As a Senior Business Security Consultant , you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value. Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization. Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives. As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs. In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole. What You Enjoy Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies. Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps. Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions. Providing guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to colleagues within project teams while actively promoting knowledge sharing across the organization. Facilitating workshops, executive presentations, and strategic decision-making processes at management and board level. Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities. Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients. Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice. What you can expect from us First things first: You will get 30 days' holiday per year and we contribute a minimum of 20% to your company pension plan (bAV). You can organise your own working hours in consultation with your colleagues and customers. A mobility budget , also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances. What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave. It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities , such as a trip to the theme park. You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone . We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-) what else... No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles? Consulting Expertise: You bring extensive experience in cybersecurity and/or management consulting and have successfully managed complex transformation and advisory projects in client-facing environments. Trusted Advisor Mindset: You are comfortable challenging and advising executive stakeholders, earning credibility quickly and acting as a trusted advisor throughout strategic decision-making processes. Commercial Awareness: You combine a strong consulting mindset with commercial acumen, helping to identify opportunities, shape client engagements, and support business growth initiatives. Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English is required. Interested? If you are still not sure, see what Working at Northwave looks like. And when you are ready to come on board, we are looking forward to your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Business Performance Analyst (all genders)
description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich. Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken. Deine Mission bei Foodji Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams. Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen. Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick. Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Czech Republic & Slovakia
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>Munich, Germany or Amsterdam, Netherlands or London, United Kingdom</strong></p> <div><strong>About the Department</strong></div> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. Identify and progress cross sell opportunities to maximise revenue goals. Selling new products and generating additional sales revenue through effective sales outreach activity.</p> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement from administrative through executive levels within network operations, development and technical infrastructure teams.<br><br><strong>Regional Focus:</strong> Czech Republic & Slovakia<br><br><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong><br> <ul> <li>Passionate about sales: You have a hunger to win and a desire to exceed your targets and reap the rewards.</li> <li>Strong customer service skills: You put the client first and you do what you say you’ll do.</li> <li>Personable, resilient and a culture champion: A friendly, warm and professional demeanour will get you far. You celebrate the ups and bounce back quickly from your missteps.</li> <li>Cool and calm under pressure: The ability to effectively manage competing priorities and solve multiple problems quickly is in your DNA.</li> </ul> <strong>Main Responsibilities:</strong><br> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.</li> <li>Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within Czech Republic & Slovakia.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.</li> <li>Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Effectively scale the territory with partners</li> <li>Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> <li>Direct B2B sales experience, adept at new business acquisition and account management.</li> <li>Experience selling a technical, cloud-based product or service</li> <li>Working knowledge of the cloud infrastructure and security space</li> <li>Solid understanding of computer networking and Internet functioning.</li> <li>Keenness for learning technical concepts/terms. Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS is advantageous.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills (both verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.</li> <li>Willingness to travel frequently to visit customers and prospects</li> <li>Fluency in English and Czech a must</li> </ul> <strong>Knowledge/Experience:</strong><br> <ul> <li>8+ years of B2B selling experience and selling DevSecOps, Enterprise Software or SaaS (network security preferred) or Hardware solutions and services to Enterprise customers</li> <li>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships with enterprise accounts from Czech Republic & Slovakia</li> <li>New Business & Expansion</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles</li> <li>Fast paced environment</li> <li>Enterprise IT/Cyber Security background</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">For Germany or Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €169,000 - €232,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gend

title: Accountmanager Bouw - Waterdichting
description: Nederland Een commerciële buitendienstfunctie waarin jij zelf een markt opbouwt, met de slagkracht van een internationale producent achter je. Bij IKO krijg je de vrijheid om jouw eigen commerciële koers te bepalen, hoogwaardige technische oplossingen te verkopen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan groei. Een zelfstandige baan voor een ondernemende accountmanager die kansen ziet én benut! Maak het verschil als Accountmanager Bouw – Waterdichting in Nederland Dankzij jouw commerciële daadkracht groeit IKO's positie in de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting. Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig nieuwe klantrelaties en brengt hoogwaardige oplossingen onder de aandacht bij onder andere aannemers, voorschrijvers, woningcorporaties en vastgoedbeheerders. Denk aan waterdichtingstoepassingen voor balkons, galerijen, parkeerdaken en -dekken, dakdetails en brugdekken. Je onderzoekt de markt, signaleert bouw- en renovatieprojecten en weet op het juiste moment de juiste gesprekspartners te bereiken. Daarbij verkoop je op technische meerwaarde en bouw je aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Je start met een kleine bestaande klantenportefeuille en richt je aanvankelijk op new business om jouw portefeuille verder uit te breiden. Je bent regelmatig onderweg naar klanten en projecten, werkt verder regelmatig vanuit huis en bent uiteraard welkom op het kantoor in Klundert. Je schakelt met jouw Nederlandse en Belgische salescollega's en technische specialisten. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: zelfstandig ontwikkelen van de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting; actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten, waaronder aannemers, voorschrijvers en andere potentiële opdrachtgevers; signaleren en opvolgen van commerciële kansen binnen bouw-, renovatie- en infrastructurele projecten; adviseren over hoogwaardige technische oplossingen en opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; ontwikkelen van een sterke salespipeline en zorgvuldig vastleggen van commerciële activiteiten in Salesforce (CRM). Als gedreven Accountmanager Bouw – Waterdichting kun jij rekenen op: Een zelfstandige commerciële functie bij een internationaal familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief worden gewaardeerd. IKO biedt je de ruimte om jouw markt te ontwikkelen, ondersteund door ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Tijdens jouw inwerkperiode leer je bovendien van het Belgische salesteam. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop: een competitief salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; een bonusregeling tot 10% van jouw jaarsalaris; 25 vakantiedagen + 12 ATV dagen; een auto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak; een pensioenregeling volgens Hibin; veel vrijheid om jouw eigen agenda en commerciële activiteiten te organiseren; de mogelijkheid om regelmatig vanuit huis te werken; toegang tot kennis en expertise binnen een internationale organisatie. Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Jij krijgt energie van het openen van deuren en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt gestructureerd en houdt koers tijdens langdurige verkooptrajecten. Met jouw nieuwsgierigheid en technische interesse achterhaal je de werkelijke klantbehoefte. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners, van uitvoerende aannemers tot technisch adviseurs, en weet hen met inhoudelijke argumenten te overtuigen. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau; minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar commerciële buitendienstervaring, bij voorkeur als accountmanager of technisch-commercieel adviseur; aantoonbare ervaring met directe verkoop aan aannemers en actieve acquisitie; technische affiniteit, bij voorkeur met bouwproducten, waterdichting, coatings of infrastructurele toepassingen; ervaring met CRM-systemen, bij voorkeur Salesforce, en goede kennis van Excel. Jouw werkgebied Jouw werkgebied beslaat heel Nederland, met een focusgebied in de driehoek Rotterdam, Utrecht en Amsterdam. Je werkt veel vanuit huis en bezoekt zelfstandig klanten, prospects en projecten. Je deelt jouw agenda grotendeels zelf in en stemt afspraken af op de commerciële kansen in jouw regio. Regelmatig heb je contact met collega's op de Nederlandse vestiging in Klundert. Voor trainingen en salesmeetings bezoek je incidenteel het Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen. Werken bij IKO IKO is een internationaal familiebedrijf en producent van hoogwaardige dakbedekkings-, isolatie- en waterdichtingsoplossingen. Ze zijn marktleider en staan voor kwaliteit. Met circa 4.000 medewerkers wereldwijd levert de organisatie technische producten voor uiteenlopende bouw- en infrastructuurprojecten. Binnen de productgroep IKO flexia ligt de focus op vloeibare waterdichting voor specialistische toepassingen, binnen dit segment zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe collega. De organisatie is actief in meer dan 40 landen en heeft haar Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen. IKO werd in 1951 opgericht in Canada en is nog altijd een echt familiebedrijf. De cultuur is nuchter, lean en hands-on: een ‘doe’-mentaliteit met veel vrijheid, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en korte lijnen. Eén klik verwijderd van jouw nieuwe baan Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van deze vacature en heb je de checklist afgevinkt? Wacht dan niet te lang, want zodra wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden sluiten we de vacature. Solliciteren doe je simpel en snel via onze solliciteer-button. title: Chargé.e de communication marketing
description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. Entreprise lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions En lien direct avec le responsable marketing et communication, vous participerez à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de communication de l'entreprise afin de renforcer sa notoriété, valoriser son offre et engager ses différentes cibles (B2B, secteurs privé et public). Création de contenus audiovisuels Concevoir, tourner et monter des vidéos : présentations produit, témoignages clients, interviews d'experts, formats courts pour les réseaux sociaux, Réaliser des visuels et supports graphiques en cohérence avec la charte de l'entreprise, Participer à la captation de contenus lors d'événements, de webinaires ou de salons, Adapter les contenus aux différents canaux (sous-titrage, déclinaisons de formats, miniatures). Rédaction & production de contenus Rédiger des contenus variés : articles de blog, actualités, newsletters, cas clients, communiqués de presse, Adapter le ton et le niveau de langage aux cibles (décideurs, techniciens, collectivités, partenaires), Contribuer à la création de supports marketing : plaquettes, présentations, fiches produit, emailings. Animation des réseaux sociaux Participation au développement des comptes de l'entreprise (LinkedIn et YouTube), Rédiger et programmer les publications, en adaptant le ton et le format à chaque plateforme, Animer la communauté : veille, interactions, relais des actualités de l'entreprise et de ses collaborateurs, Proposer des formats innovants pour accroître l'engagement (carrousels, vidéos courtes, témoignages, séries thématiques). Gestion du site web (WordPress) Mettre en ligne et mettre à jour les contenus sur le site : pages, articles, actualités, visuels, vidéos, Veiller à la cohérence éditoriale et graphique ainsi qu'à la qualité des contenus publiés, Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de base (SEO, poids des images, accessibilité, liens). Événementiel & communication corporate Participer à l'organisation et à la promotion des événements (salons, webinaires, conférences), Contribuer à la communication interne et à la valorisation de la marque employeur, Assurer une veille sur les tendances de communication et les actions des concurrents. Suivi de performance & amélioration continue Suivre les indicateurs clés (engagement, audience, trafic, taux d'ouverture…) via des outils type LinkedIn Analytics, GA4, outils d'emailing, Réaliser des reportings réguliers et proposer des axes d'optimisation, Participer à l'élaboration et au suivi du calendrier éditorial. Vos compétences Vous préparez une formation en communication, marketing, audiovisuel, journalisme ou équivalent (Bac+4 / Bac+5) et souhaitez développer vos compétences sur l'ensemble des leviers de la communication et du marketing. Vous avez une plume claire et efficace, un bon sens visuel et aimez raconter des histoires, à l'écrit comme en vidéo. Vous savez adapter un message à une cible et à un canal, et transformer un sujet technique en contenu accessible et engageant. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les réseaux sociaux et avez déjà manipulé des outils de montage vidéo et de création graphique. Vous êtes rigoureux·se, organisé·e, créatif·ve, curieux·se, et appréciez le travail en équipe : prendre du feedback, itérer rapidement et respecter des délais. Un plus : compétences en tournage (cadrage, lumière, son), portfolio de réalisations (vidéos, visuels, publications), projets personnels en lien avec la communication, première expérience en communication B2B ou dans le secteur de la transition énergétique. Compétences clés Excellente qualité rédactionnelle : orthographe, grammaire, style clair, capacité à vulgariser et à adapter son ton, Maîtrise du montage vidéo (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve ou équivalent), Compétences audiovisuelles appréciées : tournage, prise de son, vidéo mobile, Bonne connaissance des réseaux sociaux, de leurs codes et de leurs formats, Connaissance de WordPress et des bases du SEO, Aisance avec les outils de création graphique (Canva, suite Adobe…) et Microsoft Office, Maîtrise des outils IA appliqués à la création de contenus, Rigueur et organisation : gestion de plusieurs projets en parallèle, respect des délais, relecture systématique, Esprit d'équipe : intégrer les retours, travailler avec les équipes marketing, commerciales et experts métiers, Autonomie progressive et force de proposition : capacité à proposer des idées, des formats et des angles de communication. Avantages Localisation : Quartier de la Part-Dieu, au cœur de Lyon, Un environnement de travail dynamique, Gratification : selon année d'étude, Remboursement à 50 % des transports en commun, Tickets restaurant de 10 € par jour, Télétravail partiel possible après une période d'intégration. Informations complémentaires Type de contrat : Stage de 6 mois (offre non ouverte à l'alternance) Date de début : dès que possible Pour candidater, merci d'envoyer votre CV ainsi qu'une courte lettre de motivation. Démarquez-vous en partageant un book ou des exemples de réalisations ! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location</strong>: Switzerland (remote) </p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>RVP Sales </p> <p><strong>Travel: </strong>within DACH </p> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>native/C2 level French and English </p> <p>  </p> <p><strong>A Quick Snapshot…..</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, driving both new business acquisition and the expansion of existing enterprise accounts across key strategic industries in the DACH region. You will build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, understand complex business challenges, and position Conga's enterprise-wide solutions to deliver measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Working closely with Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners, and clients, you will manage the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through close. This role is focused on 40% new business generation and 60% growth within existing customers.</p> <p><strong>Why it's a big deal…</strong></p> <p>You'll have the opportunity to sell high-impact, mission-critical transformation initiatives that create substantial value for enterprise organizations. You will develop and execute territory, account, and opportunity plans, engage senior decision-makers, and lead complex sales cycles to drive predictable revenue growth within your assigned region.</p> <p><strong>Are you the person we are looking for?</strong></p> <p><strong>Proven Track Record</strong></p> <p>You have at least 20 years of successful B2B enterprise technology sales experience within the SaaS industry and a strong track record of success in DACH.</p> <ul> <li>Acts as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, aligning business challenges with measurable commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Consistently exceeds quota within complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments.</li> <li>Builds and leverages executive, customer, partner, and ecosystem relationships to create, accelerate, and expand strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Demonstrates strong knowledge of AI, automation, and revenue management trends, effectively translating these into customer value and business outcomes.</li> <li>Drives predictable revenue growth through strategic account planning, executive engagement, and value-based selling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Hunter Mentality</strong></p> <p>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for identifying, pursuing, and winning new business opportunities. Through persistence, strategic thinking, and strong commercial acumen, you consistently create pipeline and close high-value enterprise deals.</p> <p><strong>Solution Selling</strong></p> <p>You take a consultative approach to understanding customer challenges, business priorities, and strategic objectives. You effectively position Conga's solutions and services, clearly articulating value and demonstrating how they help customers achieve their desired outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Drive</strong></p> <p>You proactively leverage available resources and take ownership of results. You are highly motivated, resilient, and committed to achieving success regardless of the challenges encountered along the way.</p> <p><strong>Communication</strong></p> <p>You can articulate complex technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You possess excellent listening, presentation, and negotiation skills, enabling you to address objections, build credibility, and influence stakeholders at every level.</p> <p><strong>Growth Mindset</strong></p> <p>You embrace change and continuously adapt to evolving market conditions, customer priorities, and competitive dynamics. You are innovative in your approach and seek new ways to create value for customers and the business.</p> <p><strong>Collaboration</strong></p> <p>You work effectively across cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partners to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You have the leadership presence and influence to align stakeholders, mobilize resources, and drive successful business results.</p> <p><strong>What will give you an edge...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with strong knowledge of CPQ, CLM, revenue optimization, document generation, and e-signature products.</li> <li>Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research is considered a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong> </p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong> </p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. </p> <p><strong>Don’t meet every requirement for the role?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong> </p> <p>Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  </p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.</p> </div> </section> </div> <section class="job-apply print-hidden"></section> <p><strong>Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement </strong></p> <p>The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (<a href="https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement">https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement</a>). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Change the way the world travels Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step. Team mission Our Product Design team shapes how millions of travelers find, book, and enjoy activities, and how our supplier partners run their business on GetYourGuide. We combine strategic thinking, customer insight, and a high craft bar to make every step of the journey clear, trustworthy, and a little bit delightful. Within the team, the Ontrip group designs the support and communication experiences that connect travelers, suppliers, and customer care before, during, and after a trip. It's a mobile-first, high-stakes space with many stakeholders and plenty of open questions. As Staff Product Designer, you'll set the direction for these channels, see the in-flight redesign and brand refresh through to a polished result, and raise the design quality and standards for the whole group. Your mission Lead the design strategy and experience for the channels that connect travelers, suppliers, and customer care, from vision through shipped product. Land the in-flight communication redesign and the brand refresh across Ontrip, so the experience feels cohesive and unmistakably GetYourGuide. Shape the long-term vision for on-trip and manage design dependencies across adjacent groups. Make sense of ambiguous problems, and use future thinking to turn them into bold directions teams can actually build. Partner with product, engineering, research, and operations to align a wide set of stakeholders around clear decisions. Present your work and rationale in executive-level reviews, and bring senior leaders along with you. Design mobile-first for travelers but think beyond traditional surfaces and processes as supplier communication can involve different channels Raise the craft bar for the group through critique, clear standards, and mentoring other designers. Work in the open with AI tools, using them to explore faster, prototype sooner, and improve and raise the quality of what ships. Your toolkit Extensive experience designing complex, mobile-first products, with a portfolio that shows both strategic thinking and polished UI craft. Experience owning design across multiple teams or a product area A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-cutting problems and turning them into direction that teams can build against. Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build alignment across many teams and explain your rationale clearly to executives. Experience setting and raising the quality bar for a design team through critique, mentoring, and leading by example. Deep understanding of experimentation. You work with research and analytics to validate hypotheses. Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows. You use AI tools consistently and effectively in your work and to drive innovation in UX, such as Claude and Figma Make, with concrete examples of how AI has improved your efficiency, quality, or impact. How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them Monthly transportation and fitness budget Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities Language reimbursement program Health and wellness benefits And more… How to apply Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change first, we'd like to hear from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
