Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean. Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs. Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules. Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements. Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap. Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes. Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate teams. Workflow Analysis: Understand customer processes from initial site assessment through permitting, identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, or connect existing workflows. Technical Requirements Translation: Convert customer workflows and operational needs into concrete software requirements, rules, and parameters for development teams. Implementation & Customer Success: Coordinate product rollouts, support customers through implementation and productive use, and maintain engagement after launch. Requirements : The ideal candidate combines formal architectural training with strong communication, analytical, and customer-facing skills. You should understand how buildings are designed and planned, be comfortable discussing technical concepts with software engineers, and have the ability to translate complex customer workflows into practical software requirements. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture. Practical experience in architectural design, building planning, or permitting processes is highly desirable. Fluency in English and German is required, with Korean language proficiency considered a strong advantage. Confidence presenting products and communicating with international customers in multiple languages. Basic understanding of artificial intelligence, algorithms, and programming concepts. Ability to understand rule-based systems, interpret simple scripts or logical structures, and communicate effectively with technical development teams. Familiarity with BIM software such as Revit or Archicad is advantageous. Experience with parametric design tools such as Grasshopper is a plus. Strong understanding of architectural planning workflows and customer decision-making processes. Ability to analyze operational processes, identify inefficiencies, and translate findings into clear software requirements. Previous experience in key account management, consulting, or customer-facing project management is highly valued. A forward-deployed mindset, with the ability to work directly with customers, take ownership of their success, and act as a bridge between customer teams and engineers. Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a structured approach to testing and documentation. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer visits and on-site collaboration. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere worldwide. Permanent employment contract. Flexible working hours. Opportunity to work at the intersection of architecture, technology, and software innovation. Direct interaction with international customers, including major retailers and real estate developers. Opportunity to influence product development through direct customer feedback and architectural expertise. Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of architects, engineers, and software developers. Short decision-making processes within a small, international team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team. What the team does DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Your Role We are looking for a Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a key role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making. You will build scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and contribute to efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will help develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and apply best practices that empower data-driven decision-making. This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you help build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will take real ownership of the pipelines you build, with room to propose solutions and the support to grow your scope. What will keep you challenged? Build, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability Implement data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights Evaluate and propose new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure What you bring 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a similar data-related role (e.g., software or analytics engineering with a strong data focus) Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field Solid proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with hands-on experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL) Experience with at least one cloud data platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt) Good understanding of data modelling principles and of data governance, security, and compliance best practices FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development, with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it. Familiarity with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production is a plus. Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one. This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees. You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way. You'll be responsible for Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees. Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks. Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks. Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks. Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting. Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence. Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring. Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards. Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity. We are looking for a person who has Experience and background A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience. Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework. Meaningful experience in fintech or banking. Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees. Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure. Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives. Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense. title: Business Development Representative - Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Seoul, South Korea</p> <p><strong>This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week required to be in the Seoul office.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:</p> <ul> <li>Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions</li> <li>Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience</li> <li>Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Languages required: Korean (native speaker) and English (working fluency)</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for being the “face of Cloudflare” and account resource for our prospects and customers. You will support Account Executives's book of business as well as your own to open doors and identify opportunities.</p> <p>This role requires you to have a basic understanding of Cloudflare’s suite of products to be able to provide a range of recommendations and solutions to our customers. You will be leveraging tools such as Salesforce, Google Sheets, internal applications, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo among others to map key customers to the right product suite for them. This is a great role if you are interested in a career path towards becoming a BDR management, Mid-Market Account Executive, Expansion Account Manager or Customer Success Manager. </p> <p><strong>Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities</li> <li>Identify target accounts with strategic timing and strong use cases through qualitative and data driven approach</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)</li> <li>Help lead BDR team-wide campaigns or initiatives (we’re a collaborative group)</li> <li>Write emails and letters you’d love to open; make calls you’d love to receive; ask compelling questions</li> <li>Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC</li> <li>Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes</li> <li>Experience in Google Sheets, Outreach, Salesloft, SFDC reporting, and data analysis is a great plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills</li> <li>Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity</li> <li>Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously</li> <li>Fluent in Korean (verbal & written)</li> <li>Minimum 1 year of experience in BDR or in a similar capacity in technology industry is preferred, specifically in SaaS will be a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Social Media & Campaign Manager
description: Über Cell Labs Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Content-Produktion: Du produzierst Shorts, Reels und Posts für LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube, vor und hinter der Kamera. Vom ersten Konzept über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Schnitt. Social-Media-Redaktion: Du verantwortest unseren Redaktionsplan und entscheidest, welches Thema auf welchem Kanal läuft. Du machst aus einem Engineering-Fortschritt einen LinkedIn-Post, aus einem Testlauf ein Video und aus einem Meilenstein einen Moment, über den geredet wird. Community Management: Du sichtest Kommentare und Nachrichten, antwortest im Tagesgeschäft und erkennst, wann ein Thema an das Team oder die Gründer:innen geflaggt werden muss. Mit Creator:innen und Partnern arbeitest du dabei eng zusammen. Founder-Content: Du recherchierst Themen und schreibst Entwürfe für LinkedIn-Beiträge, die unsere Gründer:innen aus ihrer eigenen Perspektive veröffentlichen. Du entwickelst eigene Formate aus unserem Material: Unser Videograf kümmert sich um Dokumentation und aufwendige Produktionen. Du machst daraus eigene Formate, schneidest Snippets und organisierst kleinere Drehs selbst. Reporting: Du misst Reichweite, Engagement und Profilbesuche, wertest aus, was funktioniert, und bringst die Erkenntnisse in den nächsten Redaktionsplan ein. Brand Consistency: Gemeinsam mit unserem Brand & Communications Lead bringst du unsere Markenstrategie in die tägliche Content-Arbeit. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Marke über alle Kanäle hinweg wiedererkennbar bleibt. Das bringst Du mit Erfahrung: Mindestens zwei Jahre im Social Media Management oder in der Content Creation, in einer Agentur, einem Startup, einem In-house-Team oder als Freelancer:in. Du hast mindestens eine Kampagne eigenständig umgesetzt und kannst zeigen, was dabei herauskam. Vor und hinter der Kamera: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera und drehst und schneidest Shorts eigenständig, zum Beispiel in Premiere, CapCut oder DaVinci Resolve. Redaktion und Konzept: Du denkst in Formaten und Serien, schreibst gute Texte und weißt, wie sich ein Thema auf LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube jeweils anders erzählt. Produktion: Kleinere Drehs organisierst du selbst, von der Location über das Equipment bis zur Abstimmung mit allen Beteiligten. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen und technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu machen. Zahlen: Du kennst die Analytics der Plattformen und leitest daraus ab, was du als Nächstes anders machst. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Das bieten wir Dir Deine Arbeit ist das, was die Welt von uns sieht: Feeds, Launch, Event. Fast alles, was die Öffentlichkeit von unseren Robotern mitbekommt, geht über deinen Tisch. Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du den Roboter in Aktion filmen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, ganz ohne Ticket. Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und begleitest einen Launch, den bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat. Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und Links zu Content, den du selbst produziert hast, idealerweise eine Kampagne oder Serie, die du von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung umgesetzt hast. Dazu ein paar Zeilen: Was war das Ziel, was hast du gemacht, was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Content-Aufgabe, Angebot. Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Social Media und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Personalreferent (m/w/d)
description: Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Hauptverwaltung Düsseldorf · Direkt an die Geschäftsführung angebunden · Start kurzfristig, spätestens zum 01.01.2027 „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Stell dir vor Montagmorgen. Eine Standortleitung braucht bis Mitte des Monats eine neue Dozentin, also geht die Anzeige heute noch raus. Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Du sortierst, legst los – und am Abend ist alles erledigt und sauber in Personio dokumentiert. Das ist kein Werbetext. Das ist der Job. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personalarbeit nicht delegiert, sondern macht: von der Stellenanzeige bis zum Zeugnis, selbstständig und mit Tempo. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg und Berlin sowie in Marokko. Wir konzipieren und realisieren geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprachkurse und Weiterbildungen – für Privat- wie Firmenkunden, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Worum es geht Wir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. Dafür brauchen wir kurzfristig eine Person, die unsere Personalarbeit operativ in die Hand nimmt: das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung, schnelles Recruiting und eine Personalabteilung, die vollständig über Personio läuft. Du arbeitest sehr eigenständig, verantwortest die operative Personalarbeit ab Januar in eigener Hand und hast den direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Wenn du gern selbst anpackst, statt Zuständigkeiten zu verteilen, bist du hier richtig. Was du bewegst Personalabteilung über Personio führen – Du führst unsere Personalarbeit in Personio: Stammdaten, digitale Personalakte, Abwesenheiten, Dokumente, Workflows und Auswertungen. Was noch nicht sauber läuft, richtest du ein. Personalsachbearbeitung von A bis Z – Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und Schreiben erstellst du selbst. Du pflegst die Personalakten und behältst Fristen wie Probezeiten und Befristungen im Blick. Kurzfristig einstellen – Du schreibst Stellen aus, sichtest Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche, stimmst Termine ab und bringst Einstellungen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift – auch wenn es schnell gehen muss. On- und Offboarding – Du begleitest Eintritte und Austritte vollständig: Unterlagen, Unterweisungen, Zugänge, Übergaben. Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung – Du bereitest die monatlichen Lohndaten vor, klärst Rückfragen und hältst den Kontakt zur Steuerberatung. Ansprechperson im Alltag – Du bist erste Adresse für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei allen Personalfragen und bereitest arbeitsrechtliche Vorgänge wie Abmahnungen oder Kündigungen sauber vor. Mitdenken und anpacken – Du kümmerst dich um das, was anfällt – auch wenn es nicht in der Stellenbeschreibung steht. Was du mitbringst Qualifikation – Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zur Personalkauffrau bzw. zum Personalkaufmann, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis. Erfahrung – Mehrjährige Praxis in der operativen Personalarbeit. Du beherrschst das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung und hast es selbst gemacht, nicht nur begleitet. Personio – Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio und hast das System idealerweise selbst eingerichtet oder administriert. Arbeitsrecht – Solide Grundkenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht für das Tagesgeschäft – und das Gespür dafür, wann du dir Rat holst. Hands-on-Mentalität – Du packst an, kümmerst dich und arbeitest gern selbstständig. Du priorisierst sicher, wenn vieles gleichzeitig kommt. Verfügbarkeit – Du kannst kurzfristig einsteigen, bestenfalls zum 01.01.2027 oder früher. Persönlichkeit – Verbindlichkeit, strukturierter Arbeitsstil, klare Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift und absolute Diskretion. Von Vorteil – Erfahrung bei einem Bildungsträger oder im SGB-II/III-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Was du bei uns findest Eigenverantwortung – Du baust die Personalarbeit so auf, wie sie gut funktioniert – mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Wirkung – Deine Arbeit betrifft unmittelbar unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Führungskräfte und die Entwicklung der gesamten Gruppe. Ein Team mit echter Diversity – Auf Augenhöhe, mehrsprachig und mit Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit. Entwicklung – Gezielte Förderung deiner Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung. Sicherheit – Festanstellung bei einem Bildungsträger, der seit über 15 Jahren im Markt ist. Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) mit Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Eintrittstermin an Herrn Debdoubi Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei einer der operativen Tochtergesellschaften der EuBiA-Gruppe – EuBiA GmbH, EuBiA Rhein-Ruhr-West GmbH oder EuBiA NRW GmbH – je nach Aufgabengebiet. Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. description: <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.</p> <p>DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.<br>The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.</li> <li>Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.</li> <li>Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.</li> <li>Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.</li> <li>Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.</li> <li>Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.</li> <li>Feed the product loop. Help Us Build Trust in Compliance & Security</strong></h2> <p>Our squads ship fast, with AI-assisted tooling, on a regulated fiscalization platform that customers trust with their compliance. We want security to keep pace with that speed, not stand in front of it. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer (Application & Platform Security) to be our founding security engineer in a company of about 150 people. This is a builder's role: you will write the controls that make the secure path the fast path, then prove they work.</p> <h2>💼 <strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p data-path-to-node="10">As a Senior individual contributor, you will own the secure baseline for cloud, Kubernetes and application delivery, and you will express it as code rather than documents. You will bring threat modelling into squad design reviews, buy and steer external testing, and act as our named security incident commander. You will work closely with Compliance by supplying the technical facts they need, while the regulatory relationship stays with them. You will have read access to all repositories and staging environments, with break-glass production access under audit. You will have no direct reports; you will influence through standards, coaching and well-argued written advice.</p> <h2>🛠️ <strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Secure Baseline as Code:</strong> Define and maintain the secure baseline for cloud, Kubernetes and application delivery as policy-as-code and archetype defaults, so squads inherit the control instead of waiting for a review.</li> <li><strong>Threat Modelling:</strong> Run threat modelling inside squad design reviews for changes that touch data flows, authentication, authorisation or cryptography.</li> <li><strong>Security Assurance:</strong> Own assurance end to end: scope external tests, triage findings, drive remediation to a verified fix and run the retest.</li> <li><strong>Incident Command:</strong> Act as named security incident commander. Maintain the severity model and runbook, coordinate response, preserve evidence and supply the facts for Compliance's notification decisions.</li> <li><strong>AI-Assisted Testing:</strong> Operate our AI-assisted security testing programme: run it, score it, tune it, and decide when it is not worth the triage.</li> <li><strong>Champions & Collaboration:</strong> Re-charter and run the security champions guild, and turn recurring squad friction into platform improvements together with Foundational Infrastructure, Observability, Compliance and Delivery.</li> <li><strong>Vendor & Data Review:</strong> Review external vendor changes that would put customer data in a new place.</li> <li><strong>Measure & Publish:</strong> Own the security metrics, including publishing the function's own misses, and measure the friction security adds to delivery.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <h2>✨ <strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Controls Shipped as Code:</strong> You have shipped security controls as code (policy, CI checks, IaC guardrails), not only advised on them. You have hands-on experience with Kyverno or OPA and with GitHub Actions.</li> <li><strong>Application Security Depth:</strong> Strong grounding in threat modelling, authentication, authorisation, cryptography misuse and injection classes, plus data classification and redaction design.</li> <li><strong>Cloud & Kubernetes Fluency:</strong> You read Terraform/OpenTofu, Kubernetes manifests and Helm without assistance, and you know cloud IAM and Kubernetes security boundaries well enough to write a baseline engineers can actually implement.</li> <li><strong>Pentest Ownership as the Client:</strong> Practical experience scoping and running penetration tests from the buying side: writing the scope, judging the report and driving remediation.</li> <li><strong>First-Security-Hire Experience:</strong> You have been the first or only security person somewhere, ideally in a regulated or otherwise high-trust environment, and you can describe what you deliberately did not do.</li> <li><strong>Regulatory Literacy:</strong> Enough familiarity with the German regulatory landscape to sit in a BSI / KassenSichV conversation without owning the programme.</li> <li><strong>AI Literacy:</strong> You use AI tooling for drafting, triage and policy generation with review discipline, and you can say where it fails. You understand AI-specific attack surface: prompt injection against agents that read code, agent credential scope and model supply chain.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Influence:</strong> You write more than you talk, and prefer a one-page decision note to a 20-slide deck. title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Director, Head of Quality <span style="font-size: inherit;">& Responsible Person</span> for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity </li> <li>Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management</li> <li>Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations</li> <li>Approve return to saleable stock</li> <li>Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment</li> <li>Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup</li> <li>Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license</li> <li>Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness </li> <li>Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program</li> <li>Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces </li> <li>Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements</li> <li>Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP</li> <li>Participate in GDP vendor qualification program</li> <li>Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications</li> <li>Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation </li> <li>Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets</li> <li>Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence</li> <li>Be available and reachable 24/7 </li> </ul> <p><strong>Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed</li> <li>Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements</li> <li>Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective</li> <li>Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed </li> <li>Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed </li> <li>Participate in regulatory inspections  </li> <li>Participate in internal and external project team meetings </li> <li>Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary  </li> <li>Other duties as assigned </li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work </u></strong></h3> <p>This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred </li> <li>Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred) </li> <li>Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)</li> <li>Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products </li> <li>Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management </li> <li>Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance </li> <li>Working in a highly regulated environment </li> <li>Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems </li> <li>BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy</li> <li>Documented GDP training and the education and experience to be accepted as Responsible Person by the Dutch authorities (Farmatec/IGJ)</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Skills</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines </li> <li>Fluent in English language; written/spoken in Dutch language, preferred </li> <li>Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload </li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail </li> <li>Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP </li> <li>Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture  </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>We have high expectations for our team members</li> <li>We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return</li> <li>Market leading compensationHybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</span></strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">For BridgeBio title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong> Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Canada, Remote</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. </li> <li>Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.</li> <li>Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. </li> <li>Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. </li> <li>Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. </li> <li>Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .</li> <li>Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.</li> <li>Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++</li> <li>Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects.</li> <li>Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose. </li> <li>Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy.</li> <li>Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Geschäftsleiter Markt - SumUp Bank (Managing Director, Front Office)
description: SumUp is preparing to build a CRR (Capital Requirements Regulation) licensed bank in Germany—an important next chapter in our journey to help small businesses thrive. As Managing Director, Front Office, you'll be part of the team that shapes how this bank serves customers: the proposition we bring to market, the products we build, and the standards by which we grow. This is a rare opportunity to take an executive management role in a new, digitally native bank. You'll combine commercial leadership with direct accountability for customer-facing governance, and represent the market perspective in dialogue with supervisors. We're looking for a leader who sees customer trust and sustainable growth as inseparable—and who can build with the pace of a technology company and the discipline of a bank. What you'll do Together with the other members of the executive management team contribute to the strategic and corporate development of the bank. Lead the market facing part for the German banking licence application. Represent the bank in supervisory dialogue on commercial strategy, products, distribution and customer treatment, including with BaFin, Deutsche Bundesbank and the European Central Bank where relevant. Support building the go to market operating model and ensure it is integrated into the bank's governance, risk and control framework. Work closely with the Managing Director, Back Office (Geschäftsleiter Marktfolge) to ensure product, conduct and outsourcing risks are understood and managed. Partner with the wider SumUp and bank leadership teams—including Finance, Global Banking, Product and Engineering—to turn the strategy into a viable, well-governed business. Coach the next generation of SumUp leaders on their path to a §25c Abs 1 KWG qualification. You'll be great for this role if… You bring 15 - 20+ years of senior leadership experience in credit institutions, including the qualification according to §25c Abs. 1 KWG. You have led commercial, product or customer activity in a regulated bank and can show how you balanced business performance with customer outcomes, conduct requirements and effective controls. You have a practical understanding of German and European banking regulation, including the requirements relevant to governance, product oversight, market conduct and customer protection. You're fluent in German and have excellent English skills. You can engage credibly with supervisors, communicate complex issues clearly and raise difficult topics early. You bring sound judgement, integrity and the independence of mind expected of a bank executive, and can meet the applicable fitness and propriety requirements for the appointment. You're comfortable building in a fast-moving environment where there may be limited precedent. You can establish the right foundations without slowing the business down with unnecessary processes. Experience in merchant or SME banking, payments, lending, embedded finance, digital banking or API-led products would be especially valuable. So would experience building a new regulated entity or scaling a fintech, specialist lender or digital bank. You'll need to commit the capacity expected of a full-time executive board role. Why you should join SumUp You'll help shape a new bank for the businesses that keep local economies moving. You'll have the influence to define its commercial direction and customer proposition, while building the governance and trust that let it grow for the long term. It's a chance to bring together your banking experience and your builder mindset at a defining moment for SumUp. Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region. In this role, you will Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across
