title: Growth
description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE. You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show. Your First Six Months Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own. Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing. Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with. Who Will Thrive At Augustus We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits: American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low. Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment. Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team. Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent. This role is for you if: You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO. You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth. You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights. You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks. You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on. You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it. After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it. This is not for you if: You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person. You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them. You want a predictable week. Plans change, the bar is high and the hours are long. You expect your degree to count for more than your results. Hard Requirements You are currently pursuing or have obtained, in the last two years, a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution. You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, private equity, consulting or investment banking, and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations or entrepreneurial experiences. Fluent English. Spanish is a strong plus. You can travel regularly, often at short notice. Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Pay transparency Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €60,000-€80,000 + equity and benefits. What We Offer Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before. Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities. Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner. Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget. Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team. Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Ability to plan and deliver projects under tight deadlines, across several teams with competing constraints. Experience with EMC constraints and RF integration is a plus. title: Product Feature Owner ADAS
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively. As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping ADAS functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy. 🧠 Your day-to-day Act as the accountable product owner for specific ADAS features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs. Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy. Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans. Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities. Serve as the central point of coordination between OEMs, product and engineering teams, creating clarity, resolving ambiguity and reducing misunderstandings. Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as feature requirements, customer priorities and the technology evolve. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of ADAS features across Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Evasive Steering Assist (ESA), Automatic Emergency Steering (AES) and Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM). Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams. Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery. Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications. Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production. Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy. Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively. Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations. 🙌 You should apply if: You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM. You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation. You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy. You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation. You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams. You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap. You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process. Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable. Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable. Experience with machine learning, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial. You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new ADAS capabilities and advancing the customer experience. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: This is a full-time role based in our Leonberg office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes) Competency interviews (HM Interview) 45 Minutes Deep-dive technical interviews (ADAS domain knowledge, Technical Depth and Presentation) Final interview : mission & values alignment. We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. Port and configure Linux-based systems, QNX, and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments. Integrate and validate drivers, middleware, and boot-time configurations. Essential 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience. Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python. Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees). Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware. Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI). Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs). Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C. Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks. Desirable Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs). Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs. Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics. Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and artifact management tools like JFrog Artifactory. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 📊 About our Data Quality & Provenance Team Our Data Quality & Provenance team sits within Wayve’s AI Platform organisation and builds the evidence that helps teams make confident decisions about the data underpinning our embodied AI systems. We develop statistically robust methods, metrics and tools to determine when data-quality, annotation and evaluation signals can be trusted—and when they cannot. 🧠 Your day-to-day Define measurable, statistically rigorous concepts of data quality, including coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance. Apply statistical-inference methods to multi-rater annotation, label ambiguity, dataset coverage and black-box model evaluation. Partner with annotation, autonomy and evaluation teams to translate practical quality questions into defensible metrics. Build automated reports that clearly communicate confidence, limitations and appropriate interpretation. Analyse large annotation datasets using Python and SQL to identify quality issues and inform decisions. Iterate on metrics and reporting based on feedback from the teams using them. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Statistical methods for distinguishing genuine data-quality problems from label ambiguity, inconsistent annotation or evaluation noise. Labeler and dataset metrics that support training-data selection, simulation, annotation acceptance and model evaluation. Reusable quality artefacts that replace one-off analyses with registered, automated metrics and reports. Multi-rater and human-in-the-loop ML systems, including approaches such as Dawid–Skene-style models, psychometrics and inter-rater agreement. Quality standards spanning coverage, uncertainty, provenance, annotation quality and predictive-model performance. Integration of data-science outputs into the platform workflows used by engineering and research teams 🙌 You should apply if You have strong foundations in classical statistics, including experimental design, sampling, modelling, estimation and inference. You have practical experience with rater or annotator modelling, inter-rater agreement, label uncertainty or related methods. You understand data quality across dimensions such as coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance. You have worked with annotation tooling, QA methodologies, human-in-the-loop ML systems or multi-rater labelled datasets. You have strong Python and SQL skills and are confident analysing large, complex datasets. You can turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into rigorous, usable metrics and clearly communicate uncertainty, limitations and decision implications. Experience with probabilistic or Bayesian modelling, production platform integrations or safety-critical data would be an advantage. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency interview : Python Programming (60 mins) Data Curation Domain (60 mins) Deep-dive interview : Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) Systems design interview (60 mins) Final interview : Mission and values alignment (45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects. Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes. Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production. Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices. You might thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success. Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact. Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers. Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy. Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows. Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript. Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership. title: Data Center Site Selection - Hyperscale
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>San Francisco, Austin, Seattle, or New York</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Data Center Strategy team needs a site-selection manager who has closed NNN and wholesale leases at MW scale. You find the site, underwrite it, and get the paper signed.</p> <p>The binding constraint is usually power: available MW, interconnection, substation work, and when the site actually energizes. title: Data & AI Engineer (Frankfurt or Munich, Germany)
description: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a leading Data & AI services company helping large organisations turn data and AI into measurable business value. We work with major enterprises across industries including pharma, chemicals, manufacturing, financial services and automotive, solving complex problems across operations, R&D, customer experience and core business processes. Today, Unit8 brings together 170+ engineers, data scientists and consultants across Europe and North America, with a growing presence in the Middle East. We have delivered more than 350 Data & AI projects, spanning GenAI and AI engineering, data platforms, cloud, machine learning and advanced analytics. Our Mission Our mission is to help organisations make Data & AI work in the real world. We combine strong engineering, technical expertise and business understanding to take ideas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment and adoption. Requirements About You As a Data & AI engineer, you build the technical side of client projects, going from a business problem to a solution running in production. You help work out what the client actually needs, design the parts you own and write most of the code yourself. You work in a small project team with a technical lead, and you talk directly with the client's engineers and users. This role is for engineers who want to own real pieces of client work end to end and grow their impact, while staying hands-on. What You’ll Do Build the solution: design and write tested, maintainable production code for GenAI applications (agents, RAG, LLM apps) or data platforms and pipelines, and get it running for real users. Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision. Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders. Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team. Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team. Why You'll Love It Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs. Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks. Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms. Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow. Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself. Who You Are 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months. Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production. Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code. Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs. You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for. You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft. You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus. Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus. How We Hire Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study. Benefits What we offer Work on client projects that have a concrete impact on their business. Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts ( https://github.com/unit8co/darts ) or building our own MLOps platform. Tailor-made mentorship programme. Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups. Up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere. Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line). Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities. Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company Extended parental leave conditions. Why Unit8? At Unit8, we don’t just turn data into value – we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here. Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture. Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work. Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: E-Commerce Integration Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Rügamer & Steiner entwickelt E-Mail-Marketing für Online-Shops. Damit unser Team für einen neuen Kunden loslegen kann, müssen Shop und Klaviyo sauber zusammenspielen. Du übernimmst diese Anbindung, klärst technische Fragen direkt mit dem Kunden und seiner Shopagentur und prüfst, ob alles für den Start bereit ist. Was du übernimmst • Du bindest Kundenshops an Klaviyo an, richtest die Integration ein und prüfst, ob die benötigten Daten und Shop-Ereignisse ankommen. • Du führst technische Onboarding-Termine. Du erklärst, welche Zugänge oder Änderungen nötig sind, und hältst die offenen Punkte bis zur Übergabe nach. • Du gehst Fehlern in bestehenden Anbindungen nach, etwa wenn Bestellereignisse fehlen oder eine Schnittstelle nicht mehr zuverlässig läuft. Bei Änderungen am Live-Shop planst du die Prüfung mit ein. • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen. Das Team weiß von dir, was bereits funktioniert, was noch offen ist und wann es mit der Übergabe rechnen kann. • Wenn sich ein technischer Schritt bei mehreren Kunden wiederholt, kannst du ein Skript, ein internes Tool oder ein Plugin bauen, das die Arbeit beim nächsten Onboarding vereinfacht. So startest du Du lernst unsere Klaviyo-Setups und die Onboarding-Checkliste an konkreten Kundenfällen kennen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du technische Termine und eigene Anbindungen. Nach drei Monaten ist das Ziel, dass du ein Standard-Onboarding vom ersten technischen Kundentermin bis zur geprüften Übergabe selbstständig durchführst. Was du mitbringst • Du hast schon selbst eine Integration eingerichtet, einen technischen Fehler behoben oder ein funktionierendes Projekt mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit laufenden E-Commerce-Shops ist ein Plus. • Du kannst mit KI-Agenten arbeiten und programmieren. Du zerlegst technische Aufgaben in Schritte, prüfst den erzeugten Code und testest, ob die Lösung funktioniert. • Du kannst nachvollziehen, wie Daten zwischen Shop und angebundenen Systemen fließen. Du findest dich in APIs, Shop-Apps und technischen Einstellungen wie DNS zurecht. • Du kannst erklären, wie du eine Änderung an einem laufenden Shop vorbereitest, prüfst und bei Bedarf zurücknimmst. • Du kannst technische Probleme im Kundengespräch verständlich erklären und mit Kunden und Agenturen konkrete nächste Schritte vereinbaren. • Erfahrung mit Shopware, Magento oder ähnlich komplexen Shop-Setups ist besonders interessant. Klaviyo-Erfahrung ist willkommen. Unsere Abläufe lernst du bei uns kennen. Was dich erwartet Du bekommst früh eigene Kundenfälle und entscheidest bei Standardanbindungen selbst, wie du sie umsetzt. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Shopsystemen und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden verändert. Wenn du merkst, dass ein eigenes Tool einen wiederkehrenden Engpass löst, kannst du es bauen und in den nächsten Onboardings einsetzen. Rahmenbedingungen • Düsseldorf, fünf Tage pro Woche vor Ort • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche, Festanstellung • 50.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Entwicklung in der Rolle Bewirb dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Beispiel für eine Shop-Integration, einen technischen Fehler, den du gelöst hast, oder ein Projekt, das du mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt hast. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Phoenix, AZ</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking an experienced and strategic Enterprise Account Executive to own a dedicated territory of named Fortune 500 and Global 2000 accounts across our Michigan territory. You will lead complex, multi-year platform deals across Cloudflare’s SASE/Zero Trust, Application Security, Developer Platform, and Network/CDN portfolio—helping CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs consolidate legacy point products onto one global intelligent network.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own Regional Enterprise Accounts:</strong> Build and execute multi-threaded account plans to acquire new logos and expand strategic enterprise agreements across large, complex organizations.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Leadership:</strong> Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.</li> <li><strong>Sell Platform Consolidation to the C-Suite:</strong> Partner with CIOs, CISOs, and VP-level architecture leaders to displace incumbent firewall, VPN, MPLS, and CDN vendors with Cloudflare’s unified connectivity cloud.</li> <li><strong>Run Disciplined Deal Execution:</strong> Manage accurate forecasting and pipeline progression using MEDDPICC (or comparable enterprise frameworks), leveraging executive sponsors, Solutions Engineers, and channel/GSI partners.</li> <li><strong>Shape Product & Field Strategy:</strong> Feed customer architecture requirements directly back to Product Management and leadership to accelerate enterprise adoption.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, software, cloud, or cybersecurity deals.</li> <li>Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.</li> <li>Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees (Security, Networking, Infrastructure, AppDev, and Procurement) and close seven-figure agreements.</li> <li>Experience co-selling alongside strategic channel partners, VARs, and global systems integrators.</li> <li>Willingness to travel regionally within the Michigan territory to build executive customer relationships.</li> <li>Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).</li> <li>Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. </p> <ul> <li>Estimated annual salary of $350,000- $360,000 (base/variable) with uncapped commissions.</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. us create standard deployment playbooks which speed up bringing our solutions to market.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> You have a strong En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een <strong>Senior Project Manager </strong>die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je concreet doen?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.</li> <li>Je zorgt voor <strong>heldere projectstructuren</strong> en planning voor alle disciplines.</li> <li>Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.</li> <li>Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar <strong>uitvoerbare plannen</strong> en bewaakt verwachtingen.</li> <li>Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.</li> <li>Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.</li> <li>Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.</li> <li>Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Sterke projectmanager</strong> met min. 5+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om planning, coördinatie, organisatie en procesoptimalisatie.</li> <li>Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe projecten (in agencies, techteams, productteams of andere uitvoerende omgevingen).</li> <li>Je bent een pro in overzicht houden, risico’s inschatten en structureel werken — en je weet dit zelfverzekerd te vertalen naar teams en klanten.</li> <li>Je hebt <strong>geen creatieve productie-achtergrond nodig</strong> (zoals design of copywriting); wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.</li> <li>Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij jou?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Salaris:</strong> €<strong>3000 – 4250 bruto per maand</strong> (op basis van <strong>38,75 uur per</strong> week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.</li> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong> Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).</li> <li><strong>Vrijheid: </strong>Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.</li> <li><strong>Werkomgeving: </strong>werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.</li> <li><strong>Klanten:</strong> Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.</li> <li><strong>Groeikansen</strong>: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.</li> <li><strong>Toegang tot M Academy:</strong> Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.</li> <li><strong>Reiskostenvergoeding:</strong> Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.</li> <li><strong>8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar</strong> (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working allowance:</strong> <strong>€30 netto</strong> per maand bij fulltime.</li> <li><strong>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD):</strong> Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van <strong>€57,50 netto</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Lunchfaciliteiten:</strong> Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.</li> <li><strong>Zorgverzekering:</strong> Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p>Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.</p> <p>Enthousiast? Laat van je horen en vertel ons waarom jij de Project Manager Creative bent die wij zoeken.<strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Field Marketing Manager, EMEA Commercial
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences.</p> <p>We have a lot still to build, and we’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to have you join us.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll align regional and global marketing teams around shared priorities for EMEA Velocity, secure investment to deliver them, and balance global strategy with regional needs. You’ll directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.</p> <p> </p> <p>You’ll shape how Stripe grows its Velocity segment across EMEA, with a particular focus on winning and expanding relationships with priority commercial accounts. You’ll combine regional strategy with hands-on field marketing, building programs that generate demand and accelerate pipeline across different markets.</p> <p>As the primary marketing partner on the EMEA Velocity leadership team, you’ll own the regional marketing strategy and investment plan. You’ll work closely with Sales leadership to identify the biggest opportunities across markets, decide where marketing can make the greatest difference, and turn those priorities into measurable business results.</p> <p> </p> <p>You’ll lead account-based programs, executive engagement, and market-relevant campaigns for priority commercial accounts, bringing together regional and global teams to deliver them. Your programs will engage senior decision makers and operational leaders on reducing developer complexity, improving conversion, and increasing the return on their financial infrastructure. You’ll also partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those efforts with regional business priorities.</p> <p> </p> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll lead through influence across markets and teams, aligning Sales, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns around a shared plan. You’ll balance regional priorities with local customer needs, use results to guide investment, and build approaches that can scale across EMEA. You’ll help shape the marketing approach and directly lead the initiatives where regional context and ownership matter most.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and own the integrated marketing strategy for the Velocity segment across EMEA, turning business goals, market dynamics, customer needs, and competitors into clear priorities.</li> <li>Partner with regional Sales and Sales Development (SDR) leadership to set shared priorities, take part in pipeline reviews, and steer marketing investments.</li> <li>Build full-funnel campaigns around the problems businesses are trying to solve, such as taking payments online, growing recurring revenue, and getting paid faster.</li> <li>Lead high-touch field marketing, targeted account-based programs, and executive events, including dinners and roadshows, for priority commercial accounts. Partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those programs with regional Sales priorities.</li> <li> </li> <li>Co-market with the SaaS Platforms and Partner teams to reach merchants through the software they already use.</li> <li>Build Stripe’s brand with these businesses through customer stories, executive engagement, and industry initiatives, and lead the programs yourself where local context and senior ownership matter most.</li> <li>Own the regional marketing budget and use pipeline generation, pipeline progression, priority-account engagement, and ROI to guide investment. Partner with relevant teams to measure contributions to product adoption and customer advocacy, and use results to prioritise, scale, or change programs.</li> <li>Bring regional and global teams (including Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns) together to deliver the plan, and adapt global strategy to local buyer expectations, regulation, and the competitive landscape.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>You’re an experienced B2B marketing leader who has owned an integrated marketing strategy across a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio. You can set clear direction, make clear commercial trade-offs, and partner credibly with senior Sales and go-to-market (GTM) leaders—all while staying close enough to execution to turn strategy into measurable business results. </p> <p> </p> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements for the role. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including ownership of integrated marketing strategy and budget for a region or broad portfolio in tech.</li> <li>GTM business partnering: Proven track record partnering with senior Sales and GTM leaders to turn commercial targets into marketing plans and investment decisions.</li> <li>Scaled and high-touch marketing: Experience running both scaled digital demand and high-touch account-based marketing for larger prospects.</li> <li>Commercial accountability: Success generating pipeline, accelerating deal velocity, and managing multi-program budgets tied to clear ROI.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership: Demonstrated ability to align regional and global teams (Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Communications) without direct authority.</li> <li>Strategy and hands-on delivery: Comfort moving between multi-quarter planning and delivering key initiatives yourself.</li> <li>Executive communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to explain technical products in business terms and present recommendations to leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Domain knowledge: Experience in payments, fintech, embedded finance, ecommerce, or high-growth B2B SaaS.</li> <li>Ecosystem and platform GTM: Experience marketing to software platforms, SaaS businesses, marketplaces, or building joint co-marketing programs with technology and ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Positioning & localization: Proven ability to take category or business-model positioning and translate it into regional and local-market programs.</li> <li>Executive advocacy: A track record of building customer advocacy and influence strategies with senior commercial stakeholders (Founders, CEOs, and CFOs).</li> <li>Builder mindset: Comfort building marketing approaches where the playbook, tooling, or route to impact is still taking shape.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Researcher (Robot Learning)
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. You will train and deploy modern neural robotic policies for real customer tasks. This is an early-career role for someone whose strongest experience may come from a university laboratory, thesis, internship, or recent research position. We care about the depth of your work and your ability to learn quickly, not the number of years on your CV. What You Will Do Train neural policies for manipulation and other embodied tasks using real and simulated data. Build data, training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines for robotic policies. Run experiments in simulation and transfer successful policies onto real robots. Collect demonstrations and deployment data, diagnose failure modes, and improve policies iteratively. Evaluate models for robustness, generalisation, latency, and real-world task success. Work alongside deployment engineers at customer sites to adapt policies to new environments and workflows. Turn research ideas into systems that operate reliably outside the lab. Requirements Experience training modern neural-network-based robotic policies through a thesis, university laboratory, internship, research project, or early professional role. Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, or related robot-learning methods. Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch, JAX, or an equivalent framework. Experience running experiments on real robots or in a robotics simulator. Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals and experimental design. Evidence of strong technical work, such as a thesis, paper, research project, open-source contribution, or working robotic system. Comfortable moving between research code and physical hardware. Willingness to travel to deployment sites. Nice to Have Experience with manipulation, dexterous control, teleoperation, or whole-body policies. Familiarity with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, or similar environments. Experience with diffusion policies, transformers, multimodal models, or vision-language-action systems. Publications or workshop papers in robotics, computer vision, or machine learning. Experience collecting or curating robot-training data. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Power Originator Germany
description: DORTMUND | HYBRID Help us accelerate the energy transition The energy transition is transforming the German electricity market at unprecedented speed. At GIGA Storage, we develop, invest in and operate large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across Germany, the Netherlands and Belgium, with Germany playing an increasingly important role in our growth. By 2030, we aim to manage 1.5 to 2 GW of operational BESS assets, enough capacity to provide electricity to millions of households when it is needed most. You take ownership of the origination process, from identifying opportunities and structuring transactions to negotiating terms and closing contracts that balance risk and return. A strong understanding of the German power market, commercial energy structures and the relevant market participants. Experience in the German market is a must. Help determine how 2 GW of battery flexibility can be brought to market and turned into sustainable revenue streams. Get the freedom to make deals. title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business Fluent French and access to our Paris office An ideal candidate also has Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. title: Senior Territory Account Executive-Detroit OR Grand Rapids, MI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Grand Rapids, MI (Detroit could work for the right candidate)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About this Role</strong></p> <p>This role within the mid-market segment focuses on both the acquisition of new Territory accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  Within the mid-market segment, you will work a set of accounts in the territory sub-segments. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.</li> <li>Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Engage in account mapping sessions with partners, including training new partners on our technology and GTM strategies.</li> <li>Developing scalable relationships with target partners, to expand partner ecosystem in a specific region.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.</li> <li>Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. </li> <li>Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. </li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of direct B2B selling experience</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Demonstrated analytical and quantitative abilities</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in Software/SaaS/Security Sales & Channel management.</li> <li>Existing relationships and/or strong familiarity of the partner ecosystem in the region that they cover.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystem and cloud security is highly preferred.</li> <li>Experience working in a start-up environment.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> <li>Technical competence strongly preferred.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>
