title: Working Student MDR
description: About the Role Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step. That's where you come in. As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR) , you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo. You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey. This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact. It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension. About Trengo Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture. What your role looks like: Turn inbound interest into opportunities Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day. Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting. Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step. Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation. Help prospects become self-serve customers Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo. Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan. Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers. Improve how we engage with leads Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best. Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data. How we'll measure success You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track: Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention. Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives. Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers. Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve. The tools you'll work with You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit: HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling. RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking. Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching. Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks. AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working. What you’ll bring 1-2 years of experience , ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment. Fluent English , both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus. Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met. A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative. An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments. Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback. A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works. Nice to have Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools. Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes. Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian. Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms. Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows. ⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams. What’s in it for you? This is what we carefully prepared for you: 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment. 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad. 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success. 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp) . 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences. 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ. 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected. 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues. 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office . 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future. 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world. 🔍 Our hiring process Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team. Manager interview – Deep dive into experience and expectations. Practical assignment – Role-related, real-world challenge. Team connection – Meet future colleagues and confirm mutual fit. We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step. Your next challenge starts here! Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team. 👉 Apply today and let’s grow together! We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Hybrid #LI-MT1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to autonomy. Our systems are designed to revolutionize material handling - from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods. We’re looking for a Lead Deployment Engineer who will take charge of scaling our deployment activities across Europe. This is a role for someone who thrives both hands-on in the field and in leading and coordinating multiple deployments as we roll out robots at customer sites. You’ll shape how our robots are brought into production environments, ensuring smooth installations, happy customers, and continuous improvements that set new standards in logistics automation. Who you are Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early growth phase and own the deployment function end-to-end. Experienced in logistics automation, with a proven track record of rolling out complex robotic or automation systems in production environments. A leader who balances hands-on problem-solving with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Clear communicator, fluent in English; German is a strong plus. Excited about frequent travel to customer sites across Europe (up to 50%). Skilled at building trust with customers and collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams. What you bring Hands-on experience in designing, testing, deploying and commissioning automation, robotics, or other machinery in industrial settings. Strong understanding of mechanical engineering, mechatronics, sensors, networking, and control systems. Demonstrated ability to organize, manage, and prioritize multiple deployment projects in parallel. Proven leadership experience: mentoring and building field/deployment teams. Strong diagnostic skills for both hardware and software issues, and confidence in high-pressure environments. Familiarity with Linux and modern deployment practices is a plus. Driver’s license and proficiency in German or other European languages are advantages. What you’ll do Lead deployments : Plan, organize, and oversee robot installations across Europe, ensuring smooth execution and customer satisfaction. Build and scale the team : Recruit, train, and mentor deployment engineers as we expand across markets. Customer interface : Act as the technical lead in the field, ensuring a smooth handover and training for customer operators. Feedback loop : Collect insights from deployments and feed them back into product and engineering to drive reliability and new features. Represent Flink : Be the face of the company at pilots, trade shows, and customer demos. Drive standards : Develop and refine processes, documentation, and playbooks to enable repeatable, reliable deployments. Why join A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential. Work at the cutting edge of robotics, where real-world impact meets world-class research. Take a central role in scaling a function critical to Flink’s growth. Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear. Work in a central office in Zurich and across Europe with our partners. Apply now if you’re ready to push the boundaries of robot automation! Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Acquisition Operations
description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. The mission Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand. Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets. You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet. Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet. What you'll build Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days) Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it. Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call. Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly. Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9) Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks. Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing. Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond) Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel. Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously. Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it. Why this role Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days. Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you. Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level. A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat. The steepest learning curve we can offer. A path that grows with the system: from operator to architect to leader of growth automation at Zefir. Who you are Top-tier problem solver: 2 to 6 years at a top strategy consultancy (BCG, McKinsey, Bain...), in Growth, Ops or Strategy at a high-growth tech company, or both. You structure messy problems in minutes and you get the math right the first time. Builder at heart: you have already built something real: a model, a tool, an automation, an AI agent, a side project. SQL is second nature; Python is a strong plus. You'd rather prototype in an afternoon than debate for a week. Commercial instinct: you think in revenue, not in vanity metrics. You're curious about why people click, book and buy, and you know when fewer leads is good news. Systems thinker: when you see a task done twice, you design the system that removes it. You care about guardrails, feedback loops and what happens when things break. Ownership and clarity: you hold a high bar, move fast and own outcomes. You write crisp updates that start with the number, the cause and the action. Languages: fluency in French and English is required. What we don't require: years of media buying or a marketing title. We hire for slope, not intercept: if you learn fast and build relentlessly, we'll teach you the rest. Hiring process 30-min call with our Talent Lead 30-min interview with the hiring manager 60-min live case on real (anonymised) funnel data. AI is allowed in part of the case: we want to see how you use it. 15-min coffee chat with our RevOps lead and 45-min Behavioral interview with our CoFounder, then references Benefits The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter. Competitive salary : You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator . BSPCE (Stock Options) : Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period. Healthcare plan : Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children. Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement) : With flexible remote work options. Swile meal card : €11 per worked day. Swile mobility card : €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…). Team events : Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company. Our Operating Principles 🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them. 🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes. 🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition. Application & Process We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives. For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step. Compensation: €59.6K – €67K • Offers Equity • €59.6K – €67K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: AI Deployment Manager, Enterprise
description: We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop. At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift. Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before. To win, we focus relentlessly on: Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand. Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout. Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing. The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood. Join us to make Conversational Commerce real. About the Team The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent. Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions. About the Role As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage. You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding. What You'll Do Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products. Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals. Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage. Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration. Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms. Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process. Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools. Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting and workback schedules, ensuring effective project management throughout the implementation. Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers. Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices. Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings. Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation. Who You Are Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus. Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy. Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience. Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus. AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency. Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes. Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn. Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge. French Bilingual (C1) is a must AI at Gorgias At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones. The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions. We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better. title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description: AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken. Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen. Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten. Wie zijn wij? Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie. We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen. En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren. Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie Wat ga je doen? Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren. Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen. Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen. Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers. Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's. Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid. Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven. Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt. We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken. Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften. Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties. De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen. Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken. Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen. title: Cisco OEM Alliance Director

title: Principal Solution Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Strength in Trust </h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">The Challenge</h3> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"></p> <p>We’re looking for a Principal Solutions Engineer to shape and lead technical strategy for OneTrust’s most strategic and complex opportunities in France. Reporting to the Director of Solutions Engineering, you will bring broad portfolio fluency, deep enterprise technology expertise, executive-level customer engagement, and commercial judgement to help customers solve business-critical challenges with OneTrust.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and partners to build deep account alignment, progress complex buying decisions, and create measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You will be a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and a force multiplier for the Solutions Engineering organisation: setting s high bar, developing reusable approaches, and coaching others to raise the quality of our work. AI Governance is an important area of expertise for this role, alongside the breadth to lead opportunities across OneTrust’s entire platform.</p> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"></p> <h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">Your Mission</h3> <ul class="p8i6j08 p8i6j02"> <li class="p8i6j0b">Lead technical strategy for complex, strategic sales opportunities, from discovery and solution design through executive presentations, RFPs, and proof-of-concept evaluations.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Advise customers on integration architecture, platform capabilities, implementation approaches, and technical best practices aligned to their objectives and environment.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Design and guide tailored demonstrations and proof-of-concept evaluations that clearly connect OneTrust’s capabilities to customer requirements and measurable outcomes.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Partner with Sales leaders to build opportunity strategy, navigate technical and competitive considerations, and communicate differentiated value to technical and business stakeholders.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Serve as a trusted technical advisor in customer conversations, including architecture deep dives and discussions involving enterprise systems, APIs, cloud environments, and deployment patterns.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Coordinate with Product, R&D, technical integrations, and partner teams to validate capabilities, influence product direction, and bring customer feedback into the business.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Share expertise across the Solutions Engineering organization by coaching peers, developing repeatable technical assets and approaches, and helping strengthen the team’s engagement practices.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Build and maintain a strong understanding of the privacy industry, regulatory environment, competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs; apply that knowledge to customer engagements and solution strategy.</li> </ul> <h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">You Are</h3> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph">You are a credible, customer-focused technical leader who can move comfortably between business outcomes and detailed architecture. You bring sound judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving opportunities, communicate complex topics clearly, and influence stakeholders across customers and internal teams. You enjoy helping others succeed and can create leverage beyond your own account work.</p> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"><strong>Your Experience Includes</strong></p> <ul class="p8i6j08 p8i6j02"> <li class="p8i6j0b">Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Fluent in French and English</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, ideally in enterprise technology and/or cloud-based software, including significant customer-facing Solutions Engineering, consulting, or technical pre-sales experience.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">A track record of leading technical strategy for complex enterprise opportunities and communicating effectively with both executive and technical audiences.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Expertise delivering software demonstrations, technical evaluations, and proof-of-concept engagements, and translating customer requirements into solution designs.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Ability to build productive relationships across Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing, Engineering, and customer teams.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills, with the entrepreneurial mindset to thrive in a complex and evolving environment.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">A clear understanding of the privacy industry and its regulatory environment, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Willingness to travel as the role requires; an estimated 25% is assumed based on the reference description.</li> </ul> <h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">Extra Awesome</h3> <ul class="p8i6j08 p8i6j02"> <li class="p8i6j0b">Experience working in AI Governance, Risk and/or Privacy</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Hands-on familiarity with REST APIs, JavaScript, FreeMarker, HTML, and CSS.</li> </ul> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">Where we Work</span></span></h3> <p>We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.</p> <p>Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.</p> <h3><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">Benefits</span></span></h3> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">As an employee at </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW202854797 BCX0">OneTrust</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">, you will be part of the </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW202854797 BCX0">OneTeam</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">. That means </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0">you’ll</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW202854797 BCX0"> receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.</span></span></p> <h3>Resources  </h3> <p>Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: </p> <ul> <li><a class="fui-Link ___m14voj0 f3rmtva f1ern45e f1deefiw f1n71otn f1q5o8ev f1h8hb77 f1vxd6vx f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f9n3di6 f1ids18y fygtlnl f1deo86v f12x56k7 f1iescvh ftqa4ok f50u1b5 fs3pq8b f1hghxdh f1tymzes f1x7u7e9 f1cmlufx f10aw75t fsle3fq" href="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTM-0khp0wIWkO-Bh3IfdSMMOi8606Tl0" target="_blank">OneTrust Careers on YouTube</a></li> <li><a class="fui-Link ___m14voj0 f3rmtva f1ern45e f1deefiw f1n71otn f1q5o8ev f1h8hb77 f1vxd6vx f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f9n3di6 f1ids18y fygtlnl f1deo86v f12x56k7 f1iescvh ftqa4ok f50u1b5 fs3pq8b f1hghxdh f1tymzes f1x7u7e9 f1cmlufx f10aw75t fsle3fq" href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatonetrust/" target="_blank">@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram</a></li> </ul> <h3>Your Data</h3> <p>You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? </p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p> </p> <p>Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong></li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages </li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong> </strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators. </strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career. </strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>When are you joining? </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fall Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: September, October<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Spring Edition 2027<br></strong>Start dates: February, March<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <p>📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DE<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;">There is no </span><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">deadline</span>:</strong> Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. </p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>🚲Health and Transportation</strong><br>Through our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.</p> <p><strong>🍉Food</strong><br>Since we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.</p> <p><strong>📈Personal and Professional Development</strong><br>You will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.</p> <p><strong>🏖️All the rest</strong><br>You get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.<br>🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. </p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.<br><br><br></p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yEQXLpeYN84?si=It-z9-XNLVMDeHEy" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Federal
description: <p>This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.</p> <p>Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.</p> <p>Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.</p> <p>We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.</p> <p>Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.</p> <p>Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.</p> <p>We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.</p> <p> </p> <p>In building our sales team, we look for five things:</p> <p>Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems</p> <p>High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence</p> <p>Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes</p> <p>Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions</p> <p>Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers</p> <p>Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.</p> <p>The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.</p> <p>Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region of the Americas.</p> <p> </p> <p>What your day will look like:</p> <ul> <li>Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory</li> <li>Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting</li> <li>Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events</li> <li>Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets</li> <li>Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle</li> <li>Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems</li> <li>Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce</li> <li>Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>What we are looking for in you:</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science</li> <li>Minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise software or technology sales</li> <li>Experience with open source technology and solutions</li> <li>Detail oriented with effective follow-up</li> <li>Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution</li> <li>Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins</li> <li>Experience developing and managing complex customer relationships, including technical, executive and procurement stakeholders</li> <li>Understanding of public sector customers, government procurement processes and the unique challenges of selling technology solutions to government or education organizations</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute account strategies, build new pipeline and manage complex sales cycles within an assigned territory</li> <li>Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market</li> <li>Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Additional skills of interest:</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience selling enterprise software or technology solutions to U.S. Public Sector customers, including federal civilian, defense, intelligence, state and local government, or education organizations</li> <li>Previous sales experience with an enterprise software, open source software, cloud or infrastructure technology company</li> <li>Previous employment or experience working with U.S. government agencies, the military, Intelligence Community, government contractors or systems integrators</li> <li>Familiarity with government acquisition and contracting processes, public sector procurement vehicles and channel partner ecosystems</li> <li>Established customer relationships within federal agencies, the Intelligence Community, state and local government, or education markets</li> <li>Current or previous U.S. government security clearance, particularly for roles supporting defense, intelligence or other federal government customers</li> <li>Experience with cloud computing, Linux, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, AI or cybersecurity solutions</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences or industry events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>What we offer you</p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. description: <p>Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.</p> <p>We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. Qualifier et répondre aux différents besoins et demandes des clients par e-mail, chat ou WhatsApp, dans les délais définis par l'entreprise. Véritable "digital native", tu maîtrises les outils collaboratifs modernes (type Zendesk, CRM) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les modes de travail hybrides ou à distance. Tu ne te contentes pas de gérer l'existant. Ta proactivité et ton esprit d'analyse te poussent à identifier des axes d'amélioration et à proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser nos processus. Parce que nous savons que nos experts sont notre meilleure ressource, nous vous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant : Intégrez une communauté soudée et ultra-motivée pour relever des défis collectifs ! title: Stage of afstuderen Finance: Memoriaal Boekingen
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in het maandafsluitingsproces en verder optimalisering en automatisering hiervan. Je onderzoekt welke memoriaalboekingen er worden gemaakt, waarom ze ontstaan en hoeveel tijd ze kosten. Daarmee help je Finance om de doorlooptijd van de maandafsluiting te verkorten en het proces minder foutgevoelig te maken. Wat je gaat doen: Inventariseren van alle memoriaal boekingen binnen het maandafsluitingsproces / analyseren van historische data; Categoriseren van memoriaal boekingen (bijvoorbeeld correcties, accruals, reallocaties en eenmalige posten); In kaart brengen van de tijdsbesteding per type memoriaal boeking; Identificeren van oorzaken (procesmatig, datastructuur, systeembeperkingen, afhankelijkheden); Vaststellen welke memoriaal boekingen structureel, repeterend of te automatiseren zijn; Analyseren van de impact van memoriaal boekingen op doorlooptijd, foutgevoeligheid en controlelast. Uiteindelijk lever je een overzicht op van alle memoriaal boekingen met tijdsbesteding en frequentie inclusief een analyse en advies van de bottlenecks en verbetermogelijkheden. Aanbevelingen voor automatisering, toepassingen van AI, standaardisatie of eliminatie van memoriaal boekingen zijn een onderdeel van jouw advies. Wij vragen HBO of WO opleiding in de richting Finance & Control of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Designer
description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define. What you'll do Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products Requirements Two things matter most: Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type. Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company. Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Role Overview</strong></span><br><br>This is a leadership role spearheading Nebius’s communications across Europe and the Middle East: you will develop strong regional narratives, provide senior counsel, manage and develop the team, and lead consequential communications and stakeholder situations.<br><br>Reporting to the global Head of Communications, you will translate business priorities into compelling stories and a practical regional strategy. You will connect local developments to the company narrative and adapt them to the audiences and circumstances of each market.<br><br>We need an outstanding storyteller with the gravitas, experience and judgment to personally lead high-stakes situations involving multiple stakeholders. You will know when to shape the narrative, handle a difficult relationship or lead a response yourself, and when to give colleagues the authority and support to deliver.<br><br><strong>What success looks like</strong><br><br>The region has clear priorities, strong narratives, credible stories and trusted stakeholder relationships. Important situations receive the right senior attention. Colleagues understand their responsibilities, exercise sound judgment and develop under your leadership. Global colleagues have early visibility of consequential regional developments.<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span><br><br>Shape regional narratives and strategy</p> <ul> <li>Develop communications strategy and strong narratives for priority European and Middle Eastern markets, linked to business priorities and the wider company story.</li> <li>Identify compelling stories and the evidence behind them. Make clear choices about audiences, markets and investment; adapt narratives locally while keeping core facts consistent.</li> <li>Advise senior leaders on positioning, communications opportunities and reputation risks. Define measurable objectives and use evidence to improve the programme.</li> </ul> <p>Lead communications and consequential stakeholder situations</p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with regional business leaders, partners and relevant business, technology, infrastructure and local media. Create a sustained pipeline of credible stories.</li> <li>Shape and deliver the narratives, writing, executive counsel and stakeholder engagement that need your senior experience. Delegate other work with clear briefs, authority and quality standards.</li> <li>Lead regional communications for customer, partner, product and infrastructure developments.</li> <li>Partner with country managers and public affairs colleagues on communications and local engagement around physical infrastructure builds.</li> </ul> <p>Manage people and regional resources</p> <ul> <li>Set team priorities and responsibilities, coach colleagues, manage performance and support their development. Build the capability and confidence to make sound decisions.</li> <li>Balance workloads and recommend where additional skills or capacity are needed. Recruit and onboard approved hires.</li> <li>Direct agencies and partners through clear briefs, budgets and performance reviews. Judge what to own personally, what to delegate and when to intervene; retain accountability for quality and outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>Coordinate across the business</p> <ul> <li>Work closely with stakeholders across Nebius – GTM country leads, Marketing, Business Diplomacy, Product, Research, Technology, subject experts and other colleagues – to coordinate on issues including regional priorities, policy, local engagement and reputation management.</li> <li>Coordinate with US, APAC and global communications leaders on announcements, issues and executive visibility. Maintain early visibility of consequential developments within appropriate confidentiality controls.</li> </ul> <p><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Qualifications and Experience</strong></span><br><br>What we need</p> <ul> <li>A strong record of senior communications leadership in Europe and the Middle East, with substantial in-house technology-company experience and the ability to operate credibly across the region.</li> <li>Outstanding storytelling and narrative-development skills: translating complex business and technology priorities into compelling, credible stories for different audiences and markets.</li> <li>Demonstrated people-management experience: setting goals, coaching, managing performance and developing capable colleagues.</li> <li>Gravitas and senior experience to personally lead high-stakes, multi-stakeholder situations, advise business leaders and navigate competing interests with sound judgment.</li> <li>Evidence of judging when personal involvement is essential and when to delegate, alongside strong media relationships and experience directing agencies and regional resources.</li> <li>Outstanding English writing, editing and spoken communication, with the curiosity and rigor to understand complex technology and build accurate narratives.</li> </ul> <p>Helpful experience</p> <ul> <li>AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology or another complex B2B sector; regional expansion, infrastructure investment or a publicly listed company.</li> <li>Substantial Middle East communications work, relevant media relationships and additional regional language skills.</li> <li>Agency experience is valuable alongside substantial in-house experience; an agency-only background does not meet the role’s requirements. Journalism experience can be beneficial.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies and Behavioural Traits</strong><br><br>Strong narrative judgment, senior presence, clear prioritisation and calm leadership. A capable people manager who develops others, gives direct feedback and delegates with purpose. Takes personal ownership where the stakes or complexity require senior experience, while keeping regional and global colleagues aligned. Comfortable with ambiguity, iteration, course-correction, experimentation and (occasionally) failure.<br><br><strong>What We Offer</strong><br><br>A senior communications leadership role shaping narratives and stakeholder relationships across Europe and the Middle East, working closely with business and global communications leaders and developing the regional team.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. </p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - F/H
description: Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier. Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus. Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre. Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment. Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes. Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi. Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout. 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien. Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes. Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider. Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit. Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.
