title: Senior Response Engineer (Application & network security)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire.</p> <p>Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 6–8 years of hands-on experience in a high-volume Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets and adversarial edge attacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven experience commanding incident bridges, making decisive risk-tradeoff decisions, and maintaining composure while managing enterprise stakeholders during high-pressure crises.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience querying large-scale distributed logging and analytics systems using SQL, GraphQL, ClickHouse, or SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic, Sumo Logic).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defending against advanced persistent threats (APTs), credential stuffing, scraping botnets, or application-layer bypass attacks against major CDNs/WAFs.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications, such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, or advanced GIAC credentials (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GNFA).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><div> <p>If you're a problem solver, able to think outside the box and eager to nurture others and learn from them, then this is your challenge!</p> <br>As a <strong>principal engineer working across the entire frontend stack</strong>, from design-system primitives to product-level architecture, you will shape how developers build with Algolia and how customers experience our products.<br> <p>In the Frontend Experiences team, we're on a mission to make it effortless for developers to <strong>build great search and discovery experiences on the front end</strong>, with libraries, components and tooling that are fast, accessible, and a pleasure to use. Our work reaches customers and their end users directly, on the web and on mobile, so the quality bar is high and the feedback loop is short.</p> <br> <p>Right now, that includes a cross-team, multi-quarter effort to <strong>evolve the Algolia Dashboard</strong> from a collection of product surfaces into one coherent environment: a new navigation and information architecture, a shared component foundation, and an interaction model that supports traditional configuration, conversational assistance and agentic workflows side by side.</p> <br> <p>The team is looking for an experienced individual who is well versed in defining, building and operating scalable architectures, with proven strengths in cross-team collaboration, taking solutions all the way through delivery to adoption by other engineering teams and by customers. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and implementing systems that play a central role across all of Algolia's front-end products, including libraries that run in production on thousands of customer sites. You will also play a role in training/mentoring and leading team members.</p> <br> <p><strong>YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:</strong></p> <br> <ul> <li><strong>Defining the multi-year technical vision</strong> for Algolia's front-end platform, and turning it into roadmaps and projects that several teams can execute;</li> <li><strong>Playing an active role in the evolution of the Algolia Dashboard</strong>: shaping the experience architecture, the component strategy and the technical foundations for conversational and agentic UX, and partnering with engineering, product and design leadership to sequence delivery;</li> <li><strong>Driving convergence on a shared component library</strong>, reducing duplicated components and inconsistent patterns across product surfaces;</li> <li><strong>Designing and delivering solutions</strong> that will scale with significant volumes, be highly available, performant and resilient, including on pages and apps we do not control;</li> <li><strong>Owning solutions</strong>, taking them all the way through delivery to adoption by engineering teams and customers;</li> <li><strong>Shaping API design, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy</strong> for public libraries used by a large developer community;</li> <li><strong>Embodying technical expertise</strong>, that the team can refer to for advice or validation of a solution;</li> <li><strong>Setting engineering standards and best practices</strong> to be followed by engineers</li> </ul> <br> <p><strong>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</strong></p> <br> <ul> <li>Excellent communication and organization skills</li> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong>, with a track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams</li> <li>Experience as a <strong>thought leader/standard-bearer</strong> for engineers, inside and outside the company (talks, open source, writing)</li> <li>Proven experience <strong>leading engineers on large, cross-cutting projects</strong></li> <li>Extensive experience <strong>designing full stack solutions</strong>, interacting with microservice architectures, and strong grounding beyond the frontend (APIs, backend services, delivery infrastructure) to make sound end-to-end trade-offs</li> <li><strong>Deep frontend expertise</strong> (TypeScript, modern web platform, React and other major frameworks, accessibility, bundle size and runtime performance)</li> <li>Experience <strong>designing and maintaining public libraries, SDKs or design systems</strong>, with a feel for API ergonomics and a track record of managing breaking changes</li> <li>Experience <strong>building complex, high traffic & multi products web applications</strong> such as dashboards or admin consoles, and leading cross-team UI consolidation efforts</li> <li>Interest in <strong>conversational and agentic interfaces</strong> (chat, streaming responses, tool-driven workflows) and in the architecture needed to support them</li> <li>Familiarity with search UX patterns and with generative AI and agentic experiences is a plus</li> <li>Preference for candidates with experience at our current stage and beyond (over 10,000 customers, $50-200M ARR range, high growth, lots of change and building internal infrastructure).</li> </ul> </div> <div class="uil-fw-normal uil-ff-hind uil-fsz-16 lg:uil-fsz-18 uil-lh-bigger uil-color-grey-700"> <p> </p> </div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>The annual base salary compensation range for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€108.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€135.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p> <p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. </p> <p>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.</strong></p> <p><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>GRIT</strong> - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li> <li><strong>TRUST </strong>- Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li> <li><strong>CANDOR</strong> - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li> <li><strong>CARE</strong> - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li> <li><strong>HUMILITY</strong> - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.</li> </ul> <p>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.</p> <p><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice</strong></p> <p>We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:</p> <ul> <li>Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the <strong>best way to apply safely</strong> is directly through our <strong>careers page</strong>.</li> <li>All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an ----- email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li> <li>We’ll <strong>never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details</strong> during the hiring process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>READY TO APPLY?</strong></p> <p>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our stack includes .NET/C#, Python, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kafka/Debezium, Airflow, gRPC, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS, Batch), Terraform, Helm/Argo CD, and Datadog, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, CDC and streaming, data archiving, and batch compute</li> <li>Deep PostgreSQL experience at scale, including performance tuning, partitioning, and large online migrations</li> <li>A track record of rebuilding production data syncs and pipelines incrementally, keeping them idempotent, reconciled, and running throughout</li> <li>Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations</li> <li>A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution</li> <li>A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards</li> <li>Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business</li> <li>Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization</li> </ul> <p>#LI-IK1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁 - 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗝𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀</p> <p>Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.</p> <p> </p> <p>Learn more online at <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">cloudbeds.com</a></p> <p> </p> <p>𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/press/?press_type=company-news&news_category=awards">𝗔𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀</a>:</p> <ul> <li>Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)</li> <li>Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)</li> <li>Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)</li> <li>Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)</li> <li>Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)</li> <li>Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>𝗗𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗕𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀:</p> <ul> <li>Remote First, Remote Always</li> <li>PTO in accordance with local labor requirements</li> <li>Fully Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Home office stipend based on country of residency</li> <li>Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University</li> <li>Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 - 𝗔 𝗖𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗜𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻</p> <p>Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! title: Founding Product Manager - Claap
description: we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO. About Claap Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams. What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work. This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible. Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade. We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM. As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one. You will work with Robin on three big topics: - In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching. - Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app. - Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics. The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing). Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached. Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together. The PM at Claap wears different hats - A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed - A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance - An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe - A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation - A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it What you are not - A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks - A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs - A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for - The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business - A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you - A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on Key results Within 3 months you will have - Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision - Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts - Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones - Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad - Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams Within 12 months you will have - Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal - Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention - Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch - Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments What's in it for you? - A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders - Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals - A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action - Opportunity to shape our company's direction - Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales Preferred experience Must have - You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred. - You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies. - You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup. - You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end. - You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution. - You have strong communication skills. - You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking. - You have a strong pragmatism. - You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms. - You have a strong business acumen. Nice to have - You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews). - You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams. - You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience. - You know how to wireframe designs. - You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong. - You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff. Additional Information - Competitive salary + profit sharing - Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷 - Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits - Alan Blue: comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family - Swile Meal Tickets: daily meal tickets to fuel productivity - Navigo Card: 100% covered Navigo card - Full-remote work setup: a well-funded home office budget - Gear: a laptop + the tools and equipment you need for your job - Team building: we all meet once a year at really cool places around the world Recruitment process - Interview with Victoire, our Talent Acquisition Manager - Interview with Robin, Claap co-founder and CEO - Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Robin and Pierre - Team fit - Interview with Charles, our CEO - Reference Check - Offer How to apply Include a short note (200 words max) on an AI feature or agent you shipped end to end. It's the hardest thing to read on a CV, so we screen for it from day one. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Designer (Contract)
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The mission Every month, millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure, right inside the websites they read and the brands they like. We're looking for a Product Designer to own how these conversations look, feel and work. About 90% of the work is consumer-facing, and the need keeps growing: we want someone to build this with us over the long run. title: Lead Customer Success
description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role Context This new role comes as our customer base grows rapidly, driven in particular by deployments in private healthcare facilities. Its purpose is to ensure our customers get the most out of our solution and are fully satisfied with it. As Lead Customer Success, you will own customer usage and satisfaction, and manage our Customer Support team of two experienced people. This is a hands-on Lead role: you will manage the team while still spending a significant share of your time working directly on accounts. You will work closely with Clémentine (Head of Ops), the Deployment Strategists, the Product team, and RevOps. Missions Account monitoring : track usage metrics for each hospital and define the indicators to watch. Detection and resolution : spot accounts in trouble (for example a hospital whose activity suddenly drops), raise the alarm and solve the issue, on your own or with the Deployment Strategists. Satisfaction : set up and follow NPS campaigns. Adoption : run campaigns to increase usage of Parallel across our customers. Product feedback : share what you see in the field and work with Product on levers to increase usage. Management : manage two experienced people, set the framework and priorities, help them grow and structure the team as the number of accounts increases. Who you are You have 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, with your own B2B customer portfolio. You have already managed people, even an intern, and you have the credibility to lead two experienced people. You have already set up NPS campaigns and done account monitoring: you know which indicators you track and how you detect an account in trouble. You make decisions on your own on an account and raise the alarm when a metric drops. You want to keep working directly on accounts on top of managing: this is not a pure management role. A plus: experience with key account portfolios. Our values Play to Win : we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters. High Trust, High Standards : trust is our starting point. If you join us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar. Low Ego, Hands-On : at Parallel, no one is above the work. No title, seniority or past success exempts anyone from getting involved in the actual work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution. Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously : we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both. Hiring process Call with the Hiring Team (30 min) Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min) An afternoon at our office to present your case and meet the founders (2 hours) Reference check Why join us? A role to build : you lay the foundations of customer success at Parallel (metrics, campaigns, team organisation). A key role : customer success weighs heavily on Parallel's reputation, and you are the right hand of the Head of Ops on this topic. Real traction : seed and Series A ($20M with Index Ventures) closed in less than a year, more than 800 clients and a team of over 30 people. Strong investors and founders : Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI; founders who come from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo. A complete package : competitive salary and BSPCE, Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% of public transport covered. The team : a team event every month and two offsites a year. Our office : Paris 2nd arrondissement. Flexibility : on average one remote day per week and one remote week per year. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Seoul</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As a Senior Territory Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.</li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent with at least 8+ years of relevant work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
description: Be yourself at Protolabs Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. Why Protolabs? We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. Join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead! This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. Platform & environment Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability. Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery. Mentoring & influencing Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews. Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them. Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization. What You Bring: Technical 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data. Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers). Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes. Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt). Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs. Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems. MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents). Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations. Leadership & Collaboration Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams. Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams. Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery. Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving. Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements. Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences. Mindset Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative. Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security. Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts Bonus Points If You Have : Experience with AWS managed services. Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. What's In It For You: Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter. Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business. Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more. Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration. We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more! Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites. It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers. Tasks Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team Requirements Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B) Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously. Benefits Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo Employee stock options: you own part of what you build New office in Zürich Kreis 5 Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster Work directly with the founders Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Hoofd Servicemonteur Warmtepompen
description: Hoofd Servicemonteur Als Hoofd Servicemonteur ben jij het technische boegbeeld van onze serviceafdeling. Waar een reguliere servicemonteur de standaard onderhoudsbeurten en reparaties uitvoert, kom jij in beeld bij de complexe uitdagingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het optimaal laten draaien van onze vloot aan warmtepompen door heel Nederland. Je coacht je collega-monteurs in het veld en bent de schakel tussen de praktijk en ons engineering-team. Wat ga je doen? Specialistische Service: Je lost complexe, niet-alledaagse storingen op die een diepgaande analyse vereisen (zowel mechanisch, thermodynamisch als softwarematig). Technisch Coach: Je bent de achterwacht (2e lijns support) voor je collega-servicemonteurs. Als zij vastlopen in het veld, bellen ze jou voor technisch advies of kom je ter plaatse ondersteunen. Kwaliteitsbewaking: Je analyseert servicerapporten, signaleert terugkerende problemen en doet verbetervoorstellen om de betrouwbaarheid van onze systemen te verhogen. Customer Excellence: Je zorgt dat de servicebeleving voor onze klanten van topniveau is en traint je team in hoe zij klanten het beste kunnen adviseren over hun warmtepompsysteem. Feedbackloop: Je koppelt bevindingen uit het veld direct terug aan de productontwikkelaars in Den Haag om de volgende generatie warmtepompen nóg beter te maken. Wie zoeken wij? De Expert: Je hebt uitgebreide ervaring in het servicen van CV-installaties, koeltechniek of warmtepompen. Je leest technische schema’s als een krant. Analytisch: Je vindt het leuk om diep in de data en de techniek te duiken om de oorzaak van een probleem te vinden. Mentor-rol: Je krijgt er energie van om jouw kennis over te dragen aan minder ervaren collega's en hen te helpen groeien. Opleiding & Certificering: Een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding (Installatietechniek/Elektrotechniek). Communicatie: Je kunt complexe techniek simpel uitleggen aan zowel een klant als aan een meer junior collega. Wat bieden wij jou? Sleutelpositie: Een verantwoordelijke baan in de frontlinie van de energietransitie bij een ambitieuze scale-up. Ontwikkeling: Mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar Field Lead of Technisch Specialist binnen de R&D afdeling. Topmateriaal: Een luxe servicebus met de modernste meetinstrumenten en gereedschap. Cultuur: Werken bij een innovatieve werkgever met veel vrijheid, korte lijnen en een jong, gedreven team. Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een salaris dat recht doet aan jouw expertise en senioriteit (€3500-€5000), goede pensioenregeling en 38 vakantiedagen. Over DeWarmte Wij geloven dat verduurzaming makkelijker én slimmer kan. Met onze warmtepompen bieden we een innovatieve oplossing voor de Nederlandse huishoudens. Ons serviceteam is cruciaal voor het vertrouwen van de klant in deze nieuwe techniek. Compensation: €3.5K – €5K per month • €3.5K – €5K per month Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior-adviseur duurzaamheid en business development
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Jij maakt duurzaamheid concreet, creëert nieuwe kansen en vergroot de maatschappelijke impact van complexe projecten. Dit ga je doen bij Movares Jij adviseert opdrachtgevers over strategische duurzaamheidsvraagstukken binnen infrastructuur en de gebouwde omgeving. Je ontwikkelt marktgerichte proposities en zet kansen om in concrete opdrachten voor het team Duurzaamheid. Je deelt je kennis, begeleidt collega’s en vertegenwoordigt Movares tijdens congressen, seminars en branchebijeenkomsten. Als senior-adviseur combineer je inhoudelijk advies met business development. Ongeveer 50% van je tijd werk je aan complexe projecten rond bijvoorbeeld netcongestie, circulariteit, klimaatadaptatie, energietransitie, stikstof en natuurinclusieve ontwikkeling. title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. Who we’re looking for Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps. Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead. You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth. Strategy and leadership Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets. Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs. Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product. Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped. Technical SEO and architecture Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content. Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages. Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility. Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection. GEO Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages. Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment. Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves. Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms. Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks. Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready. Content and topical authority Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent. Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing. Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output. Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice. Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire. Measurement and reporting Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders. What success looks like Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets. A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors. The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility. Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. In terms of your experience and skills: Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment. Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed. A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking. A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale. A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps. Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings. A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership. A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment. Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams. Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools. Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have. Our offer A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home. A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time. A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do. Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform. A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500. A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role. A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance. An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience. The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year. An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day. Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page . We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Online Marketing | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
description: Wat ga je doen? Uitvoeren van zoekwoordenonderzoek en toepassen van SEO; Optimaliseren van webpagina's en verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring; Ondersteunen bij het opzetten en uitvoeren van online campagnes; Werken met website- en campagnedata om resultaten inzichtelijk te maken; Analyseren van het gedrag van websitebezoekers en de boekingsflow; Samenwerken met externe marketingpartners en leren werken met marketingbriefings. Praktisch Startdatum: februari 2027; Duur: minimaal 5 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep.
