title: Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (In-office / Hybrid)</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and discreet <strong>Executive & Personal Assistant</strong> to join our Founders’ Office support team. Based in either <strong>San Francisco</strong> or <strong>New York City</strong>, this role works in close alignment with two Senior Executive Business Partners who manage direct daily support for Cloudflare’s Co-Founders.</p> <p>This is a versatile, high-touch role combining executive administrative support, event coordination, personal projects, and lifestyle logistics. You will provide critical execution capacity behind the scenes—anticipating needs effortlessly, moving between business and personal requests seamlessly, and ensuring every detail is handled with precision, follow-through, and strict confidentiality.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Executive & Founder Support:</strong> Manage executive calendar coordination, meeting logistics, priority tracking, expense reports, and backup support alongside the Senior Executive Business Partners.</li> <li><strong>Travel & Itinerary Planning:</strong> Coordinate domestic and international executive and personal travel, including private aviation charters, luxury lodging, ground transportation, dining arrangements, and detailed door-to-door itineraries.</li> <li><strong>Events & Entertaining:</strong> Plan and execute private dinners, VIP hospitality, and personal events, managing venue sourcing, guest lists, menus, invitations, and on-site vendor logistics.</li> <li><strong>Personal & Lifestyle Support:</strong> Coordinate day-to-day personal logistics, appointments, dining reservations, executive gifting, wellness schedules, and ad-hoc errands.</li> <li><strong>Special Projects:</strong> Assist with special research, bespoke purchasing, prospective property coordination, and vendor oversight for home/office maintenance and seasonal projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, Founders, or UHNW individuals in a combined executive and personal assistant capacity.</li> <li><strong>Core Skills:</strong> Exceptional organization, eagle-eyed attention to detail, and proactive follow-through</li> <li><strong>Travel & Hospitality Expertise:</strong> Deep experience booking, managing, and troubleshooting travel, including private aviation charters and luxury accommodations. You offer a high-touch concierge service.</li> <li><strong>Professional Demeanor:</strong> Personable, polished, and collaborative, adept at partnering seamlessly with internal teams and external vendors, holding firm boundaries, and maintaining complete confidentiality</li> <li><strong>Technical Savvy:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace (G-Suite) alongside practical adoption of AI and modern productivity workflows.</li> </ul> <h2><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Compensation</strong></h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. </p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li>Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models</li> <li>Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)</li> <li>Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties</li> <li>Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)</li> <li>Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories</li> <li>Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)</li> <li>Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware</li> <li>Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data </li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .</li> <li><strong>3D Vision:</strong> Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .</li> <li><strong>Modern Deep Learning:</strong> Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)</li> <li><strong>Programming & Systems</strong>: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus</li> <li>Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Event & Content Managerin/Manager
description: Stell dir vor, du bist mittendrin: Du begleitest innovative Projekte für die Schweizer Armee, hältst spannende Geschichten in Bildern und Videos fest und bringst Menschen an inspirierenden Events zusammen. Als Event & Content Managerin/Manager bei den Swiss Innovation Forces machst du Innovation sichtbar und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen mit den passenden Inhalten erreichen. Gemeinsam leisten wir einen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zukunftsfähigkeit der Schweiz. Wie du zur Sicherheit der Schweiz beiträgst Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Organisation von Events (ca. 60%) und der Erstellung von Content (ca. 40%). Je nach Saison kann sich diese Aufteilung etwas verschieben. Dabei erwarten dich vielseitige Aufgaben: Du planst und organisierst inspirierende Events für die Schweizer Armee, von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung vor Ort. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Inhalte und Eventformate weiter, probierst Neues aus und misst ihren Erfolg. Du machst unsere Innovationsprojekte sichtbar und erstellst spannende Beiträge für LinkedIn, YouTube und unsere interne Kommunikation. Du entwickelst Ideen für neue Inhalte und setzt diese selbstständig um, von Texten über Fotos bis zu kurzen Videos. Du bist regelmässig in der Schweiz unterwegs, um unsere Projekte und die Menschen dahinter zu begleiten und ihre Geschichten festzuhalten. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Content für Social Media, insbesondere mit Texten, Fotografie und Videos. Einen sicheren Umgang mit gängigen Content- und AI-Tools; Erfahrung mit Grafikprogrammen wie Adobe ist ein Plus. Erfahrung und Freude im/am Organisieren von Events und daran, Menschen zusammenzubringen. Interesse an sicherheitspolitischen Themen und Neugier, dich in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten. Eine selbstständige, kreative und pragmatische Arbeitsweise. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und packst auch bei der Umsetzung mit an. Selbstreflexion und die Bereitschaft, dich weiterzuentwickeln. Worauf du dich verlassen kannst Ein Team, das dich unterstützt und dir psychologische Sicherheit bietet. Ein unternehmerisches Umfeld, wo du dich und deine Ideen einbringen kannst. Ein attraktives Salär und ein 2. Klasse-GA. Ein inspirierender Arbeitsplatz mit gutem Kaffee, zentral in Zürich und Bern. Bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Schweizer Armee zu gestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Egal, ob du Militärdienst geleistet hast oder nicht. Auch wenn du noch nicht alles zu 100 Prozent mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir bauen auf ein vielfältiges Team, in dem alle ihre Stärken ausspielen können. Auf ein Bewerbungsschreiben verzichten wir bewusst. Viel lieber möchten wir dich mit ein paar kurzen Fragen und einem Beispiel deiner bisherigen Arbeit kennenlernen. Reiche deine Bewerbung einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite ein oder melde dich bei Fragen direkt bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Customer Observability
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX |  New York, NY | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As the Engineering Manager for our Developer Observability Platform you will manage a high-velocity customer-obsessed team. Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place. </p> <p>The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. This is a high-visibility role that will be directly interfacing with some of our biggest customers.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver excellent customer outcomes above all else. Whatever is required - building, planning, deciding, designing, communicating - you are accountable and get it done.</p> </li> <li>Set the technical and product vision along with your PM and Engineers. Build the right thing at the right time.</li> <li> <p>Building an observability platform for the current AI driven ecosystem. Agents empower new types of platforms capabilities even as they require new types of observability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the operational aspects of your platform such as SLOs, incident response, customer escalations, and technical debt. Reliability is its own feature.</p> </li> <li> <p>Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers. We have a high bar and expect you to raise it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cultivate a team culture that values fast iteration, high agency, and ownership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with a range of platform and product teams to instrument and surface meaningful data in actionable ways.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>A minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 4 years managing software engineering teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record leading teams that have shipped and operated complex, large-scale systems and data-driven applications. Preferably in observability, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, edge/proxy systems, or high-scale APIs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant technical depth, with the ability to guide architectural discussions, make credible technical decisions, review designs, and unblock your team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough observability products to know what makes them delightful or painful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop senior engineers, and to build high-performing, inclusive teams that ship. You care about teams and team culture.</p> </li> <li> <p>A hands-on approach to leadership: you consider yourself a builder, stay close to the code, know the numbers, know the customer, and know what to build next.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points </strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Working on hosted customer-facing observability products</p> </li> <li> <p>Instrumenting observability in global-scale, production environments </p> </li> <li> <p>Implementing observability (OTLP, OLAP databases such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, etc)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building with Cloudflare’s Developer Platform and have opinions on where we could improve, especially with respect to observability.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For NY-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000 - €122,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Client Success Manager - Netherlands
description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members! We are looking for a Client Success Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise , outstanding client communication , and an AI-first mindset . This is a highly client-facing role : you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey. You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations. The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively , turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI , to work smarter, faster and with better insights. Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Client Communication & Relationship Management Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies Campaign Set-up & Coordination Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time Optimization & Performance Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams Reports, Presentations & Sales Support Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals AI-Powered Ways of Working Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation Collaboration & Administration Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration Handle client invoicing WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄 Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment. Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships. AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter. Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must. Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance. Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English. Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving. 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! NICE TO HAVE 🎆 Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion). LOCATION 🌐 While you need to be based in the Netherlands , you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective. WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results. Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better. Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition. Challenge with Empathy : We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Senior Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. </p> <p>You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. quality and accessibility.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.</li> <li>Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes.</li> <li>Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.</li> <li>Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Extensive proven working experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Data Scientist or a related position.</li> <li>Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.</li> <li>Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.</li> <li>Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.</li> <li>Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Fluent in English, both written and spoken.</li> <li>Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.</li> <li>Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. title: Legal Counsel
description: Position Overview Axelera AI is a fast-growing AI semiconductor company headquartered in Eindhoven, building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration hardware and software, from the Metis AI platform for edge inference to next-generation AI processing units. We are scaling quickly: new customers, new partners, new markets, and a growing volume of complex commercial deals across the global semiconductor supply chain. We are looking for an experienced commercial lawyer to be the engine of our commercial legal function. You will close deals, build the playbooks and processes that let the business move fast without taking on unmanaged risk, and lead how legal operates day to day, with AI in the loop so a lean team delivers more with less. This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape the function as it grows. Key responsibilities: Commercial contracting Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements: customer, distribution, reseller and OEM/ODM agreements; sales terms and EULAs; supply and manufacturing agreements (foundry, OSAT, component suppliers); technology and IP licences; software and SaaS agreements; evaluation, early access and development agreements; R&D collaboration and consortium agreements; services and vendor agreements; and MOUs, LOIs and partnership terms. Act as the trusted, pragmatic adviser to Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations and Finance, giving clear, commercial risk calls at pace. Advise on key semiconductor and AI issues: IP ownership and licensing, warranties and liability caps, product liability, export controls and sanctions, data protection and the EU AI Act. Support the CFO and Head of Legal on strategic matters, including corporate transactions and board-level work, as needed. Playbooks and scale Build AI-ready contract playbooks, fallback positions and approval matrices so AI tools and the business can handle routine deals with minimal Legal involvement. Create and own a library of standard templates for our core agreement types (e.g. NDA, customer terms, evaluation, distributor, supplier) aligned to our risk appetite. Train commercial teams on contract basics, negotiation positions and when to escalate to Legal. Legal operations Lead legal operations: intake and triage, prioritisation, SLAs and reporting on legal workload and turnaround. Own the legal tech and AI stack: select, implement and continuously improve AI review and drafting tools, CLM, e-signature and the contract repository, automating repeatable work end to end. Own contract lifecycle management, including obligation tracking, renewals and keeping contract records complete and up to date. Set up clear policies and processes that scale with the company. Collaboration Work alongside, supervise and mentor a Junior Legal Counsel, allocating work and reviewing output. Manage external counsel efficiently, including scope and budget, and determine which matters are best handled in-house. Report to the Head of Legal (in the interim, the CFO) and help shape the future structure of the legal team. Qualifications: Essential Qualified lawyer with 7+ years' PQE in commercial and corporate law, from a leading firm and/or in-house. Substantial in-house experience in tech, semiconductors, hardware or deep tech, ideally at a scale-up. A strong track record negotiating complex, high-value international contracts, including IP-heavy and supply chain deals. Hands-on use of AI tools in daily legal work, plus experience building playbooks and processes that let a small team scale. Commercial judgement that finds the route to yes, and the ability to explain risk simply to senior stakeholders. Comfort with ambiguity, high volume and shifting priorities. Fluent business English, our working and contract language. Desirable Semiconductor, AI or embedded systems experience (foundry, licensing, OEM deals). Knowledge of export controls (EU dual-use, US EAR), sanctions and the EU AI Act. Experience implementing CLM or AI contract tools, prompting, or building no-code automations. Experience mentoring junior lawyers, or exposure to venture-backed companies and governance. Dutch or another European language. How We Work: AI-First Legal We're building a lean legal function, not scaling by headcount. AI handles first-pass review, redlining, drafting and research, while lawyers focus on judgement and negotiation. Routine work is self-serve through templates and AI-assisted workflows. We measure turnaround and outcomes, and we use AI responsibly, with human review and clear guardrails on confidentiality and accuracy. Location Hybrid, with 2 days per week in our Amsterdam or Eindhoven office. What we offer This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares. An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI. Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. If you have been approached by someone on our behalf and want to confirm it’s legitimate, please contact us directly at Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking an exceptional new-logo builder to join our <strong>Named Sales Team</strong> as a <strong>Senior Named Account Executive</strong>. Your primary mission is new logo acquisition within an assigned portfolio of high-potential Named accounts: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with leading enterprises across Germany. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term platform partner. Developing and expanding a limited number of existing Named accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.</p> <p>As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will own your territory and assigned Named-account portfolio end-to-end. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform.</p> <p><strong>Named Account Planning:</strong> Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.</p> <p><strong>Complex Sales Cycle Leadership:</strong> Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency.</p> <p><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions.</p> <p><strong>Virtual Deal Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists to win complex, high-value opportunities. Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle.</p> <p><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research and prioritisation, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your Named-account management and customer engagement sharper and more effective.</p> <p><strong>Digital Transformation & AI Positioning:</strong> Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas.</p> <p><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline across your Named-account portfolio to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles.</p> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s business objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner.</p> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution:</strong> Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. title: Recruiter, R&D (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>Amsterdam, Netherlands and London, United Kingdom<br><br></p> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: 8 - 12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer </li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features

title: Mainframe Data Engineer - 3 to 6 Months Contract
description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-scale data engineering platforms within secure, on-premises and air-gapped environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience working with Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters , including installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and workload management in environments with restricted or no internet connectivity. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines. Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures. Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments. Preferred / Desirable Skills Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling. Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms. Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments. title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. title: Commercial Account Executive, META
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. Role Description Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s META growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular travel to the region, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building. What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does. You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it. In this role you will Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods. Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff. Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update. Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse. Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week. Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.
