title: Product Manager, Self-serve Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's self-serve business is the growth engine that powers millions of customers, ranging from solo developers to growing SMBs and larger companies. </p> <p>The Product Manager for Self-Serve Growth is a technical role that helps optimize and scale the experience for these customers. You will focus on the customer journey from awareness through retention, ensuring our users experience the value of Cloudflare as quickly as possible. This is a highly collaborative, visible, and analytical role that will build, ship, and move quickly without perfect information.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p><strong>Problems to work through</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Time to value:</strong> How do we get self-serve users from sign-up to their first successful outcome as fast as possible, reducing friction in their initial setup?</li> <li><strong>Conversion & Upgrade Paths:</strong> How do we help free-tier users naturally discover the value of our paid plans and seamlessly upgrade when the time is right?</li> <li><strong>Onboarding Optimization:</strong> Where are users dropping off in the registration and activation flow, and how can we redesign those steps to improve conversion rates?</li> <li><strong>Growth Experimentation:</strong> How do we design, launch, and measure A/B tests on pricing pages, billing flows, and in-app messaging to drive business metrics?</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Get Stuff Done: </strong>You are relentless at execution and driving things forward,  even in ambiguous situations. You balance what’s urgent with what’s important and love to ship.<br><strong>Growth Mindset & Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn, highly adaptable, and passionate about understanding how products grow. You proactively ask questions and absorb complex concepts quickly.<br><strong>Coding and AX/UX credibility</strong>: You build with a team of coding agents to ship everything from new features to bug fixes.<strong> </strong>You have an engineering background or understand the modern stack and customer/agent experiences well enough to hold your own with engineers.<br><strong>Analytical Foundation:</strong> You have a strong analytical baseline. You are comfortable diving into data to understand user behavior, and you can combine quantitative data with qualitative feedback to form hypotheses.<br><strong>Experimentation and Velocity:</strong> You are excited by the idea of A/B testing. You understand that not every hypothesis will be proven right, but you are eager to ship, measure, learn, and iterate – even if this means getting into very technical implementation.<br><strong>Customer Empathy:</strong> You can step into the shoes of a self-serve user and advocate for simple, intuitive experiences over complex technical hurdles.<br><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration:</strong> You communicate clearly and are excited to partner closely with engineering, design, and product marketing to bring features to the finish line.</p> <h3>Bonus Points:</h3> <ul> <li>At Cloudflare it’s pretty helpful to understand how the Internet really works at layers 2 through 7. If you don’t have this, be prepared to speak with mastery about another realm of similar complexity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $230,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Senior Delivery Consultant
description: Who we are Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Sigrid Core geeft organisaties continu inzicht in de kwaliteit, security en risico’s van hun volledige softwareportfolio, en borgt kwaliteitsstandaarden tot in de ontwikkelstraat. Sigrid Axis, gelanceerd in oktober 2026, brengt diezelfde standaarden naar AI coding agents: het controleert elke wijziging die een agent maakt in real time en verbetert bestaande code, zodat organisaties agentic engineering kunnen opschalen zonder grip te verliezen op kwaliteit, kosten en risico. Beide zijn gebouwd op ’s werelds grootste benchmark voor softwarekwaliteit, met meer dan 40.000 systemen en ruim 600 miljard regels code, en op ruim 25 jaar ervaring in het enige ISO/IEC 17025-geaccrediteerde lab voor softwarekwaliteit ter wereld. Samen met onze consultants vertalen we die inzichten naar strategisch en praktisch advies, zodat technologie een aanjager van succes is in plaats van een bron van risico. Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen. Where you come in Als Senior Delivery Consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze grootste klanten Sigrid succesvol inbedden in hun organisatie. Sigrid is geen tool die je even installeert: het is complexe software voor kwaliteitsmanagement die raakt aan de ontwikkelstraat, de architectuur, de securityprocessen en de besluitvorming van een organisatie. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Je werkt met technologie die vooroploopt, op het snijvlak van softwarekwaliteit en AI, bij organisaties die nu de stap zetten naar softwareontwikkeling met AI coding agents. Wat je bij hen implementeert, bepaalt mede hoe zij die stap veilig en beheerst kunnen maken. Je werkt voor grote corporate organisaties en overheidsinstellingen, vaak met honderden ontwikkelteams en duizenden applicaties. Dat betekent complexe trajecten met veel belanghebbenden: van CIO en CISO tot architecten, IT-beheer, inkoop en ontwikkelteams. Je brengt structuur aan in die complexiteit, houdt planning en scope in de hand, en houdt de vaart erin zonder mensen kwijt te raken. Je vertaalt de inzichten uit Sigrid naar rapportages en adviezen die passen bij je publiek. Een bestuurder wil weten waar de risico’s zitten, een architect wil technische schuld gericht aanpakken en een ontwikkelteam wil het dagelijkse werk verbeteren. Dezelfde data vertelt voor ieder van hen een ander verhaal, en jij weet die vertaalslag te maken. Intern noemen we deze rol Senior Guidance Consultant. Je maakt deel uit van ons Guidance-team: een klein, hands-on team van consultants dat nauw samenwerkt met onze Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, technische consultants en het productteam. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. Wat ga je doen Je leidt complete implementatietrajecten waarin Sigrid wordt ingebed in grote organisaties, zowel SaaS als on-premise: van projectplan en kick-off tot technische onboarding, training en overdracht. Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. Bij on-premise implementaties werk je samen met de infrastructuur- en securityteams van de klant en met onze technische consultants, zodat installatie, configuratie en integratie soepel verlopen. Je begeleidt ontwikkelaars, architecten, managers en bestuurders bij het adopteren van Sigrid en het verankeren ervan in hun processen. Je levert heldere rapportages en presentaties aan zowel management als technische doelgroepen, afgestemd op de doelen van de organisatie. Je helpt klanten bij de inzet van Sigrid Axis, zodat hun AI coding agents werken volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als hun ontwikkelteams. Je adviseert klanten over sturen op softwarekwaliteit, het beheersen van technische schuld en de verantwoorde inzet van AI in softwareontwikkeling. Je managet meerdere trajecten tegelijk, gestructureerd en pragmatisch, inclusief een nauwkeurige projectadministratie in ons CRM. Je ondersteunt salestrajecten met overtuigende productdemo’s en met je inbreng over implementatieaanpak en planning. Je draagt bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze implementatiemethodiek, onze Academy-content en de ondersteuning van partners die zelf Sigrid-implementaties uitvoeren. What's in it for you? Een betekenisvolle rol op het snijvlak van technologie, consultancy en organisatieverandering Directe impact bij enkele van de grootste organisaties van Nederland, in het bedrijfsleven en bij de overheid Een platte organisatie met ruimte voor ondernemerschap, initiatief en creativiteit Een grondig inwerkprogramma in onze tooling en methodiek, en ruimte voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling Flexibele werkafspraken en een betrokken team van hoog niveau Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een mobiele telefoon, MacBook en verzekeringen Wij geloven dat software beter kan en moet bijdragen aan de organisaties waarin het draait. Deel jij die overtuiging en wil je helpen die waar te maken? Dan horen we graag van je. title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. title: Marketing Manager, ANZ
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an enthusiastic B2B Enterprise marketing manager, who is dynamic, creative, and analytical. The individual has a track record of delivering creative and smashing programs that generate new prospects and grow the marketing revenue pipeline. This person will be dedicated to growing our businesses in ANZ across enterprise and public sector accounts. </p> <p>You will support the creation, launch, and execution of campaigns that span a variety of channels - email, social, and webinars as well as supporting end-to-end execution of our in-person and virtual events, either direct or with our partners. You have a natural inclination to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities, strong project management skills, and the ability to think strategically and orchestrate many moving parts. You must have strong working knowledge and expertise in demand generation marketing funnel and lead flows. The right candidate will have the ability to work cross-functionally with all teams in-region, across APAC and in headquarters in San Francisco. This is a regional role based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia. Market experience and expertise is required for this role.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Report into the Head of Marketing APAC, based in Singapore</li> <li>As the ANZ Enterprise marketing manager, you will plan, promote, and execute field marketing initiatives across the region that capture mindshare, drive prospects into customers and support Cloudflare customers on their journey to build and secure on Cloudflare.</li> <li>You will be accountable for online, trade shows, conferences, executive dinners, workshops, developing communities, and the full range of regional marketing tactics and execution for Australia across enterprise & public sector.</li> <li>Manage campaigns from strategic planning and execution to evaluation, ensuring smooth project management throughout. Oversee timelines, track ROI, and implement data-driven optimisations to continuously improve performance and communicate campaign results to key stakeholders.</li> <li>Work in cross-functional teams and collaborate closely with global & regional demand centre teams, the partner team, BDR, product marketing, sales, marketing operations, sales ops and others in the development, execution and measurement of high-impact integrated marketing campaigns (global or regional) that are optimised and relevant across the marketing mix - online, offline, ABM, communities and more.</li> <li>Align marketing initiatives to directly support sales objectives, focusing on full lead lifecycle and funnel management, from lead generation to opportunity progression and customer loyalty and expansion.</li> <li>Assess campaign performance using SFDC and Tableau reporting, evaluate ROI, and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 to 8 years proven experience in B2B marketing (enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, regional marketing and/or info security experience a plus)</li> <li>BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>On the digital side, you will be supporting our digital teams to help with execution and optimisation of online marketing campaigns across multiple channels (e.g. email, webinars, social media, etc.). </li> <li>Excellent channel experience working with partner marketing, distribution, resellers and systems integrators. </li> <li>In addition, you must have experience in planning, budgeting and managing trade shows, events, and conferences from start to finish</li> <li>Have proven track record of launching successful online and offline marketing campaigns and driving qualified leads in the funnel</li> <li>Strong project management/organisational skills and the ability to successfully manage multiple initiatives at once</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments in different time zones</li> <li>Results oriented with experience using qualitative and quantitative metrics with a focus on revenue, conversion, sales and other marketing goals</li> <li>Analytically inclined, exceptional organisational skills, with rigorous attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with tight deadlines</li> <li>Having a strong sense of curiosity and passion for learning</li> <li>Exhibit strong stakeholders’ management and communication skills</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and Tableau, will be an advantage.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high growth company in the SaaS, security, or network space, combined with knowledge of how the Internet works is a plus</li> <li>An established player in the business and marketing community with a strong business network which included media, marketing agencies, events organisers, social media platforms amongst others.  </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together. Our current tech includes: Data warehouse: BigQuery Ingestion: Stitch Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. The Team You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. Who you are You have owned analytics engineering work end to end. You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core). You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. How we hire There are four stages: 30-minute call with our recruiter. 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager. 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. What we have for you Competitive compensation 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you’ll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. About Talk360 Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ “Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: The Challenge Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. You're pragmatic. title: Senior Customer Service Leader
description: Jij bouwt aan sterke klantrelaties, creëert commerciële kansen en maakt het verschil met dienstverlening die resultaat oplevert. Krijg jij energie van strategisch klantmanagement, commerciële groei en het realiseren van duurzame klantwaarde? Als Customer Service Leader bij Centric ben jij de drijvende kracht achter succesvolle klantrelaties. Je verbindt klantambities met onze IT-expertise, stuurt op resultaat en weet commerciële kansen om te zetten in concrete groei. Je bent sparringpartner voor onze klanten, geeft richting aan multidisciplinaire teams en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het succes van onze dienstverlening. Een veelzijdige sleutelrol waarin ondernemerschap, klantgerichtheid en resultaat samenkomen. Werken bij Centric De kans is groot dat je Centric al kent, zonder dat je het weet. Bijvoorbeeld wanneer je betaalt in een winkel, kraanwater gebruikt of een paspoort aanvraagt. Dagelijks vertrouwen duizenden organisaties en miljoenen mensen op onze ruim 200 technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 professionals. Binnen Centric Services werk je samen met meer dan 900 collega's in Nederland, Litouwen en Roemenië. Als IT-partner van organisaties in onder meer de publieke, financiële, logistieke en industriële sector zorgen we ervoor dat hun dienstverlening blijft draaien. Van het gemeenteloket tot de bevoorrading van supermarkten. Bij Centric krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, impact te maken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Jouw rol als Customer Service Leader Jij bent hét gezicht van Centric bij jouw klanten en de verbindende schakel tussen klantstrategie en succesvolle dienstverlening. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de contracten, P&L, klanttevredenheid en commerciële groei. Je begrijpt wat klanten beweegt, denkt vooruit en vertaalt hun ambities naar concrete plannen en resultaten. Samen met accountmanagers, architecten, projectmanagers en beheerteams bouw je aan sterke klantrelaties, optimale dienstverlening en nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je houdt de regie, stuurt op resultaat en zorgt dat we onze klanten blijvend toegevoegde waarde bieden. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt samen met de accountmanager strategische accountplannen en stuurt op omzet, marge, groei en klantwaarde. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor contractmanagement, P&L, governance, rapportages en facturatie. Je bouwt aan duurzame klantrelaties en bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten en interne stakeholders. Je signaleert commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete voorstellen, offertes en contractuitbreidingen. Je verbindt en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams en zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking. Je neemt initiatief voor verbeteringen en klantgerichte innovaties die de dienstverlening versterken. Je bewaakt de klanttevredenheid en stuurt actief op kwaliteit, resultaat en continuïteit. Dit breng je mee Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner die commerciële kansen herkent, relaties weet te versterken en mensen in beweging krijgt. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met een resultaatgerichte aanpak en voelt je thuis in een complexe IT-omgeving. Daarnaast heb je: Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en minimaal 5 tot 8 jaar relevante werkervaring. Ruime ervaring met strategisch klant- en contractmanagement, P&L-sturing en commerciële groei binnen IT-dienstverlening. Ervaring met key-accountmanagement, accountplannen, forecasting en complexe stakeholdernetwerken. Het vermogen om klantbehoeften, organisatiedoelen en operationele mogelijkheden met elkaar te verbinden. Een ondernemende, analytische en resultaatgerichte instelling. Experience with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana or similar platforms. Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation and daily workflows. Communication & Organisation Fluent professional German and strong English communication skills. Excellent written communication and attention to detail. Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients. Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach. Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues. Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. title: Ketenregisseur | Directoraat-generaal Herstel Toeslagen

Binnen DGH richt de Taskforce Versnelling Bezwaren zich op het versnellen van de bezwaarafhandeling. Hiervoor moet de gehele keten optimaal functioneren. Als ketenregisseur bewaak je directieoverstijgend en doorlopend deze keten. Je haalt prioriteiten op en stemt deze af met de betrokken partijen. Je bewaakt doorlooptijden en voorraden binnen de keten. Je initieert en leidt het wekelijkse ketenoverleg en zorgt voor een heldere actie- en besluitenlijst. Je signaleert en escaleert knelpunten en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen worden geborgd. Je zorgt voor een actueel ketenoverzicht met afspraken en aanspreekpunten, een wekelijkse monitor en een duidelijke escalatieroute. Je zorgt voor een goede overdracht aan de lijn. Wat vragen wij? Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt kennis van beleidsvorming, governance en bestuurlijke samenwerking met inhoudelijke technische kwalificatie van schaderoutes. title: IT Specialist Frontend Platform
description: Wie ben jij Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT; ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer; ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure; praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS); ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling; kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace); ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen; kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen; affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID); ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen; je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen. Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend. Wat bieden wij Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern. Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis. Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning); 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld; variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38‑urige werkweek; goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling; thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding; korting op schade‑ en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. Drie focusgebieden De IT-organisatie is vanaf 1 januari 2025 ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders. Het team Frontend Platform Binnen Frontend Platform werken we aan het beheer en de continuïteit van platformen die direct bijdragen aan de digitale dienstverlening van Univé. Daarbij werken we nauw samen met DevOps‑teams, architectuur, security, leveranciers en andere platformteams. Het team richt zich onder andere op: Frontend- en webplatformen; Microsoft Azure en Kubernetes (AKS); Monitoring en observability; Secrets- en toegangsbeheer; DNS, gateways en integraties; De platformen onder onze apps en lowcode platformen; Dynamics/CRM gerelateerde platformonderdelen; Digitale kanalen zoals voice, chat, mail en websites. title: Meewerk- of afstudeerstage Verzekeringen
description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar het MKB en wil je ontdekken hoe zakelijke verzekeringen in de praktijk werken? Vanaf februari 2027 kun je stage lopen bij het MKB team van Univé Zuid-Nederland. Je kijkt mee met onze zakelijke adviseurs, leert hoe we ondernemers helpen bij hun verzekeringsvragen en steekt zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Een mooie kans om werkervaring op te doen, nieuwe mensen te leren kennen en te ontdekken waar jouw talent ligt! Wie ben jij Je bent een enthousiaste student die graag leert door te doen. Je vindt het interessant om te ontdekken wat ondernemers bezighoudt en hoe je hen verder kunt helpen. Je stelt vragen, luistert goed en durft initiatief te nemen. Ervaring met verzekeringen is niet nodig: nieuwsgierigheid en de wil om te leren vinden we belangrijker. Of je nu vooral wilt meelopen of juist actief wilt meewerken, je denkt graag mee en werkt zorgvuldig samen met anderen. Daarnaast breng je mee: Je volgt een Mbo 4 of Hbo opleiding waarbij een meewerk- of afstudeerstage past. Je kunt vanaf februari 2027 met je stage beginnen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar het MKB en verzekeringen. Je vindt het leuk om met mensen in contact te zijn. Je communiceert helder en gaat zorgvuldig met informatie om. Je neemt initiatief, stelt vragen en staat open voor feedback. Wat ga je doen Tijdens jouw stage maak je kennis met onze zakelijke afdeling MKB. Je ontdekt hoe we ondernemers adviseren over bedrijfsrisico's en passende verzekeringen. Je kijkt mee bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze zakelijke adviseurs en leert hoe een klantvraag van eerste contact tot opvolging wordt opgepakt. Je staat er niet alleen voor: collega's nemen je mee in hun werk en helpen je de zakelijke verzekeringswereld te leren kennen. Je krijgt ruimte om vragen te stellen en mee te denken over hoe we onze leden nog beter kunnen ondersteunen. Zoek je vooral een oriënterende meeloopstage of wil je tijdens een meewerkstage zelfstandig taken oppakken? We bespreken samen welke invulling het beste aansluit bij jouw opleiding. Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden: Je kijkt mee met zakelijke adviseurs en leert hoe klantgesprekken worden voorbereid en opgevolgd. Je ondersteunt, onder begeleiding, bij het verzamelen en verwerken van klantinformatie. Je helpt waar passend bij offertes, klantdossiers en andere werkzaamheden binnen het MKB-team. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen in de dienstverlening aan ondernemers en werkt aan je leerdoelen. Wat wij bieden Bij Univé Zuid-Nederland krijg je de kans om ervaring op te doen in een betrokken team en te ontdekken hoe de zakelijke verzekeringsmarkt werkt. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op: Een meeloop- of meewerkstage met start in februari 2027. Een stagevergoeding voor €500,- per maand. Een kijkje achter de schermen bij ons MKB-team en onze zakelijke dienstverlening. De kans om mee te kijken met adviseurs en, waar passend, zelf taken op te pakken. Praktijkervaring met klantcontact, samenwerking en het ondersteunen van ondernemers. Ruimte om vragen te stellen, mee te denken en jouw talenten te ontdekken. Aandacht voor jouw leerdoelen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wie wij zijn Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
description: We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience. Responsibilities & Tasks Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures. Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies. Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls. Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights. Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk. Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers. Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable. Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures. Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment. Requirements & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience. At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field. Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience. Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools. Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage. Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial. Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers. High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility. Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage. Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually. Benefits & Culture Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role. Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making. Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas. Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment. Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications. Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance. Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: AI Software Architect
description: We are currently looking for an experienced AI Software Architect to join our client, a world-leading high-end CAE software company, and contribute to the development of its next-generation application platform. You will play a key role in shaping the architecture, engineering standards and development practices required to build and operate scalable AI-powered applications. In this position, you will work closely with product and platform engineering teams, helping them turn machine learning models into maintainable production applications. Combining strong software engineering expertise with a pragmatic architectural mindset, you will establish reusable solutions, improve integration with the AI platform and support teams in making sound technical decisions. Responsibilities & Tasks Define and establish practical application architecture patterns and interfaces for integrating machine learning models, data processing and inference capabilities into product applications. Support product and platform teams in developing scalable, maintainable and production-ready AI-powered applications. Drive cross-team architectural decisions through focused architecture reviews, technical prototypes and hands-on engineering guidance. Identify opportunities to develop and share reusable software components, whether based on existing open-source solutions or internally developed technologies. Promote consistent engineering practices, ensuring shared components have clear ownership, automated testing and well-defined, compatible interfaces. Work closely with product and platform engineers to translate concrete application requirements into prioritised platform capabilities and technical improvements. Evaluate existing solutions and identify opportunities to build on established components rather than introducing unnecessary complexity. Support knowledge sharing and collaboration across engineering teams, helping establish common standards and proven approaches for AI application development. Contribute to the continuous evolution of the application platform and its architecture as machine learning becomes more deeply integrated into AutoForm’s products. Requirements & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Natural Sciences or a comparable discipline; equivalent practical experience is also considered. Several years of professional experience in software engineering, including responsibility for the architecture and design of production software. Practical experience integrating machine learning models into production applications. Strong understanding of software architecture, application design and the development of maintainable, scalable software solutions. Experience defining reusable application patterns, interfaces and engineering standards across multiple teams. Pragmatic approach to software design, with a focus on maintainability, simplicity and meaningful reuse. Ability to assess technical solutions, identify opportunities for improvement and make architecture decisions that balance long-term quality with practical delivery needs. Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to guide engineers, facilitate technical discussions and promote collaboration across teams. Proactive and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move between architectural concepts and practical implementation. Fluent English is required; German language skills are considered an advantage. Benefits & Culture Join a world-leading, high-end CAE software company operating at the forefront of automotive technology. Take on a technically influential role, shaping the architecture and engineering practices behind next-generation AI-powered applications. Work with cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning and cloud applications. Collaborate with international product and platform engineering teams in a respectful and knowledge-driven environment. Benefit from continuous professional development, training and opportunities to expand your technical expertise. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Stagiair Accountmanagement & Customer Success (MKB)
description: Ben jij commercieel, houd je van aanpakken en wil je jouw eigen klantenbestand runnen? Dan zoeken wij jou! Bij Lease a Bike hebben we één grote missie: heel werkend Nederland op de fiets krijgen. Wil jij hieraan bouwen en werkend Nederland groener, gezonder en fitter maken? Sales haalt de bedrijven binnen, daarna begint het werk voor jou. Als Stagiair Accountmanagement & Customer Success beheer jij onze zakelijke klanten in het MKB-segment (bedrijven van 20 tot 49 werknemers). Je krijgt energie van direct klantcontact en hebt de commerciële drive om proactief de relatie met de bedrijven niet alleen goed te houden, maar ook te verbeteren. Klaar om vanaf dag één jouw eigen MKB-portfolio te managen binnen een razendsnelle scale-up? Join the ride! Wat ga je doen? Je komt te werken in het Customer Success-team, dit team bestaat uit 6 energieke collega’s en is verantwoordelijk voor het accountmanagement van de aangesloten bedrijven. Wij zijn onderdeel van Lease a Bike Nederland met in totaal bijna 60 medewerkers. Sinds 2020 zijn we van start-up uitgegroeid tot een internationale scale-up met meer dan 450 medewerkers in zes landen en in Nederland zijn we zelfs marktleider! Binnen ons team ga jij zelfstandig aan de slag met accountmanagement voor jouw eigen MKB-segment. Dit is wat je te wachten staat: Jouw eigen MKB-klantenbestand runnen: Jij bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor bedrijven met 20 tot 49 medewerkers. Hierbij zorg je voor Een vlekkeloze onboarding van de bedrijven die aangesloten moeten worden, Het verder activeren van de al aangesloten bedrijven; Medewerkers enthousiasmeren: Je bedenkt en lanceert creatieve promotieacties bij én met jouw klanten, zoals een kick-off event bij een bedrijf, zodat zoveel mogelijk werknemers de auto laten staan en op de leasefiets stappen; Doorontwikkelen en optimaliseren: Je bouwt mee aan ons Learning Center, landingspagina’s en verbetert de huidige workflow om de customer journey nóg slimmer in te richten; Kansen spotten: Je hebt een commerciële mindset en klimt direct in de telefoon om geen kans onbenut te laten. Meebouwen aan de scale-up: Je werkt nauw samen met Sales en Marketing, wat zorgt voor een constante stroom aan inspiratie én een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende organisatie. Wat verwachten wij? Binnen Lease a Bike staat snel schakelen centraal: een bedrijf dat vandaag tekent, kan volgende week al op de fiets zitten. Jij krijgt energie van snelheid, werkt gestructureerd en durft beslissingen te nemen. Gaat het een keer niet helemaal zoals gepland? Dan trek je op tijd aan de bel en denken we samen in oplossingen. Je volgt een studie, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, communicatie of een andere studie waar jouw commerciële en klantgerichte talent tot zijn recht komt; Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar voor een periode van tenminste 5 maanden (startdatum in overleg); Commerciële drive & assertief: Je vindt het leuk om via de telefoon mensen te overtuigen en weet klanten op een enthousiaste manier in beweging te krijgen; Creatief brein: Een pakkende mail schrijven, een actie bedenken of een proces verbeteren? Jij ziet overal kansen; Teamplayer: Bij ons staat samenwerken centraal, want samen zorgen we ervoor dat zoveel mogelijk mensen op de fiets stappen. Daarnaast maken we er samen het leukste van op kantoor. Met jou samenwerken is een feestje, omdat de gezelligheid en het teamgevoel ervan afspat. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt voor jouw eigen klanten, bieden we je natuurlijk nog veel meer: Volledige verantwoordelijkheid: Geen koffiehaal-stage, maar jouw eigen MKB-segment én de ruimte om mee te denken over onze Customer Success-strategie; Een jong, ambitieus team waarin veel ruimte is voor gezelligheid en persoonlijke groei; Een mooie stagevergoeding van €500 per maand (o.b.v. fulltime) en 6 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. een half jaar); Elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor met je collega’s; De mogelijkheid om mee te doen aan Pon Fit (hét gezondheidsprogramma van Pon) en je te ontwikkelen via onze Winter- en Summerlabs ; Ambitie om na je stage te blijven? Geen probleem! Je stapt in op een geweldig moment om mee te groeien met de organisatie. Solliciteren zonder gedoe! Wij geloven niet in lange, stoffige motivatiebrieven. Overtuig ons liever op jouw manier! Klik op de sollicitatieknop en stuur je CV mee met een korte pitch (max. 5 zinnen) waarin je vertelt hoe jij een bedrijf van 35 medewerkers enthousiast maakt om op de fiets te stappen. Liever een kort spraakbericht of video sturen? App hem direct naar Siebe! Heb je eerst nog een vraag? Bel of app Siebe Reinders (Customer Success Manager) op +316 33 01 30 14 of mail naar . Sollicitatieproces: We houden het lekker snel. Jouw sollicitatie bestaat uit één kennismakingsgesprek met Siebe of Joep (beide Customer Success Manager). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Federal Account Executive, DHS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (Federal Government) ; DHS sales experience required (but open to other Fed agency sales experiences as well)</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to the Federal customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Washington DC, based hires: The expected salary range for this role is $269,000 - $370,000,  depending on experience and qualifications. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

You write clearly and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written; French or Dutch is also preferred. You produce work that serves as a reference for your colleagues.
