title: Senior ML Engineer
description: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival. We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies. The Role You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will: Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven What We're Looking For Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience Language: English. The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Compensation: Competitive salary + equity. Location: Zurich HQ Apply Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Commerce
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet <strong>payable</strong> by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.</li> <li>Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or payment platforms, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (like digital wallets, payment protocols, and web authorization) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with emerging agentic/machine-to-machine payment edge computing architectures.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based billing, title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT US: Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace. We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists. The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room. The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing. - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t. - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup. - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field. - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping. - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same - Agents are already part of how you build. You’ve gone beyond autocomplete. You can show us workflows you’ve put together, what they do on their own, how you check their work, and what you’ve learned when they go wrong. We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Named Account Executive (AI & Digital Natives)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Atlanta, Georgia</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise AI and Digital Natives segment is Cloudflare's fastest growing and highest visibility market. This segment is dedicated exclusively to the largest organizations in the modern tech economy including premier SaaS platforms, hyperscale digital marketplaces, and leading AI labs. This is a deep infrastructure, developer centric play where technical alignment and deep engineering partnerships are our most critical currencies, resulting in Cloudflare’s largest and most complex enterprise agreements.</p> <p>Digital Native AEs at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in North America. In targeting high-growth, technologically advanced, and venture-backed companies, AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within the digital native segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Digital Native accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS</li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative</li> <li>Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.</p> </li> <li> <p>Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.</p> </li> <li> <p>Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.</p> </li> </ul> <p>What we're looking for</p> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.</p> </li> <li> <p>8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.</p> </li> <li> <p>A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus points</p> <ul> <li> <p>You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.</p> </li> <li> <p>You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Spain
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. title: Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer, Cloudflare One - Russian or Hebrew speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: London, UK or Munich, Germany or Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to navigate the entire customer journey, from initial discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept and implementation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Serve as a trusted technical advisor</strong> to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges</strong> by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.</li> <li><strong>Guide qualified prospects</strong> through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with sales partners</strong> to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>Analyze customer IT landscapes</strong> and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.</li> <li><strong>Clearly articulate the benefits</strong> and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Enhance customer retention</strong> by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Product Teams</strong> by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <p>Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences.</p> <p><strong>Key Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers:  Securing employee AI tool usage,  Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools</li> <li>Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and mitigation strategies.</li> <li>Fundamental knowledge of customer network and application architectures, including hybrid environments leveraging public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Solid grasp of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew</li> <li>Proficiency with networking fundamentals, including routing, subnetting, VPNs, and SD-WAN concepts.</li> <li>Understanding of AI agentic architecture and the security requirements and challenges in implementation at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with client operating system fundamentals and software distribution methods.</li> <li>Knowledge of the competitive landscape for CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions.</li> <li>Direct experience with Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions (Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation) is a significant plus.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize effectively among competing goals.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Spain based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €79,000 - €124,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,2,0">For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €116,000 - €182,000.</p> </li> <li> <p Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to shape Monzo’s international expansion strategy and play a key role in launching borrowing the next generation of markets. Sitting at the intersection of borrowing, operations, and execution, you’ll help identify where Monzo expands next and define how we successfully enter and scale credit in new geographies.</p> <p>As a Borrowing Strategy & Operations Manager, you’ll lead high-impact work across market assessment, customer and competitive insights, local borrowing strategy, regulatory setup, and launch execution. You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders across Borrowing, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Legal and Risk  to solve complex problems and build scalable market-entry playbooks.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone with strong credit expertise, structured problem-solving skills and a bias for execution - someone excited by the challenge of building new markets from the ground up in a fast-moving, highly regulated environment.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Setting the vision for borrowing local features, understanding how it connects to Monzo’s expansion goals</li> <li>Building the local borrowing proposition with world-class customer experiences in mind, understanding the full credit lifecycle of a customer</li> <li>Defining, prioritising, and communicating short, mid, and long-term project goals for the product and market</li> <li>Working with the borrowing collective and with marketing to create a high-conversion funnel and offering acceptance rate</li> <li>Ensuring high customer satisfaction related to understanding and experience within the borrowing products segment</li> <li>Establishing reliable and reputable third-party partnerships and regulators</li> <li>Ensuring zero tolerance of any compliance issue or breach of regulatory requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building products and/or features in retail or business borrowing</li> <li>Broad knowledge of risk management principles</li> <li>You have experience from a top-tier management consultancy, investment firm, strategy team, and/or a high-growth international fintech or technology company</li> <li>You’ve worked on launching or scaling credit products and operations within European markets</li> <li>You have strong knowledge of credit products, local banking infrastructure, and financial operations in EU</li> <li>You’re highly analytical and data-driven, with experience using data to define opportunities, prioritise initiatives, measure impact, and support decision-making</li> <li>You’re able to break down complex, ambiguous problems into clear frameworks and actionable plans</li> <li>You’re intellectually curious, commercially minded, and motivated by the opportunity to build and scale new markets from the ground up</li> <li>You’re an excellent communicator and storyteller, able to influence and align stakeholders around a common vision</li> <li>You’re humble, fast-learning, and excited by solving hard problems in a high-growth environment</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! title: Internal Communications Internship
description: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. As our Internal Communications Intern, you’ll join our Marketing & Communications team and help keep colleagues across SkyNRG informed, connected and engaged. Working closely with our PR & Communications Manager and teams across the business, you’ll create engaging content, support internal campaigns and events, and help improve the channels and tools we use to communicate. Your Responsibilities Content creation: Draft and publish newsletters, intranet articles, announcements, interviews, employee stories and leadership updates. Employee engagement: Support internal campaigns, company events and town halls that connect and engage colleagues across SkyNRG. Channels & tools: Maintain internal communication channels and content calendars and help improve the processes and tools behind them. Collaboration: Work with teams across the organization to gather information and turn it into clear and engaging communication. Insights & improvement: Monitor engagement and use insights to continuously improve our internal communications. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Current Bachelor’s or Master’s studies in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business or a related field, with enrollment for the full duration of the internship. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create clear and engaging content. Strong interest in internal communications, employee engagement and organizational culture. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with colleagues across different teams. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint and SharePoint. Full-time availability for a 6-month internship from 15 February 2027 onwards. About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. Besides that, we offer: A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation. An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Dutch speaking/ Nederlandstalig)
description: Over de rol 🎯 Als Senior Customer Success Manager bij DataSnipper zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten hun doelen bereiken met onze innovatieve, AI-gedreven oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de klantreis, van onboarding tot langdurige waardecreatie en retentie, en bouwt sterke relaties op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je helpt klanten sneller waarde te halen uit onze producten en draagt bij aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf. Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om nauw samen te werken met professionals die de wereldwijde kapitaalmarkten draaiende houden, door uitzonderlijke service te leveren en een actieve en betrokken community voor onze klanten op te bouwen. Word jij enthousiast van Customer Success en pak je graag zelf de regie? Dan horen we graag van je! Over DataSnipper Wij geloven dat vertrouwen essentieel is voor hoe de samenleving werkt. Elke dag vertrouwen we op informatie die onafhankelijk is gecontroleerd, van jaarrekeningen tot de producten die we kopen en de duurzaamheidsclaims van bedrijven. Achter dat vertrouwen staan audit- en financeprofessionals die bewijs onderzoeken, informatie verifiëren en organisaties ter verantwoording roepen. Bij DataSnipper bouwen we AI-oplossingen waarmee deze professionals die beoordelingen kunnen maken. Met Alwin by DataSnipper, ons nieuwe agentic platform, nemen AI-agents audit- en financeprocedures van begin tot eind over, terwijl elke conclusie terug te voeren is op de bron. Zo houden professionals ruimte voor het oordeelsvermogen en de expertise die hun werk zo belangrijk maken. Meer dan 600.000 professionals bij ruim 3.000 organisaties in 175 landen vertrouwen op ons platform. Daaronder vallen Fortune 500-bedrijven, overheidsinstanties en alle Big Four-accountantskantoren. Alleen al in 2025 leverde DataSnipper zijn klanten een productiviteitswinst op ter waarde van meer dan 1,4 miljard dollar. Met een Series B-financieringsronde van 100 miljoen dollar onder leiding van Index Ventures, bij een waardering van 1 miljard dollar, leggen we een solide basis voor onze volgende groeifase. Als lid van 1% for the Planet kijken we niet alleen naar hoe snel we groeien, maar ook naar hoe we groeien. Voor onze Customer Success-teams wordt het nu extra spannend. Alwin is net gelanceerd, de vraag groeit en we breiden uit naar nieuwe markten en segmenten. Met een product waar klanten al op vertrouwen, heb je de kans om echt je stempel te drukken op de volgende stap. Wat ga je doen Trusted Advisor zijn: Je bent een strategische partner voor belangrijke beslissers, zoals auditpartners en -managers, controllers, finance directors en IT-besluitvormers, en begeleidt hen bij de transformatie van hun organisatie met DataSnipper. Business transformatie aanjagen: Je helpt klanten hun workflows en processen opnieuw uit te vinden en laat zien hoe de AI-mogelijkheden van DataSnipper meetbaar bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kostenbesparing en kwaliteit binnen audit en finance. Strategische, consultatieve oplossingen bieden: Je denkt mee over de uitdagingen van elke klant en vertaalt dat naar praktisch advies, zodat zij hun audit- en financeworkflows optimaliseren en hun strategische doelen bereiken met DataSnipper. Klanten helpen om meer waarde uit DataSnipper te halen: Je geeft uitgebreide trainingen, organiseert regelmatige Business Reviews en ontwikkelt succesplannen, zodat klanten de functionaliteiten van DataSnipper omarmen en aantoonbare waarde halen uit ons platform. Hechte klantrelaties opbouwen: Je bouwt sterke, langdurige partnerschappen op basis van vertrouwen, diepgaand inzicht in de sector en oprechte betrokkenheid bij het succes en de resultaten van je klanten. Over teams heen samenwerken: Je werkt samen met Product, Engineering, Sales en Solutions Engineering en deelt klantinzichten over workflowuitdagingen, use cases en technische vereisten om productinnovatie te stimuleren. De stem van je klant zijn binnen DataSnipper: Je begrijpt de auditmethodologie, compliance-eisen en bedrijfsdoelen van je klanten goed en geeft feedback intern door, zodat DataSnipper antwoord geeft op echte behoeften uit de praktijk. Strategische groei ondersteunen: Je signaleert en realiseert uitbreidingskansen binnen je portefeuille. Samen met Sales toon je de ROI aan, faciliteer je pilots en vergroot je de adoptie binnen teams en service lines. Zorgen voor soepele technische implementatie en fungeren als platformexpert: Je ondersteunt klanten bij onboarding, inclusief setup, AI-configuratie en het op maat maken van workflows, en blijft up-to-date met het platform van DataSnipper, de AI-mogelijkheden en best practices voor automatisering. Strategische sessies leiden: Je plant en faciliteert persoonlijke en virtuele sessies met audit- en financeteams om adoptie te stimuleren. Daarnaast deel je best practices voor een succesvolle transformatie en pak je uitdagingen aan die het klantbehoud in gevaar kunnen brengen. Heldere succesplannen opstellen: Je maakt strategische roadmaps voor elke klant met transformatiedoelen, adoptiemijlpalen, uitbreidingskansen, engagementtactieken en succesmetrics. Health en business impact monitoren: Je volgt en voorspelt belangrijke metrics, zoals gebruikersengagement, featuregebruik, geleverde bedrijfswaarde, uitbreidingskansen, retentierisico's en technische health-indicatoren. Wat breng je mee Customer Success-ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting of een andere customer-facing functie in B2B SaaS, met een goed begrip van de customer success-aanpak (onboarding, adoptie, verlengingen en uitbreiding). Trusted Advisor-mindset: Passie om een strategische partner voor klanten te zijn, duurzame relaties op basis van vertrouwen op te bouwen en transformatie aan te jagen die uitzonderlijke waarde levert. Focus op business transformatie: Aantoonbaar vermogen om klanten te helpen hun processen en workflows opnieuw te bekijken en te laten zien hoe technologie meetbare bedrijfsresultaten oplevert. Verantwoordelijkheid en ownership: Een sterk gevoel van ownership en de drive om je vak te beheersen, initiatief te nemen en te zorgen dat geen details over het hoofd worden gezien. Samenwerkingsgeest: Je werkt graag samen met andere teams en bouwt waardevolle partnerschappen op met klanten en interne stakeholders. Flexibiliteit en groeimindset: Je leert snel en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving met een hoog tempo, waarin klantbehoeften en prioriteiten blijven veranderen. Uitstekende communicatie: Professionele beheersing van het Engels en Nederlands is een must. Auditachtergrond: Werkervaring binnen externe of interne audit of assurance is een pre. Wat bieden wij Je maakt deel uit van een van de snelstgroeiende, winstgevende unicorn-scale-ups van Nederland met wereldwijde impact. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights), zodat je meedeelt in het succes en de groei van het bedrijf. Een pensioenregeling met een bijdrage van 6% bovenop je basissalaris. 28 vakantiedagen per jaar (fulltime) voor een goede werk-privébalans. Hybride werken, met minimaal 3 dagen per week op kantoor in ons dynamische kantoor in Amsterdam. Dagelijks vers bereide lunches om je energiek te houden. Een NS Business Card voor makkelijk reizen naar kantoor. Een gestructureerd onboardingprogramma waarmee je een sterke start maakt, inclusief gereserveerde tijd om ons product en onze klanten te leren kennen voordat je écht begint. Toegang tot doorlopende leer- en ontwikkelinitiatieven om je vaardigheden te laten groeien. Werk samen met een levendig internationaal team verspreid over zeven kantoren wereldwijd. title: Chief Financial Officer
description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally! title: wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken? Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? Dit is jouw uitdaging Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden: Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen. Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken. Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan? Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen! Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: Statistiek; Python en/of R; Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers. Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot; ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten; leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python; jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Financial Analytics
description: Onze missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden LOGEX ontvangt elke maand data vanuit ziekenhuizen. Wij hebben een grotendeels geautomatiseerd proces om op basis van de data van het ziekenhuis periodieke analyses uit te voeren en de resultaten op te leveren aan de klant. Na de oplevering kunnen de ziekenhuizen via ons online platform op een interactief dashboard de resultaten inzien. Naast het interactieve dashboard leveren we ook detail informatie op richting deze ziekenhuizen. Elke oplevering kent echter ook maatwerk: Is de data correct ingeladen? Zijn de uitkomsten betrouwbaar? Zijn alle onderdelen van het interactieve dashboard goed gevuld? Sluiten de cijfers tussen de detailinformatie in het interactieve dashboard op elkaar aan? Welke aandachtspunten moeten we communiceren richting het ziekenhuis? Jouw rol is om het gehele proces te bewaken van de data aanlevering tot de uitkomsten in het interactieve dashboard. Jij zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat alle ziekenhuizen periodiek inzicht hebben in hun financiële resultaten. Het team Het Financial Analytics-team – momenteel ~40 mensen – groeit snel en is in volle gang. Het team is primair verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van financiële planning en controle van ziekenhuizen door hen met tools te ondersteunen bij o.a. duurzame portfoliobeslissingen, operationele processen en financiële overeenkomsten. Mede gedreven door de demografische ontwikkeling is er (reeds langere tijd) een sterke stijging van de zorgkosten. Om deze stijgende kosten onder controle te houden, is het essentieel om strategische portfoliobeslissingen te nemen, efficiënte zorg te bieden en duurzame financiële controle te behouden. De tools van het Financial Analytics team bieden hiervoor oplossingen. Jouw profiel Kan jij de onderstaande vragen met “ja” beantwoorden, dan is deze functie zeker wat voor jou! Doe jij een technische HBO of universitaire bachelor? Ben jij voor minimaal 9 maanden, 2 dagen per week beschikbaar? Haal jij energie uit het perfectioneren en blijven optimaliseren van doorlopende processen? Kan jij je goed vastbijten in een technische uitdaging tot jij de oplossing gevonden hebt? Vind je het gaaf om de verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor de financiële inzichten, voorspellingen en doelmatigheidsdoorlichtingen van een groot aantal ziekenhuizen? Maak jij graag deel uit van een jong en enthousiast team? Ben je resultaatgericht, met een gestructureerde manier van werken en een pragmatische mentaliteit? Schrijf en spreek je vloeiend Nederlands en Engels? Waarom LOGEX? Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen Contact ons! Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande knop en je CV uploaden. Voor meer informatie, of als je vragen hebt, kun je contact opnemen met Wesley Schreuder via Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Copywriter
description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Every email, push notification and in-app message we send should feel like it was written for the person reading it, not for us. Right now, nobody owns that. That’s where you come in. As our Copywriter, you will own every message our users get across email, push and in-app, plus the updates they read when something goes wrong. AI will write most of the first drafts. You’ll build the system that writes them, judge what it gets wrong, and add the creative edge AI always misses. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the words our users read every day. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and improve AI copywriting agents for email, push and in-app, and feed your edits back in so their output keeps getting better. Turn every draft into copy that starts from the user’s world, not ours (“your rate just jumped to 3.01%” instead of “we increased your rate”), with hooks, subject lines and tone that make people act. Own the moments that matter most, from the messages users see before they leave to incident banners and status page updates, and write the one-off copy the system can’t produce. Your English is fluent at a professional level, and your grammar and spelling are spotless. Native or near-native is a plus. You’ve built or improved AI agents or prompts that produce copy, and you know how to fix them when the output drifts. You write creative, user-first copy that gets people to open, click and act. You’ve turned briefs into finished copy across multiple channels, on time. Lifecycle or CRM experience is a bonus. You’re reachable outside working hours when our users need to be informed of an ongoing incident. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. Your space to perform We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪 🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset 👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly. 📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget 🇧🇬 Flex Benefits: €70 monthly budget via Re: benefit, offering access to 150+ perks tailored to your lifestyle. 🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳) (in the Netherlands) 🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration 🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office. 💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us 🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options 💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq (in the Netherlands) ⚕️ Private health insurance, just in case (in Turkey or Bulgaria) 🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually (in the Netherlands) 🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description: Over Jumbo Group: De wereld van Jumbo Group is gevuld met spelletjes, puzzels en speelgoed die vreugde verspreiden en creativiteit over de hele wereld stimuleren. Met bekende merken zoals Stratego, Party & Co, Jan van Haasteren-puzzels en natuurlijk het fantastische merk Hitster, geven ze de ‘Kracht om te Spelen’ vrij om overal betekenisvolle verbindingen te creëren. De kernwaarden van het bedrijf zijn betrokkenheid, teamwork, wereldwijd denken en vertrouwen. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, open en nuchter. Functieomschrijving Als Accounts Receivable Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol binnen de financiële organisatie en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het optimaal beheren van de debiteurenportefeuille. Je draagt bij aan een gezonde cashflow door betalingsprocessen effectief te bewaken, kredietrisico’s te beheersen en tijdig actie te ondernemen waar nodig. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende interne afdelingen, waaronder Sales en Customer Service, en fungeert als een belangrijke schakel tussen financiële en operationele processen. Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, nauwkeurige werkwijze en proactieve houding draag je bij aan het verder optimaliseren van het order-to-cash proces en ondersteun je de organisatie bij het realiseren van haar financiële doelstellingen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Verwerken van dagelijkse bankmutaties Onderzoeken en opvolgen van factuurafwijkingen en openstaande posten. Schakelen met Sales en Customer Service om geblokkeerde orders (orders in wacht) snel op te lossen. Opstellen en analyseren van ouderdomsanalyses (AR Aging Reports) om betaaltrends en risico's vroegtijdig te signaleren.
