title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project. Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch. Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen. Solliciteer en ontdek hoe jij recruitment bij Change verder in beweging kunt brengen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Lead – Connectivity Domain
description: Do you enjoy helping engineering teams grow while keeping a close eye on technical quality? Are you a servant leader who leads through influence rather than authority? Then you could be the Engineering Lead we're looking for. As Engineering Lead, you'll lead and coach three back-office engineering teams in our connectivity domain . Each team has about three developers, plus outsourced developers. You'll make sure the teams deliver predictably and to a high technical standard, that people keep growing, and that the work stays aligned with product goals. You'll be part of a group of six Engineering Leads , working together on team effectiveness, technical improvements and tech alignment across teams. Location: Sunweb Group office in Rotterdam (Hybrid) Start Date: Asap Availability : Fulltime Your impact Lead, coach and develop three engineering teams, and build high-performing teams with a growth and blameless mindset Ensure predictable delivery while balancing speed with sustainable engineering practices Drive technical improvements and engineering excellence, and promote software best practices Simplify complex technical solutions and help teams make sound technical decisions Guide teams through change and build a culture of continuous improvement Align multiple stakeholders across business and technology, and drive tech alignment on cross-team initiatives Work with external technology partners and suppliers when needed Who you'll work with You'll work closely with other Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, Architects and Product Owners. You'll also work with technicall stakeholders from Hotels, Transport, Ancillaries and Purchasing. Who you are You're a servant leader with strong people skills, technical curiosity and high quality standards, and you take a pragmatic approach. You work independently, take ownership and stay resilient when you meet resistance. You hold teams accountable, balance business and technical needs, and are always looking for the next step to improve. What you bring 5+ years of experience in software engineering A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Fluency in English Dutch and/or Spanish is a big plus Proven experience leading engineering teams, and you're comfortable managing several teams at once Experience working with cross-functional product teams and with Product and Architecture stakeholders Strong skills in people leadership, coaching, stakeholder management and Agile delivery Strong communication and influencing skills, plus experience with change management A lean approach to problem solving and decision making Solid technical knowledge of: Software engineering and modern cloud-native architectures CI/CD, DevOps and software delivery practices Software quality, observability, security and operational excellence AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering productivity Lean software craftsmanship and continuous improvement Your toolbox Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, observability and monitoring platforms, and collaboration and documentation tools. Not ticking every box? At Sunweb Group, we believe curiosity, energy, and the right mindset matter more than meeting every single requirement. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear your story — let’s explore the journey together. Let us introduce Sunweb Group Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories. Why join our journey? Yearly gross salary between 85K and 100K plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts. Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends. As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. Access to LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth. Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being. Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine. Ready for departure? Do you want to become part of our team as Engineering Lead? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you! Closing date for applications: 7 November Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. title: Stage community- en interactieredacteur magazines - Libelle
description: Amsterdam - Bij Libelle geloven we dat mooie en inspirerende verhalen mensen verbinden. Via onze website, app en social media brengen we onze lezers met elkaar én met de redactie in contact. Met quizzen, enquêtes en winacties stimuleren we die interactie iedere dag. Wil jij ervaring opdoen en meewerken aan een inspirerende omgeving? Lees dan snel verder! Wat ga je doen? Als stagiair Community- en Interactieredacteur speel je een actieve rol in het versterken van de verbinding tussen onze lezers en de redactie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze online community betrokken blijft en levert waardevolle inzichten die bijdragen aan nieuwe verhalen en content. Dit doe je onder andere door: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Onderwerpen, stellingen, quizzen en enquêtes te bedenken die lezers uitnodigen om actief mee te praten. Winacties te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren in samenwerking met de redactie en marketeers. Reacties op onze website en socialmediakanalen te modereren en online gesprekken op een prettige manier te begeleiden volgens onze huisregels. Te signaleren welke onderwerpen leven onder onze lezers en deze inzichten te delen met de redactie. Actief mee te denken over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen op het gebied van communitymanagement en online engagement. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een betrokken en ervaren redactie, waar je veel ruimte krijgt om ideeën aan te dragen en praktijkervaring op te doen. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Libelle, een van de grootste en meest vertrouwde magazinemerken van Nederland. Met inspirerende verhalen, praktische tips en herkenbare onderwerpen bereiken we dagelijks een grote en betrokken doelgroep via ons magazine, onze website, app en socialmediakanalen. We bouwen continu aan een sterke community waarin lezers elkaar én onze redactie weten te vinden. Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat? Voor deze stage zoeken wij een nieuwsgierige en betrokken student met interesse in online communities en digitale content. Daarnaast: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Je volgt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Communicatie, Media, Journalistiek of Commerciële Economie. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er leeft onder onze lezers. Je vindt het leuk om online gesprekken op gang te brengen en mensen met elkaar te verbinden. Je kunt zorgvuldig, objectief en zelfstandig afwegingen maken. Je denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen. Je bent op zoek naar een stageplek vanaf februari 2027 voor een periode van minimaal 5 maanden. Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wat krijg je van ons? Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn! li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> 💰 Een passende stagevergoeding van 400 euro p/m. 🎓 Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en trainingen. 💻 Een laptop om op te werken. 🤝 Begeleiding van ervaren journalisten en marketeers. 🏢 Een geweldige werkplek in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). Van (spontane) borrels tot teamuitjes en ons legendarische personeelsfeest, hier voel je je meteen thuis! Stagelopen bij DPG Media Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv! Over DPG Media DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl , Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat? Solliciteren, en dan? Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct en uiterlijk 13 december! Je krijgt binnen 10 werkdagen een reactie op je sollicitatie. Meer weten? Neem dan contact op met Simone van Zwienen (Redactiecoördinator) via . title: Healthcare Data Consultant
description: Onze Missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Data: Je hebt een affiniteit met data en bent in staat om klanten te helpen met optimale inzichten uit onze producten te halen. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden, interne stakeholders en klanten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden: Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. Naast een baan met een duidelijke missie bieden wij jou: Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, fiets leaseplan, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de zorg? Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande knop en je CV uploaden. Voor meer informatie, of als je vragen hebt, kun je contact opnemen met Wesley Schreuder op Ons bedrijf zet zich in voor het creëren van een werkplek die gelijkheid, diversiteit en inclusie bevordert. Wij geloven dat een diverse workforce essentieel is voor ons succes. Terwijl we blijven streven naar een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt – ongeacht ras, gender, seksuele geaardheid, leeftijd, religie of andere kenmerken – moedigen wij iedereen aan om te solliciteren. title: Product Manager (m/w/d) 100%
description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden HINT AG suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) 100% Gesundheitswesen sicher digitalisiert Wir decken die ICT-Bedürfnisse der Schweizer Spitäler, Heime und Praxen ab, sodass sich diese voll und ganz auf ihre Arbeit konzentrieren können. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Service Management suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Product Manager Deine Aufgaben Du kennst das Gesundheitswesen und weisst, was Leistungserbringer im Alltag bewegt. Du entwickelst gerne Angebote, kannst Menschen dafür gewinnen und bringst die Umsetzung voran. Bei uns verbindest du Branchenwissen mit kommerziellem Gespür und gestaltest Produkte und Services mit konkretem Kundennutzen. Du bringst dein Verständnis für die Abläufe und Herausforderungen von Spitälern, Heimen und Praxen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktstrategie und unseres Portfolios ein. Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und Marktpotenziale und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Partnern passende, standardisierte und wirtschaftliche Angebote. Du führst die Beteiligten zusammen, klärst Anforderungen und Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst die Entwicklung und Markteinführung unserer Produkte und Services voran. Du unterstützt Sales und Account Management in Kundengesprächen, Workshops und Angebotspräsentationen. Dabei vermittelst du den fachlichen und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen unserer Leistungen überzeugend. Du präsentierst unsere Angebote und relevante Digitalisierungsthemen bei Kundenveranstaltungen, Fachanlässen und in Vorträgen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Sales und Marketing die Positionierung, Verkaufsargumente und Unterlagen für eine erfolgreiche Vermarktung. Du kalkulierst Produktkosten mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen, wirkst bei Preisen und Verrechnungsmodellen mit und beurteilst die Wirtschaftlichkeit des Portfolios. Du begleitest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus von der Einführung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ablösung und lässt Rückmeldungen aus Vertrieb und Betrieb gezielt einfliessen. Du stellst verständliche und aktuelle Produktinformationen im Servicekatalog und Webshop sicher und wirkst bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres standardisierten Hardware-Sortiments mit. Dein Profil Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen aus eigener Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise direkt bei einem Leistungserbringer wie einem Spital, Heim oder Praxisverbund. Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit. Du kannst verkaufen: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, formulierst überzeugende Nutzenargumente und begeisterst unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen für eine Lösung. Du trittst sicher auf und präsentierst gerne – im persönlichen Kundengespräch ebenso wie in Workshops oder vor einem grösseren Publikum. Du bist kommunikationsstark, vernetzt Menschen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit über Bereichs- und Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg. Du packst an, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Themen mit Eigeninitiative, Struktur und Beharrlichkeit zum Abschluss. Du verbindest ein gutes Verständnis für ICT-Services und Healthcare-Applikationen mit analytischem und betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken. Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Gesundheitswesen, in Medizininformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder Betriebswirtschaft beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. title: Duitssprekende recruiter
description: Vacature: Recruiter bij PhysioMatch Locatie: Regio Groningen | Fulltime/Parttime Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging? Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste recruiter die ons team komt versterken! Wil jij zorgprofessionals begeleiden naar hun droombaan in Zwitserland? Ben jij communicatief sterk en spreek je vloeiend Duits? Dan gaan we graag met jou in gesprek. Lees verder en ontdek of deze kans jouw volgende stap kan zijn. Misschien word jij binnenkort onze nieuwe collega. Taken Wat ga je doen? Tijdens het intakegesprek informeer je de kandidaat over de mogelijkheden die Zwitserland biedt en bespreek je uitgebreid hun wensen en verwachtingen. Samen met het team selecteer je de best passende opdrachtgevers bij je kandidaten en je stelt deze voor. Regelmatig heb je contact met je opdrachtgevers om op de hoogte te blijven van hun wensen en behoeften. Je bouwt een band op met de kandidaten door ze zorgvuldig te begeleiden in het emigratieproces. Je denkt mee over de marketing en werving van zorgprofessionals zoals fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen. Je schrijft vacatureteksten Je bezoekt circa een keer per jaar zorginstellingen in Zwitserland om bestaande relaties te onderhouden. Vereisten Jij brengt mee: Geen ervaring nodig, je wordt goed ingewerkt. Fouten maken mag! Actieve werkhouding, je pakt makkelijk de telefoon. Gezelligheid: interesse in collega's, klanten en kandidaten. HBO werk- en denkniveau. Pré: ervaring met fysiotherapie. Woonachtig in Groningen of omgeving. Vloeiende beheersing van de Duitse taal (B2/C1 niveau). Goede kennis van Engels en redelijke kennis van Nederlands, extra talen zijn mooi meegenomen. Pré: werkervaring in de zorg. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Actief en gezellig team met een moderne werkomgeving. Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk. Gezellige teamuitjes en trips naar Zwitserland. Werklaptop, telefoon en een goed gevulde koelkast. Goed salaris. Een baan voor langere tijd. Interesse? Extra info over PhysioMatch: PhysioMatch is gespecialiseerd in het bemiddelen van zorgprofessionals, zoals fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen, voor diverse instellingen in Zwitserland. We zorgen voor de ideale match tussen professionals en zorginstellingen, waarbij we de nadruk leggen op persoonlijke begeleiding. title: Senior PMO Analyst
description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
description: <h3><strong>Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)</strong></h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> CTO</p> <p><strong>About the venture: ROB'E</strong></p> <p>ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.</p> <p>Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.</li> <li>Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.</li> <li>Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.</li> <li>Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.</li> <li>Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.</li> or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.</li> <li>At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.</li> <li>Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.</li> <li>Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.</li> <li>Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.</li> <li>Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.</li> <li>Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to single use interface components.</li> <li>Dutch or German language skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real title: Senior Credit & Risk Associate
description: We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank What you can expect ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our ClearBank Europe’s Operations team as a Senior Credit & Risk Associate? Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, you will be at the centre of the day-to-day credit lifecycle. You will own and execute the core credit assessment, monitoring and provisioning activities that support sound lending decisions, and you will coordinate the information and hand-offs required across Sales, Finance & Treasury, and Risk. Alongside this, you will support the management of ClearBank Europe’s operational risk environment, risks and controls, operational risk events, issues and actions, and evidence of control effectiveness across the Operations function. The role in a nutshell: you produce, operate and coordinate the first-line credit process; working closely with second line as they provide independent review and challenge. Your role includes: Creditworthiness assessment and underwriting Own the creditworthiness assessment model specifications and the supporting assessment tool, keeping the methodology and practical execution aligned. Execute creditworthiness assessments for onboarding and periodic reviews, including gathering and assessing the required client inputs and translating the outcome into a clear credit conclusion. Prepare the first-line overdraft / credit proposal, inc luding the proposed limit and the analysis supporting the recommendation, and coordinate the proposal through the relevant approval process. Coordinate credit onboarding once approved, ensuring agreed credit terms and the relevant operational hand-offs are clear to the teams involved. Early warning, portfolio monitoring & provisioning Own and operate the Early Warning Indicator assessment process and investigate triggered cases. Maintain visibility of Watch List and Default cases, ensuring appropriate escalation and hand-off. Produce first-line credit risk monitoring across the portfolio, identifying changes in exposure, concentrations and emerging risks. Coordinate annual credit reviews, renewals and exits. Support NPE and forbearance management through appropriate first-line analysis, case history and supporting data. Credit risk framework and pricing Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures. Translate relevant policy requirements into practical processes, tools, controls and monitoring. Coordinate periodic review of relevant interest-rate spreads and overdraft fees with Finance & Treasury. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process. Risk & Controls Support the ongoing development of Operations risk and control within ClearBank Europe, ensuring operational risks, controls and residual-risk assessments remain current, appropriately evidenced and aligned to risk appetite. Work with risk and control owners to assess inherent risk, control design and effectiveness, and residual risk, providing constructive first-line challenge where required. Maintain oversight of locally operated, Group and outsourced controls, ensuring ClearBank Europe has appropriate evidence and entity-level oversight. Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment. What does success in this role look like? Credit assessments and proposals are timely, well evidenced and decision-ready, with a clear audit trail from client information through to conclusion and limit recommendation. Daily EWI monitoring and annual reviews operate reliably, with Watch List, Default, renewal and exit cases identified and progressed without unnecessary delay. The first-line credit framework, models and tools remain practical, current and consistently applied as the lending portfolio develops. Stakeholders have a clear view of case status, responsibilities and next steps because you actively coordinate the credit lifecycle rather than simply completing individual analyses. There is clear separation between first-line ownership and second-line independent challenge, while the two roles work together effectively to keep the portfolio within approved risk appetite. Robust, current and well-evidenced operational risk and control environment, proactively identifying emerging risks and control weaknesses and ensuring appropriate actions are taken to address them. What you’ll bring: Hands-on experience in credit analysis, underwriting, portfolio monitoring or a closely related first-line credit role within banking or regulated financial services. Strong ability to analyse financial and non-financial information and convert it into a concise, evidence-based credit view and recommendation. Working knowledge of business or institutional lending products and the risk drivers associated with limits, overdrafts or comparable credit exposures. title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Bengaluru
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p class="p2"><strong>Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru.<br><br></strong></p> <div>About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</div> <div> </div> <div>Based in Bengaluru, you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare’s solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.</div> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare’s target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.</div> <div> </div> <div>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. YYou will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements</div> <div> </div> <div>Additional responsibilities will include</div> <ul> <li> <div>Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals</div> </li> <li> <div>Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base</div> </li> <li> <div>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts</div> </li> <li> <div>Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity</div> </li> <li> <div>< 50% travel</div> </li> </ul> <div>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</div> <ul> <li> <div>Bachelor's degree required</div> </li> <li> <div>Fluent in English</div> </li> <li> <div>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)</div> </li> <li> <div>Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts</div> </li> <li> <div>Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions</div> </li> <li> <div>Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations</div> </li> <li> <div>Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and “how the internet works”</div> </li> <li> <div>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</div> </li> <li> <div>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</div> </li> </ul> <p class="p2"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 4-12yrs</p> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Principal, Customer Storytelling & Advocacy
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.</p> <p>We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. You will also build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows that enable us to discover, produce, and amplify distinctive customer stories at scale.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Interview customers and find the story: </strong>Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. </li> <li><strong>Explain the technology in simple terms: </strong>Turn topics like Zero Trust or Workers AI into stories that business and technical readers can both follow, and keep the technical details right.</li> <li><strong>Lead a few big moments each year:</strong> Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.</li> <li><strong>Come up with ideas that get noticed: </strong>Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.</li> <li><strong>Try new formats:</strong> Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.</li> <li><strong>Set the quality standard: </strong>Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.</li> <li><strong>Supply executives with stories:</strong> Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams to get stories approved: </strong>Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.</li> <li><strong>Use AI to scale: </strong>Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical fluency</strong>: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Reporter and editor instincts</strong>: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.</li> <li><strong>Creative judgment and taste</strong>: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.</li> <li><strong>Production experience</strong>: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.</li> <li><strong>Executive presence and influence</strong>: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>London, United Kingdom or Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success - all working together to help our customers adopt Cloudflare and build great Internet-enabled experiences. related connections and relationships</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce and other sales reporting and BI tools</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Capacity to strive in a diverse and multicultural workplace</li> <li>Aptitude to learn new technical concepts and terms</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required in a related field (Computer engineering, computer science or similar studies). We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.</p> <p><strong>Telemetry Export</strong> delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.</p> <p><strong>Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.</strong></p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You've relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today's tools fall short.</li> <li>You've run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you've ingested someone else's data at scale at a vendor.</li> <li>You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.</li> <li>You've priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.</li> <li>You're comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you're talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.</li> <li>You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Colorado</strong> based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div
