title: Release Engineer, Salesforce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.</li> <li>Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.</li> <li>Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.</li> <li>Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora, </strong>and other <strong>Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.</li> <li>Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.</li> <li>Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.</li> <li>Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.</li> <li>Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.</li> <li>Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.</li> <li>Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.</li> <li>Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.</li> <li>Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.</li> <li>Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.</li> <li>Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.</li> <li>Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms.Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using While Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare’s solution to serverless computing, handles the infrastructure part, there’s so much more that goes into enabling developers to do their jobs. Developer experience plays a critical role in the success of developers using our platform, so it is our team’s goal to make authoring and testing on our platform easy to understand, accessible, and fun! If this excites you, come join our team of talented engineers that enables developers all around the world to build low-latency planet-scale applications for the Internet and the Web!</p> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Our team is part of Cloudflare's Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) group, where new, bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. As the Workers Authoring and Testing team, we develop and maintain tools and packages within a larger collection of developer resources for one of ETIs most successful endeavors so far, Cloudflare Workers. </p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>As a member of the Workers Authoring and Testing team, you will put yourself in the shoes of a developer, and use your understanding of software engineering, Web and Internet technologies, and modern JS frameworks to propose, evaluate, and implement innovative technical solutions that create and improve the development experience on the Cloudflare Workers development platform. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <h3 class=

title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a <strong>software engineering manager</strong> with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds <a href="https://snapcraft.io" target="_blank">snaps</a>, <a href="https://juju.is/docs/sdk/charmed-operators">charms</a> and more recently, rocks (<a href="https://opencontainers.org/about/overview/">OCI images</a>).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://github.com/snapcore/snapcraft" target="_blank">Snapcraft</a> allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Likewise, <a href="https://github.com/canonical/charmcraft" target="_blank">Charmcraft</a> enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on<a href="https://charmhub.io/"> Charmhub</a>, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</span></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.</li> <li>Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.</li> <li>Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.</li> <li>Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.</li> <li>Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.</li> <li>Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.</li> <li>Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.</li> <li>Engaging with the wider open source community for feedback and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern high-level languages (Python, Go) as well as containerization technologies and primitives (Snaps, Docker, etc.).</li> <li>Experience in the design and architecture of command-line and server-side applications</li> <li>Software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.</li> <li>Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.</li> <li>A passion for technology and a drive to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.</li> <li>A track record of open source leadership and collaboration.</li> <li>Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.</li> <li>A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p>

title: Senior Customer Engineer, Digital Native Start ups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2 style="line-height: 2;">Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, NY</li> </ul> <h2 style="line-height: 2;">About the Role</h2> <p style="line-height: 2;">Digital Native SEs at Cloudflare work with the most innovative and cutting-edge companies on the planet — the startups and high-growth, cloud-native businesses that are building the next generation of Internet products. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers. You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.</p> <h2 style="line-height: 2;">Responsibilities</h2> <h3 style="line-height: 2;">Specifically, we are looking for you to:</h3> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.</li> <li>Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.</li> <li>Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.</li> <li>Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.</li> <li>Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.</li> <li>Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.</li> <li>Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to <em>build on</em> Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.</li> <li>Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.</li> <li>Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.</li> <li>Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 2;">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.</li> <li>A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.</li> <li>The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — <strong>without</strong> this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.</li> <li>Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.</li> <li>A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).</li> <li>Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.</li> <li>Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.</li> <li>Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.</li> <li>You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.</li> <li>Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).</li> <li>Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.</li> <li>Experience managing technical sales within accounts, including developing champion-style relationships, driving technical wins, and assisting with technical validation.</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience.</li> <li>The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 2;">A deep understanding of the Cloudflare Developer Platform and core industry components (and a desire to learn more):</h3> <p><strong>The Cloudflare Developer Platform</strong> — serverless compute and application development with Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, and Pages. Familiarity with building or architecting applications on a serverless/edge platform is a strong plus.</p> <ul> <li>AI/GenAI application patterns — inference at the edge, RAG, vector databases, and how startups are operationalizing AI initiatives.</li> <li>HTTP technologies including reverse proxy (e.g., WAF and CDN), forward proxy (secure web gateway), and serverless application development.</li> <li>Internet security technologies including DDoS and DDoS mitigation, Firewalls, TLS, VPN, DLP.</li> <li>Networking technologies including TCP, UDP, DNS, IPv4 + IPv6, BGP routing, GRE, SD-WAN, MPLS, Global Traffic Management.</li> <li>Zero-trust network access (ZTNA & SASE) concepts including identity management and authentication.</li> <li>Cloud computing technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and others.</li> <li>Some scripting or programming familiarity with one or more of JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Golang, BASH — enough to read code, build a demo, and converse with engineers (not to ship production software).</li> <li>Understanding of, or experience with, regulatory requirements such as FedRAMP, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC-2, ISO/IEC.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>You can translate technical concepts and jargon for a wide variety of audiences: from systems engineers, to front-end developers, through to technical founders and C-levels.</li> <li>You want to be constantly learning new things and teaching what you've learned to the broader team through internal and external blog posts, team demos, and product training sessions.</li> <li>You have a kna

description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Build a trusted market research practice and become a standing strategic partner for GTM planning, brought into launch planning early enough to shape the work. - Own brand tracking as a clear input into how Notion understands awareness, consideration, and perception, and translate those signals into sharper messaging and GTM priorities. - Connect customer, competitive, product, and top-of-funnel research across global markets to inform growth strategy and audience strategy. - Raise the bar for Notion’s research capabilities across decision support and thought leadership, building original studies on topics like AI transformation and ROI that give Marketing and Sales a credible point of view in the AI landscape. - Use AI as a research collaborator and workflow layer to connect data, scale analysis, surface patterns, and make insights easier for stakeholders to use, while improving the quality of decisions, not just the speed of delivery. SKILLS YOU’LL BRING - Strong quantitative research craft, including the ability to design and run research sprints, surveys, and MaxDiff studies, and to choose the right method for the decision at hand. - Deep understanding of brand tracking and top-of-funnel research, with the judgment to place those signals in the broader customer, competitive, and product context. - Strategic judgment: you can challenge the brief, connect market and product data, and turn ambiguous evidence into a clear recommendation that changes GTM priorities. - Experience working across global markets and regional teams, flexing across Product, Creative, and GTM while distinguishing local context from patterns that should shape broader strategy. - AI fluency and systems thinking: you use AI and data workflows thoughtfully to connect research infrastructure, scale insight delivery, and make the broader team more effective Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of their network infrastructure.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary technical support contact for assigned Enterprise customers.</li> <li>Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, Account Executives, Professional Services, and Partners to support every phase of the customer journey.</li> <li>Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, and automated handover documentation, to increase team productivity and focus on strategic customer advocacy.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high customer satisfaction, delivering world-class technical support and advocacy.</li> <li>Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.</li> <li>Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments and Cloudflare deployments, ensuring proactive issue resolution and long-term optimizations.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, and emerging security threats, while prioritizing remediation paths with customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, and deep-dive analysis of top ticket drivers, as well reviewing future-state resilience, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption. </li> <li>Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones.</li> <li>Partner with the account team to drive strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, and incident response.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities (Zero-Days, emerging DDoS vectors), ensuring defensive configurations are deployed ahead of potential exploits. </li> <li>Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, working with backend teams as needed.</li> <li>Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations don't deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds. </li> <li>Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to work one weekend per month.</li> <li>Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and providing strategic infrastructure optimization recommendations.</li> <li>Streamline the creation of technical documentation—including HLDs, LLDs, and post-incident reports—by leveraging AI workflows to ingest and summarize technical data, ensuring consistent, high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Deploy AI-assisted incident management tools to enhance communication precision, including real-time impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and handle multiple priorities.</li> </ul> <p>This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare’s Enterprise customer experience, helping businesses optimize their network performance and security while shaping the future of our products.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $114,000 - $157,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Our work influences open standards (like QUIC, MASQUE, and ECH), involves close collaboration with the IETF, and pushes the boundaries of what's possible in networking and security.</p> <p>You don’t need to be an HTTP or cryptography expert to join — we’re looking for excellent engineers who love tough problems, want to learn deeply, and are excited to contribute to one of the most technically demanding areas of infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and operate systems that terminate HTTP and TLS at Internet scale</li> <li>Migrate core infrastructure from NGINX to a next-gen Rust-based proxy</li> <li>Measure and improve protocol performance across real-world traffic</li> <li>Contribute to open source and industry standards</li> <li>Learn from and work alongside some of the leading engineers in this space<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>You might be a good fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have solid systems programming experience (Rust, C, or similar)</li> <li>Thrive in complex technical domains and enjoy learning new things</li> <li>Care about building reliable, secure, and performant software</li> <li>Are motivated by impact — technical, operational, and on the Internet itself</li> <li>Come from a background that’s underrepresented in tech — we value diverse perspectives<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks include:</strong><strong><br></strong>Flexible work hours • Take-what-you-need vacation • RSUs • ESPP • Meaningful technical challenges every day</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year. This position requires authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Staff Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll turn raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decisions across GitLab's global Support Engineering organization. You'll design dashboards, reports, and data models that help leaders monitor performance, optimize costs, and improve customer outcomes. You'll also promote data innovation by experimenting thoughtfully and working through complex problems.<br><br><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own annual operating plan and capacity planning through data modeling and validation that support workforce and budget decisions.</li> <li>Build and maintain utilization and team-performance scorecards, including automated alerting that surfaces trends in real time.</li> <li>Analyze Support Economics, including cost-per-ticket modeling, self-service savings, and product quality costs.</li> <li>Develop performance indexes and heatmaps that identify product areas and customers using the most support resources.</li> <li>Lead dashboarding for AI adoption and return on investment, measuring the business impact of AI-driven initiatives across Support Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with go-to-market teams on predictive analytics and churn-prevention models that identify at-risk customers.</li> <li>Define and refine unified customer-schema requirements to create consistent data across systems and a single source of truth.</li> <li>Deliver Monthly Business Review telemetry, executive-ready reporting packages, recurring operational reports, and ad hoc analysis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence analyst, analytics engineer, or in a similar data role, ideally in a software as a service or technology company.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Technical Support, Business Operations, Product Engineering, or similar organizations.</li> <li>Fluency in SQL, including complex multi-table joins, grouping and aggregation, common table expressions, and conditional filters.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Zendesk Explore, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Plan and prioritize work independently in a remote, cross-functional environment across time zones.</li> <li>You may also bring experience with large language model-based tools, artificial intelligence and machine learning workflows, durable data solutions, analytics frameworks, in-depth data analysis, or presenting to senior leaders and executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>Our Support Engineering organization uses data to understand performance, improve customer outcomes, and improve operational practices. You'll partner across Support Engineering, go-to-market teams, Business Operations, and Product Engineering in an all-remote environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.</li> </ul> without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, title: Principal Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3><p>Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, and every API call that configures it, from any customer, integration, or internal service, starts by proving who is calling and what they're allowed to do. The IAM team owns the authentication and authorization systems behind that: the identity layer of the Control Plane operating at global scale. Our surface spans things like login and SSO, OAuth and API tokens, account membership, roles and permissions, and SCIM provisioning.</p><p>We’re hiring a hands-on Principal Engineer to shape the technical direction of Cloudflare’s IAM platform and lead complex initiatives across teams. You’ll work from architecture through production code and rollout, evolving services under live traffic to deliver new customer capabilities, greater scale, edge-native execution, and support for data residency requirements. You’ll help teams make sound tradeoffs between security, correctness, latency, and availability.</p><h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Architecture & strategy:</strong> Set the technical direction and delivery strategy for IAM, connecting customer needs with architectural decisions and practical, incremental investments.</p></li><li><p><strong>Technical leadership & delivery:</strong> Lead complex initiatives across engineering teams, resolve ambiguity, build agreement on tradeoffs, and carry decisions through implementation and production rollout.</p></li><li><p><strong>Hands-on engineering:</strong> Design, build, and debug critical authentication and authorization services, including safe migrations and backward-compatible API changes.</p></li><li><p><strong>Security & reliability:</strong> Partner with Security to strengthen threat models and tenant isolation. Guide reliability improvements through observability, incident learning, and resilient system design.</p></li><li><p><strong>Mentorship & engineering judgment:</strong> Develop senior and staff engineers through design collaboration, code reviews, and clear technical decisions.</p></li><li><p><strong>Engineering effectiveness & automation</strong>: Identify and lead investments in automation and AI that improve how teams build, test, and operate IAM services. Prioritize measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability, and engineering capacity while maintaining security and correctness.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Extensive experience:</strong> A sustained record of building and operating large-scale production systems, setting technical direction across teams, and delivering complex initiatives with measurable customer or operational impact.</p></li><li><p><strong>Identity expertise: </strong>Deep experience building production authentication or authorization systems, with sound judgment around identity protocols, permission models, tenant isolation, and credential and session lifecycles.</p></li><li><p><strong>Distributed systems mastery:</strong> Proven track record in designing, architecting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems that handle global traffic.</p></li><li><p><strong>Languages & storage: </strong>Strong backend engineering skills and willingness to work extensively in Go, with practical depth in relational data modeling, transactions, caching, and distributed consistency. Experience with Go and PostgreSQL is particularly relevant.</p></li><li><p><strong>API stewardship:</strong> Significant experience designing and versioning public-facing APIs that are used by millions of developers.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Cloudflare ecosystem:</strong> Experience building on <strong>Cloudflare Workers</strong> or similar serverless/edge computing environments.</p></li><li><p><strong>Observability advocate:</strong> A passion for building "observable" systems using Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana to proactively identify failures.</p></li><li><p><strong>Infrastructure as code:</strong> Experience with modern containerized deployment (Docker & Kubernetes), <strong>Terraform</strong>, and infrastructure automation.</p></li><li><p><strong>Security mindset:</strong> A background in security engineering or formal verification of protocol implementations.</p></li></ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.</p> <p>We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.</li> <li>You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.</li> <li>You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.</li> <li>You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.</li> <li>You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. exploits, and attacker techniques evolve.</li> <li><strong>Investigate false positives and missed attacks.</strong> Analyze customer reports and request telemetry, reproduce issues, and refine other detection teams to deliver reliable protections and resolve recurring customer problems at their roots.</li> <li><strong>Share actionable research.</strong> Document findings, explain mitigation decisions, and contribute to internal research reports and public-facing blogs on vulnerabilities and Internet-wide attack trends.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal or London, the UK</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.<strong> </strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least three of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a Web Engineering Manager to work collaboratively with many teams and roles across the organisation including product managers and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable and delightful user experiences for users of Canonical products.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as web engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in web development is a must so that you’re able to challenge and grow your team members.
